-- Track which player has the UI open and which mat they're editing
matChooserState = {
    playerColor = nil,  -- Which player has the UI open
    matGUID = nil       -- GUID of the mat being edited
}

function onLoad()
    -- Register the textures for the UI
    local assets = {}
    for i, data in ipairs(MAT_IMAGES) do
        -- Use thumb if available, otherwise fallback to full url
        local imgUrl = data.thumb or data.url
        table.insert(assets, {
            name = "Mat_Thumb_" .. i,
            url = imgUrl
        })
    end
    UI.setCustomAssets(assets)

    -- Ensure UI starts hidden
    Wait.frames(function()
        UI.setAttribute("MatChooserPanel", "active", "false")
    end, 1)
end

-- Called by mat objects to open the chooser UI
function openMatChooser(params)
    local playerColor = params.playerColor
    local matGUID = params.matGUID
    
    -- Store state
    matChooserState.playerColor = playerColor
    matChooserState.matGUID = matGUID
    
    -- Show UI to this player only
    UI.setAttribute("MatChooserPanel", "visibility", playerColor)
    UI.setAttribute("MatChooserPanel", "active", "true")
end

-- Called when close button is clicked
function closeMatChooser(player, value, id)
    UI.setAttribute("MatChooserPanel", "active", "false")
    matChooserState.playerColor = nil
    matChooserState.matGUID = nil
end

-- Called when a mat thumbnail is clicked
function selectMatImage(player, value, id)
    -- Extract index from button ID (format: "MatSelect_Index")
    local indexStr = id:match("%d+$")
    if not indexStr then return end
    
    local index = tonumber(indexStr)
    local data = MAT_IMAGES[index]
    if not data then return end
    
    -- Find the mat object
    local matObj = getObjectFromGUID(matChooserState.matGUID)
    if not matObj then
        printToColor("Mat object not found!", player.color, {1, 0.3, 0.3})
        return
    end
    
    printToAll("Changing Mat to: " .. data.name, {0.2, 0.8, 0.2})
    
    -- Tell the mat to change its image
    matObj.call("changeMatImage", {url = data.url})
end

-- Generic Tracker

CONFIG = {
    MIN_VALUE = 0,
    MAX_VALUE = 99,
    COLOR = {0.5, 0.73, 1, 100}, -- font color
}

function onload(saved_data)
    val = CONFIG.MIN_VALUE

    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local ok, loaded = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(saved_data) end)
        if ok and loaded then
            if type(loaded) == "table" then
                val = loaded[2] or loaded[1] or val
            elseif type(loaded) == "number" then
                val = loaded
            end

-- Generic Tracker
CONFIG = {
    MIN_VALUE = 1,
    MAX_VALUE = 9,
    COLOR = {0.9, 0.9, 0.9, 100}, -- font color
}

-- Click guard for single vs double click behavior
local _click_pending = false
local _click_timer = nil

function onload(saved_data)
    val = CONFIG.MIN_VALUE

    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local ok, loaded = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(saved_data) end)
        if ok and loaded then
            if type(loaded) == "table" then
                val = loaded[2] or loaded[1] or val
            elseif type(loaded) == "number" then
                val = loaded
            end
        end
    end

    createAll()
end

function updateSave()
    self.script_state = JSON.encode(val)
end

function createAll()
    local s_color = CONFIG.COLOR
    local ttText = self.getName()

    self.createButton({
        label = tostring(val),
        click_function = "add_subtract",
        tooltip = ttText,
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 0.05, 0.2},
        height = 600,
        width = 1000,
        alignment = 3,
        scale = {x = 1.5, y = 1.5, z = 1.5},
        font_size = 900,
        font_color = s_color,
        color = {0, 0, 0, 0},
    })

    self.createButton({
        label = "End\nRound",
        click_function = "end_round",
        tooltip = "End Round: advance and reset ship activations",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 0, 1.85},
        height = 750,
        width = 1300,
        alignment = 3,
        scale = {x = 0.60, y = 0.60, z = 0.60},
        font_size = 300,
        font_color = {1, 1, 1, 0},
        color = {0, 0, 0, 0},
    })
end

function removeAll()
    pcall(function() self.removeInput(0) end)
    -- safely attempt to remove up to 4 buttons (some may not exist)
    for i = 1, 4 do pcall(function() self.removeButton(0) end) end
end

function reloadAll()
    removeAll()
    createAll()
    setTooltips()
    updateSave()
end

-- swap_fcolor removed (not used)

-- swap_align removed (not used)

-- swap_tooltip removed (not used)

-- editName removed (not used)

-- perform the actual increment/decrement (bypass click guard)
function do_add_subtract(mod)
    -- cancel any pending click message/timer
    if _click_timer then
        pcall(function() Wait.stop(_click_timer) end)
        _click_timer = nil
    end
    _click_pending = false

    local new_value = math.min(math.max(val + mod, CONFIG.MIN_VALUE), CONFIG.MAX_VALUE)
    if val ~= new_value then
        val = new_value
        updateVal()
        updateSave()
    end
end

-- Clicked on the counter: require a double-click within 0.3s to actually change value
function add_subtract(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1

    if _click_pending then
        -- second click (within window) -> perform change and cancel pending message
        _click_pending = false
        if _click_timer then pcall(function() Wait.stop(_click_timer) end) end
        _click_timer = nil
        do_add_subtract(mod)
        return
    end

    -- first click: start a short timer; if it expires, show the message (i.e. only show message if user did NOT double-click)
    _click_pending = true
    _click_timer = Wait.time(function()
        if _click_pending then
            broadcastToAll("Use End Round button to move to next round.\nTo override this, double click", {r=1, g=1, b=0})
            _click_pending = false
        end
        _click_timer = nil
    end, 0.3)
end

function updateVal()
    local ttText = self.getName()
    self.editButton({index = 0, label = tostring(val), tooltip = ttText})
end

function reset_val()
    val = CONFIG.MIN_VALUE
    updateVal()
    updateSave()
end

function setTooltips()
    local ttText = self.getName()
    self.editButton({index = 0, value = tostring(val), tooltip = ttText})
end



function increment()
    -- bypass click-guard and directly increment
    do_add_subtract(1)
end

-- End round handler: increment this counter and reset all ships' Activated condition
function end_round(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    -- First, increment this counter (uses existing logic which clamps to min/max)
    increment()

    -- Now reset all ships on the table (objects with RSS_Class == "Model")
    local shipCount = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local ok, cls = pcall(function() return obj.getVar("RSS_Class") end)
        if ok and cls == "Model" then
            shipCount = shipCount + 1
            -- Call ModifyCondition safely in case some objects don't implement it
            pcall(function()
                obj.call("ModifyCondition", { name = "Activated", amount = -1 })
            end)
        end
    end

    if shipCount > 0 then
        broadcastToAll("Reset Ship Activations and advanced to next round", {r=1, g=1, b=0})
    else
        broadcastToAll("No ships found to reset", {r=1, g=1, b=0})
    end
end

-- Global variable to store health
local current_health = 0
local b_display_health = nil

function onLoad(saved_data)
    -- Initialize button parameters first
    generateButtonParameters()
    
    -- Try to load saved data
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        current_health = loaded_data.health
    else
        -- Set default value if no saved data exists
        current_health = 0
    end
    
    -- Create button and update display
    self.createButton(b_display_health)
    damage_display()
end

function onSave()
    -- Save the current health value
    local data_to_save = {
        health = current_health
    }
    return JSON.encode(data_to_save)
end

function damage_counter(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_health = current_health - 1
    else
        current_health = current_health + 1
    end
    damage_display()
end

function damage_display()
    if (current_health < 0) then
        current_health = 0
    end
    b_display_health.label = tostring(current_health)
    b_display_health.tooltip = tostring(current_health)
    self.editButton(b_display_health)
end

function generateButtonParameters()
    b_display_health = {
        index = 0,
        click_function = 'damage_counter',
        function_owner = self,
        label = '',
        position = {0, 0.05, 0},
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        width = 500,
        height = 500,
        font_size = 450
    }
end

-- Initialize state table
local buttonStates = {
    crown = true,
    upper = true,
    lower = true
}

    -- Load saved state if it exists
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        buttonStates = JSON.decode(saved_data)
    end
    
    -- Create Crown button (at the top of token)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleCrown",
        function_owner = self,
        label = buttonStates.crown and "Crown Healthy" or "Crown Destroyed",
        position = {0, 0.2, -0.7},  -- Top of token
        width = 800,
        height = 200,
        font_size = 60,
        color = buttonStates.crown and {0, 1, 0} or {1, 0, 0},
    })
    
    -- Create Upper Tower button (in middle of token)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleUpper",
        function_owner = self,
        label = buttonStates.upper and "Upper Tower Healthy" or "Upper Tower Destroyed",
        position = {0, 0.2, 0},  -- Middle of token
        width = 800,
        height = 200,
        font_size = 60,
        color = buttonStates.upper and {0, 1, 0} or {1, 0, 0},
    })
    
    -- Create Lower Tower button (at bottom of token)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleLower",
        function_owner = self,
        label = buttonStates.lower and "Lower Tower Healthy" or "Lower Tower Destroyed",
        position = {0, 0.2, 0.7},  -- Bottom of token
        width = 800,
        height = 200,
        font_size = 60,
        color = buttonStates.lower and {0, 1, 0} or {1, 0, 0},
    })
end

-- Save function that gets called when the game state needs to be saved
function onSave()
    return JSON.encode(buttonStates)
end

-- Toggle functions for each button
function toggleCrown(obj, color, alt_click)
    buttonStates.crown = not buttonStates.crown
    local newLabel = buttonStates.crown and "Crown Healthy" or "Crown Destroyed"
    local newColor = buttonStates.crown and {0, 1, 0} or {1, 0, 0}
    
    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        label = newLabel,
        color = newColor
    })
end

function toggleUpper(obj, color, alt_click)
    buttonStates.upper = not buttonStates.upper
    local newLabel = buttonStates.upper and "Upper Tower Healthy" or "Upper Tower Destroyed"
    local newColor = buttonStates.upper and {0, 1, 0} or {1, 0, 0}
    
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,
        label = newLabel,
        color = newColor
    })
end

function toggleLower(obj, color, alt_click)
    buttonStates.lower = not buttonStates.lower
    local newLabel = buttonStates.lower and "Lower Tower Healthy" or "Lower Tower Destroyed"
    local newColor = buttonStates.lower and {0, 1, 0} or {1, 0, 0}
    
    self.editButton({
        index = 2,
        label = newLabel,
        color = newColor
    })
end

-- Red Secondary Selection
local objectives = {
    {name="Key Site", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128192859/8C40325733D3EEBC309D7A910BABE1A6E0D81130/"},
    {name="Priority Target", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128196308/73606C6976F3A0C188D679E1FEC37F76C1089731/"},
    {name="Long Shot", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128193869/2B194864A8CFE8B34DA891B85CBEBA9CA7C4AA75/"},
    {name="Annihilate", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128188714/AA6206E433D35163A82CAFB57C624915B926078C/"},
    {name="Take Prizes", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128197543/95D757A1E622649F18800BDF0320899B4872E537/"},
    {name="Gather Intel", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128191687/98FC185E1D9596D7533803D8686445F362B90A96/"},
    {name="Decapitate", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128190550/25EB74AD426E5B75C0F34B2C10D362BA7DEB58BC/"},
    {name="Objectives Beyond", url="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2450612361128195035/CDA9B5A08FF4E4B9875E8BD55437B8C510CFF051/"}
}

local selectedIndices = {}

function onLoad()
    createButtons()
end

function createButtons()
    self.clearButtons()
    
    -- Using a larger scale for "far too small" fix
    local btnScale = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5}
    local titleZ = -3.1
    local startZ = -2.5
    local spacing = 0.6
    
    -- Label: "Select Secondaries:"
    self.createButton({
        label="Select Secondaries:",
        click_function="none",
        function_owner=self,
        position={0, 2, titleZ},
        height=600,
        width=3500,
        font_size=400,
        color={0.5, 0.5, 0.5},
        font_color={1,1,1},
        scale=btnScale
    })

    -- Render Option Buttons in a Vertical Column (one above the other)
    for i, obj in ipairs(objectives) do
        local isSelected = false
        for _, v in ipairs(selectedIndices) do
            if v == i then isSelected = true break end
        end

        local col = {0, 0, 0} -- Black by default
        if isSelected then col = {0.2, 0.8, 0.2} end -- Green highlight for selected

        local funcName = "clickObj_" .. i
        _G[funcName] = function() onOptionClick(i) end
        
        self.createButton({
            label=obj.name,
            click_function=funcName,
            function_owner=self,
            position={0, 2, startZ + (i-1)*spacing},
            height=600,
            width=2800,
            font_size=350,
            color=col,
            font_color={1,1,1}, -- White text
            scale=btnScale
        })
    end

    -- Done Button
    if #selectedIndices == 2 then
        local doneZ = startZ + (#objectives * spacing) + 0.1
        self.createButton({
            label="Done",
            click_function="clickDone",
            function_owner=self,
            position={0, 2, doneZ},
            height=800,
            width=3000,
            font_size=500,
            color={0.1, 0.9, 0.1},
            font_color={1,1,1},
            scale=btnScale
        })
    end
end

function onOptionClick(index)
    local foundIdx = -1
    for k, v in ipairs(selectedIndices) do
        if v == index then
            foundIdx = k
            break
        end
    end

    if foundIdx ~= -1 then
        -- Deselect
        table.remove(selectedIndices, foundIdx)
    else
        -- Select
        if #selectedIndices < 2 then
            table.insert(selectedIndices, index)
        else
            -- Already 2 selected, do not allow more
            return
        end
    end
    createButtons()
end

function clickDone()
    spawnCards()
    self.clearButtons()
    -- Permanently end process: do nothing more.
end

function spawnCards()
    -- Get current object position/rotation
    local pos = self.getPosition()
    local rot = self.getRotation()
    local right = self.getTransformRight()
    local up = self.getTransformUp()
    
    -- Spawning 2 cards centered above
    -- Offset them along local X with fixed spacing (same Z)
    local spacing = 3.1
    
    for i, idx in ipairs(selectedIndices) do
        local objData = objectives[idx]
        
        -- Calculate position
        -- Center is pos + up * 2
        -- Left/Right along local X only (same Z), offset = ±spacing/2
        local offset = (i == 1) and -spacing/2 or spacing/2
        
        local spawnPos = {
            x = pos.x + offset + 0.55,
            y = pos.y + up.y * 2 - 0.1,
            z = pos.z
        }
        
        local card = spawnObject({
            type = "CardCustom",
            position = spawnPos,
            rotation = {rot.x, rot.y, rot.z},
            scale = {1, 1, 1},
            sound = false
        })
        
        -- Set custom card data
        -- Image used for FRONT and BACK (back fixed URL)
        card.setCustomObject({
            face = objData.url,
            back = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/10150457896268543582/4CCABB00FE4C2A65FF2A5893F5F30471FC0FD9A9/"
        })
        card.setName(objData.name)
    end
end

function none() end

function onload()
    self.interactable = false
    self.gizmo_selectable = false
    createButtons()
end

-- group offset for positioning all buttons together
buttonGroupOffset = {x = -32, y = 0.0, z = -35.5}
-- group scale for sizing/spacing all buttons together
buttonGroupScale = 1.5

local function scaled(v)
    return math.max(1, math.floor((v or 0) * buttonGroupScale))
end

local function addOffset(pos)
    return { (pos[1] or 0) * (buttonGroupScale or 1) + (buttonGroupOffset.x or 0), (pos[2] or 0) * (buttonGroupScale or 1) + (buttonGroupOffset.y or 0), (pos[3] or 0) * (buttonGroupScale or 1) + (buttonGroupOffset.z or 0) }
end

function setButtonGroupOffset(x, y, z)
    buttonGroupOffset = { x = x or 0, y = y or 0, z = z or 0 }
    createButtons()
end

function setButtonGroupScale(s)
    buttonGroupScale = s or 1.0
    createButtons()
end

function createButtons()
    if self.clearButtons then self.clearButtons() end

    self.createButton({
        label = "Table Style:",
        position = addOffset({0, 0.2, 0}),
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        width = scaled(1600), height = scaled(400), font_size = scaled(250),
        color = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1}, font_color = {1,1,1,1},
        click_function = "nop", function_owner = self
    })

    self.createButton({
        label = "Planet View",
        position = addOffset({0, 0.2, -0.8}),
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        width = scaled(1400), height = scaled(400), font_size = scaled(200),
        color = {0, 0, 0, 1}, font_color = {1,1,1,1},
        click_function = "setPlanetView", function_owner = self
    })

    self.createButton({
        label = "Clean",
        position = addOffset({0, 0.2, -1.6}),
        rotation = {0, 180, 0},
        width = scaled(1200), height = scaled(400), font_size = scaled(200),
        color = {0, 0, 0, 1}, font_color = {1,1,1,1},
        click_function = "setCleanView", function_owner = self
    })
end

function nop(obj, player_clicker_color)
    -- nonfunctional label button
end

local function readTint(tint)
    local r = tint.r or tint[1] or 1
    local g = tint.g or tint[2] or 1
    local b = tint.b or tint[3] or 1
    local a = tint.a or tint[4] or 1
    return r, g, b, a
end

function setPlanetView(obj, player_clicker_color)
    local tint = (self.getColorTint and self.getColorTint()) or {r=1,g=1,b=1,a=1}
    local r,g,b = readTint(tint)
    self.setColorTint({r=r, g=g, b=b, a=0})
    -- make the PLANET object visible
    local planet = getObjectFromGUID("4603f5")
    if planet and planet.setColorTint then
        local pr,pg,pb,pa = readTint(planet.getColorTint and planet.getColorTint() or {r=1,g=1,b=1,a=1})
        planet.setColorTint({r=pr, g=pg, b=pb, a=1})
    else
        print("Cannot find PLANET object (GUID 4603f5) to set visible")
    end

        print("Cannot set background to Clean View")
    end
end

-----------------------------------------------

-- Mode state

currentMode = MODE.none

-- Layout configuration

depTogglePosition = nil

MODE_BUTTON_Y = 1.5

function onLoad()
	createButtons()
	createModeButtons()

end

function createButtons()
	local y = 1.5

	local function createButtonAndStore(def)
		self.createButton(def)
		BUTTON_POSITIONS[def.index] = def.position
	end

	local function vecFromArray(v)
		return {x = v[1], y = v[2], z = v[3]}
	end

	local function vecToArray(v)
		return {v.x, v.y, v.z}
	end

	-- Top center: Random Scenario (use configurable topRowX)
	createButtonAndStore({
		index = BTN.topRandom,
		label = formatLabel("Random Scenario"),
		click_function = "randomScenario",

		position = {topRowX, y, topRowZ},
		width = 2300, height = 600, font_size = 240,
		color = {0,0,0}, font_color = {1,1,1}
	})

	-- Compute group and random columns separately so they can be spaced differently
	local groupCols = {
		groupsBaseX - (groupsSpacing * 2.0),
		groupsBaseX - (groupsSpacing * 1.0),
		groupsBaseX,
		groupsBaseX + (groupsSpacing * 1.0),
		groupsBaseX + (groupsSpacing * 2.0),
	}
	local randomCols = {
		randomBaseX - (randomSpacing * 2.0),
		randomBaseX - (randomSpacing * 1.0),
		randomBaseX,
		randomBaseX + (randomSpacing * 1.0),
		randomBaseX + (randomSpacing * 2.0),
	}

	-- Deployment Type group
	createArrowAndLabelGroup(BTN.dep_left, BTN.dep_main, BTN.dep_right, BTN.dep_random,
		groupCols[1], randomCols[1], y, "depPrev", "depNext", "depRandom")

	-- Approach Type group
	createArrowAndLabelGroup(BTN.approach_left, BTN.approach_main, BTN.approach_right, BTN.approach_random,
		groupCols[2], randomCols[2], y, "approachPrev", "approachNext", "approachRandom")

	-- Layout group
	createArrowAndLabelGroup(BTN.layout_left, BTN.layout_main, BTN.layout_right, BTN.layout_random,
		groupCols[3], randomCols[3], y, "layoutPrev", "layoutNext", "layoutRandom")

	-- Variants group
	createArrowAndLabelGroup(BTN.var_left, BTN.var_main, BTN.var_right, BTN.var_random,

	-- Deployment toggle button (create last so existing indices are preserved)
	depTogglePosition = {groupCols[1] - arrowOffset - depToggleOffset, y, groupsZ}
	self.createButton({

		label = "",
		click_function = "toggleDeploymentZones",

		color = {0,0,0}, font_color = {1,1,1}

	-- Scenery removal buttons (always visible)

	local blueButtonPos = vecToArray(self.positionToLocal(vecFromArray(SCENERY_BUTTON_BLUE_POS)))

	self.createButton({
		index = BTN.scenery_done_blue,
		label = "Done Placing Scenery\n(Remove)",
		click_function = "removeBlueScenery",
		function_owner = self,
		position = HIDDEN_BUTTON_POS,
		rotation = {0, -90, 0},
		width = SCENERY_BUTTON_WIDTH, height = SCENERY_BUTTON_HEIGHT, font_size = SCENERY_BUTTON_FONT,
		color = {0,0,0}, font_color = {1,1,1}
	})

	self.editButton({index = BTN.scenery_done_red, position = redButtonPos})
	self.editButton({index = BTN.scenery_done_blue, position = blueButtonPos})
end

function createModeButtons()
	local posBuilder = {-MODE_BUTTON_SPACING, MODE_BUTTON_Y, MODE_BUTTON_Z}

function createArrowAndLabelGroup(idxLeft, idxMain, idxRight, idxRandom, mainX, randomX, y, leftFn, rightFn, randFn)
	-- left arrow (part of the groups row)
	self.createButton({
		index = idxLeft,
		label = "<",
		click_function = leftFn,

	-- main label (placeholder) - part of the groups row (same Z as arrows)
	self.createButton({
		index = idxMain,
		label = "",
		click_function = "noop",
		function_owner = self,
		position = {mainX, y, groupsZ},
		width = mainWidth, height = 720, font_size = 216,
	})
	BUTTON_POSITIONS[idxMain] = {mainX, y, groupsZ}

	-- right arrow (part of the groups row)

		index = idxRight,
		label = ">",
		click_function = rightFn,

		width = 520, height = 720, font_size = 350,
	})
	BUTTON_POSITIONS[idxRight] = {mainX + arrowOffset, y, groupsZ}

	-- random button row (separate X spacing and Z)

		index = idxRandom,
		label = "Random",
		click_function = randFn,
		function_owner = self,
		position = {randomX, y, randomZ},
		width = randomWidth, height = 300, font_size = 162,
		color = {0,0,0}, font_color = {1,1,1}
	})
	BUTTON_POSITIONS[idxRandom] = {randomX, y, randomZ}
end

-- No-op click function for main labels (they do nothing for now)
function noop() end

-- Helpers
function clampIndex(i, list)
	if i < 1 then return #list end
	if i > #list then return 1 end
	return i
end

function refreshAllLabels()
	updateLabel(BTN.dep_main, deploymentTypes[selected.dep])
	updateLabel(BTN.approach_main, approachTypes[selected.approach])
	updateLabel(BTN.layout_main, layouts[selected.layout])
	updateLabel(BTN.var_main, variants[selected.variant])
	updateLabel(BTN.obj_main, objectives[selected.objective])
end

function updateLabel(index, text)
	self.editButton({index = index, label = formatLabel(text)})
end

function showSceneryButton(side)
	if side == "red" then
		self.editButton({
			index = BTN.scenery_done_red,
			label = "Done Placing Scenery\n(Remove)",
			position = self.positionToLocal({x = SCENERY_BUTTON_RED_POS[1], y = SCENERY_BUTTON_RED_POS[2], z = SCENERY_BUTTON_RED_POS[3]}),
			rotation = {0, 90, 0},
		})
	elseif side == "blue" then
		self.editButton({
			index = BTN.scenery_done_blue,
			label = "Done Placing Scenery\n(Remove)",
			position = self.positionToLocal({x = SCENERY_BUTTON_BLUE_POS[1], y = SCENERY_BUTTON_BLUE_POS[2], z = SCENERY_BUTTON_BLUE_POS[3]}),
			rotation = {0, -90, 0},
		})

end

function hideSceneryButton(side)
	if side == "red" then
		self.editButton({index = BTN.scenery_done_red, label = "", position = HIDDEN_BUTTON_POS})
	elseif side == "blue" then
		self.editButton({index = BTN.scenery_done_blue, label = "", position = HIDDEN_BUTTON_POS})
	end
end

function hideSceneryButtons()
	hideSceneryButton("red")
	hideSceneryButton("blue")
end

function setBuilderUIVisible(visible)

		BTN.topRandom,
		BTN.dep_left, BTN.dep_main, BTN.dep_right, BTN.dep_random,
		BTN.approach_left, BTN.approach_main, BTN.approach_right, BTN.approach_random,
		BTN.layout_left, BTN.layout_main, BTN.layout_right, BTN.layout_random,
		BTN.var_left, BTN.var_main, BTN.var_right, BTN.var_random,
		BTN.obj_left, BTN.obj_main, BTN.obj_right, BTN.obj_random,
		BTN.dep_toggle,
		BTN.scenery_done_red,
		BTN.scenery_done_blue,
		BTN.back_builder,
	}
	if visible then
		self.editButton({index = BTN.topRandom, label = formatLabel("Random Scenario"), position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.topRandom]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.dep_left, label = "<", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.dep_left]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.dep_right, label = ">", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.dep_right]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.approach_left, label = "<", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.approach_left]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.approach_right, label = ">", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.approach_right]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.layout_left, label = "<", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.layout_left]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.layout_right, label = ">", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.layout_right]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.var_left, label = "<", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.var_left]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.var_right, label = ">", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.var_right]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.obj_left, label = "<", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.obj_left]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.obj_right, label = ">", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.obj_right]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.dep_random, label = "Random", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.dep_random]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.approach_random, label = "Random", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.approach_random]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.layout_random, label = "Random", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.layout_random]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.var_random, label = "Random", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.var_random]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.obj_random, label = "Random", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.obj_random]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.dep_main, label = "", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.dep_main]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.approach_main, label = "", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.approach_main]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.layout_main, label = "", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.layout_main]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.var_main, label = "", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.var_main]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.obj_main, label = "", position = BUTTON_POSITIONS[BTN.obj_main]})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.back_builder, label = "Back", position = BACK_BUTTON_POS})
		refreshAllLabels()
		updateDeploymentToggleButton()
	else
		for _, idx in ipairs(indices) do
			self.editButton({index = idx, label = "", position = HIDDEN_BUTTON_POS})
		end
	end
end

function setModeButtonsVisible(visible)
	local posBuilder = {-MODE_BUTTON_SPACING, MODE_BUTTON_Y, MODE_BUTTON_Z}
	local posPremade = {MODE_BUTTON_SPACING, MODE_BUTTON_Y, MODE_BUTTON_Z}
	if visible then
		self.editButton({index = BTN.mode_builder, label = formatLabel("Scenario Builder"), position = posBuilder})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.mode_premade, label = formatLabel("Premade Scenarios"), position = posPremade})
	else
		self.editButton({index = BTN.mode_builder, label = "", position = HIDDEN_BUTTON_POS})
		self.editButton({index = BTN.mode_premade, label = "", position = HIDDEN_BUTTON_POS})
	end
end

function enterScenarioBuilder(obj, player_color)
	currentMode = MODE.builder
	setModeButtonsVisible(false)
	setBuilderUIVisible(true)
end

function enterPremadeScenarios(obj, player_color)
	currentMode = MODE.premade
	setModeButtonsVisible(false)
	setBuilderUIVisible(false)
	enablePremadeScenarios()
end

function enablePremadeScenarios()
	local premade = nil
	if PREMADE_OBJECT_GUID and PREMADE_OBJECT_GUID ~= "" then
		premade = getObjectFromGUID(PREMADE_OBJECT_GUID)
	end
	if premade == nil then
		print("Error: Could not find premade scenarios object.")
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		premade.call("enablePremadeMode")
	end)
end

function clearAllBuilderObjects()
	clearDeploymentObjects()
	clearLayoutObjects()
	clearApproachObjects()
	clearVariantObjects()
	clearObjectiveObjects()
	clearSceneryObjects()
end

function backToModeHub(obj, player_color)
	clearAllBuilderObjects()
	selected = {dep = 1, approach = 1, layout = 1, variant = 1, objective = 1}
	deploymentZonesHidden = false
	currentMode = MODE.none
	setBuilderUIVisible(false)
	hideSceneryButtons()
	setModeButtonsVisible(true)
end

function returnToModeHubFromPremade()
	currentMode = MODE.none
	setModeButtonsVisible(true)
end

function updateDeploymentToggleButton()
	if selected.dep == 1 then
		deploymentZonesHidden = false
		hideDeploymentToggleButton()
		return
	end
	showDeploymentToggleButton()
end

function showDeploymentToggleButton()
	local label = deploymentZonesHidden and "Show Deployment Zones" or "Hide Deployment Zones"
	self.editButton({
		index = BTN.dep_toggle,
		label = formatLabel(label),
		position = depTogglePosition,
		width = mainWidth, height = 720, font_size = 216,
		color = {0,0,0}, font_color = {1,1,1}
	})
end

function hideDeploymentToggleButton()
	self.editButton({
		index = BTN.dep_toggle,
		label = "",
		position = HIDDEN_BUTTON_POS,
	})
end

function toggleDeploymentZones(obj, player_color)
	deploymentZonesHidden = not deploymentZonesHidden
	applyDeploymentZoneVisibility()
	showDeploymentToggleButton()
end

-- Format labels: if exactly two words, insert a newline between them
function formatLabel(text)
	if not text then return "" end
	if string.find(text, "\n") then return text end
	local parts = {}
	for w in string.gmatch(text, "%S+") do table.insert(parts, w) end
	if #parts == 2 then
		return parts[1] .. "\n" .. parts[2]
	elseif #parts >= 3 then
		-- Put each word on its own line for three-or-more word labels
		return table.concat(parts, "\n")
	end
	return text
end

-- Deployment handlers
function depPrev(obj, player_color)
	selected.dep = clampIndex(selected.dep - 1, deploymentTypes)
	updateLabel(BTN.dep_main, deploymentTypes[selected.dep])
    updateDeployment()
end

function depNext(obj, player_color)
	selected.dep = clampIndex(selected.dep + 1, deploymentTypes)
	updateLabel(BTN.dep_main, deploymentTypes[selected.dep])
    updateDeployment()
end

function depRandom(obj, player_color)
	if #deploymentTypes <= 1 then return end
	selected.dep = math.random(2, #deploymentTypes)
	updateLabel(BTN.dep_main, deploymentTypes[selected.dep])
    updateDeployment()
end

-- Approach Type handlers
function approachPrev(obj, player_color)
	selected.approach = clampIndex(selected.approach - 1, approachTypes)
	updateLabel(BTN.approach_main, approachTypes[selected.approach])
	updateApproachType()
end

function approachNext(obj, player_color)
	selected.approach = clampIndex(selected.approach + 1, approachTypes)
	updateLabel(BTN.approach_main, approachTypes[selected.approach])
	updateApproachType()
end

function approachRandom(obj, player_color)
	if #approachTypes <= 1 then return end
	selected.approach = math.random(2, #approachTypes)
	updateLabel(BTN.approach_main, approachTypes[selected.approach])
	updateApproachType()
end

	updateLayout()
end

function layoutNext(obj, player_color)
	selected.layout = clampIndex(selected.layout + 1, layouts)
	updateLabel(BTN.layout_main, layouts[selected.layout])
	updateLayout()
end

function layoutRandom(obj, player_color)

	updateLayout()

-- Variant handlers
function variantPrev(obj, player_color)
	selected.variant = clampIndex(selected.variant - 1, variants)
	updateLabel(BTN.var_main, variants[selected.variant])
	updateVariant()

function spawnDeploymentObject(name, side, pos, rotOverride, tintOverride)
    -- Validate name
    local asset = DEPLOYMENT_ASSETS[name]
    if not asset then
        print("Error: Unknown deployment object " .. tostring(name))
        return
    end

    -- Determine rotation and color based on Side
    local rot = {0, 0, 0}
	local tint = COLOR_LEFT
    if side == "Right" then
        rot = {0, 180, 0}
        tint = COLOR_RIGHT
    end

    -- Overrides
    if rotOverride then rot = rotOverride end
	if tintOverride then tint = tintOverride end

    -- Spawn the object
    local obj = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Model",
        position = pos,
        rotation = rot,
        scale = {1, 1, 1},
        sound = false,
        snap_to_grid = false,
    })

    -- Set Custom Object properties IMMEDIATELY
    obj.setCustomObject({
        mesh = asset,
        collider = DEPLOYMENT_COLLIDER,
        type = 0, -- Generic
        material = 3, -- Cardboard
    })
    
    -- Set additional properties
    obj.setName(name)
	obj.setColorTint(tint)
    obj.setLock(true)
	updateDeploymentZoneVisibilityForObject(obj)
    
    -- Track spawned object
    table.insert(spawnedObjects, obj)
end

function spawnDeploymentTile(imageUrl, position, rotation, scale)
	if not imageUrl then
		print("Error: Missing tile image URL")
		return
	end

	local obj = spawnObject({
		type = "Custom_Tile",
		position = position,
		rotation = rotation,
		scale = scale,
		sound = false,
		snap_to_grid = false,
	})

	obj.setCustomObject({
		image = imageUrl,
		type = 0, -- Square/Rectangle
	})
	obj.setLock(true)
	updateDeploymentZoneVisibilityForObject(obj)

	table.insert(spawnedObjects, obj)
end

function updateDeploymentZoneVisibilityForObject(obj)
	if obj == nil then return end
	if obj.isDestroyed and obj.isDestroyed() then return end
	if deploymentZonesHidden then
		obj.attachInvisibleHider("deploymentZones", true)
	else
		obj.attachInvisibleHider("deploymentZones", false)
	end
end

function cloneSceneryFromGUID(guid, position, label)
	if not guid or guid == "" then
		print("Warning: Missing GUID for " .. tostring(label))
		return nil
	end
	local source = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
	if not source then
		print("Error: Could not find source for " .. tostring(label) .. " (" .. tostring(guid) .. ")")
		return nil
	end

	local clone = source.clone({
		position = {0, 0, 0},
		snap_to_grid = false,
	})
	if clone == nil then

	end

	Wait.frames(function()
		if clone ~= nil and not clone.isDestroyed() then
			clone.setPosition(position)
			clone.setRotation({0, 0, 0})
			clone.setLock(true)
		end
	end, 1)

	return clone
end

function cloneFromGUID(guid, position, label)
	if not guid or guid == "" then
		print("Warning: Missing GUID for " .. tostring(label))
		return nil
	end
	local source = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
	if not source then
		print("Error: Could not find source for " .. tostring(label) .. " (" .. tostring(guid) .. ")")
		return nil
	end

	local clone = source.clone({
		position = {0, 0, 0},
		snap_to_grid = false,
	})
	if clone == nil then
		return nil
	end

	-- clone() placement is not reliably absolute. Force an exact world position
	-- one frame later, then lock the object in place.
	Wait.frames(function()
		if clone ~= nil and not clone.isDestroyed() then
			clone.setPosition(position)
			clone.setLock(true)
		end
	end, 1)

	-- Track spawned clone for cleanup.
	table.insert(spawnedLayoutObjects, clone)
	return clone
end

	local source = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
	if not source then
		print("Error: Could not find source for " .. tostring(label) .. " (" .. tostring(guid) .. ")")

	local clone = source.clone({

	if clone == nil then

	end

			if rotation and type(rotation) == "table" then
				clone.setRotation(rotation)
			else

function findAndModifyShip3DModel(meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale)
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    if not attachments or #attachments == 0 then
        return false
    end

    if modelAttachmentIndex ~= nil then
        local obj = self.removeAttachment(modelAttachmentIndex)

        if obj then
            local data = obj.getData()
            if data and data.Nickname == SHIP_CHILD_NICK then
                if not Model3DAvailable and savedModelScale == nil then
                    savedModelScale = obj.getScale()
                end

                obj.setCustomObject({
                    mesh = meshUrl,
                    diffuse = diffuseUrl
                })

                if targetScale then
                    obj.setScale(targetScale)
                end

                self.addAttachment(obj)
                return true
            else
                self.addAttachment(obj)
            end
        end
        modelAttachmentIndex = nil
    end

    for i = 0, #attachments - 1 do
        local obj = self.removeAttachment(i)

        if obj then
            local objType = obj.type or "unknown"
            local data = obj.getData()
            local nickname = data and data.Nickname or ""

            if nickname == SHIP_CHILD_NICK or objType == "Custom_Model" then
                if not Model3DAvailable and savedModelScale == nil then
                    savedModelScale = obj.getScale()
                end

                local success, err = pcall(function()
                    obj.setCustomObject({
                        mesh = meshUrl,
                        diffuse = diffuseUrl
                    })
                end)

                if success then
                    if targetScale then
                        obj.setScale(targetScale)
                    end

                    modelAttachmentIndex = i
                end

                self.addAttachment(obj)
                return success
            else
                self.addAttachment(obj)
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

function apply3DModelState()
    local meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale

    if Model3DAvailable then
        meshUrl = TARGET_MESH_URL
        diffuseUrl = TARGET_DIFFUSE_URL

        if savedModelScale then
            targetScale = savedModelScale
            savedModelScale = nil
        else
            targetScale = nil
        end
    else
        meshUrl = PLACEHOLDER_MESH_URL
        diffuseUrl = PLACEHOLDER_DIFFUSE_URL
        targetScale = {x = PLACEHOLDER_SCALE, y = PLACEHOLDER_SCALE, z = PLACEHOLDER_SCALE}
    end

    local success = findAndModifyShip3DModel(meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale)

    if success then
        print("SUCCESS: 3D Model toggled!")

        Wait.frames(function()
            RefreshShip()
        end, 2)
    end
end

    local attachments = self.getAttachments()

    local detachedObjects = {}

    for i = 0, #attachments - 1 do

        if obj then

    end

    for i = #detachedObjects, 1, -1 do

function generateFiringArcLines()
    cachedFiringArcLines = {}

    local forward = Vector(0,0,1)
    local MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS = true
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then forward = Vector(1,0,0) end

    local arcLineLength = 16 * UNIT_SCALE

    local function addAngleLines(angleDeg, lineColor)
        local rotRight = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', angleDeg)
        local rotLeft = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', -angleDeg)

        local p1 = rotRight * arcLineLength
        local p2 = rotRight * (-arcLineLength)
        p1.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p2.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p1, p2 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })

        local p3 = rotLeft * arcLineLength
        local p4 = rotLeft * (-arcLineLength)
        p3.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p4.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p3, p4 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })
    end

    addAngleLines(45, {0, 0, 0.6})
    addAngleLines(11, {0.6, 0, 0})
end

function generateScanLines()
    cachedScanLines = {}
    local circleColor = {0.5, 1, 0.5}

    local scanRadius = ShipScan * UNIT_SCALE

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * scanRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * scanRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedScanLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.1
    })
end

function generateSignatureLines()
    cachedSignatureLines = {}

    if not state.sigAuraShown or state.sig == 0 then
        return
    end

    local circleColor = {0.8, 0, 0}

    local sigRadius = state.sig * UNIT_SCALE

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * sigRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * sigRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedSignatureLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.15
    })
end

        end
        if cachedScanLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
    end

    if state.sigAuraShown and cachedSignatureLines then
        for _, l in ipairs(cachedSignatureLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
    end

    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function onLoad(save)
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    local savedShipID = data.shipID or ""
    local isNewShipType = (savedShipID ~= SHIP_ID)

    if isNewShipType then
        print("New station type detected: " .. SHIP_ID .. " - Using script default stats")
    end

    if isNewShipType then
        -- Keep defaults
    else
        Shiphealth = data.Shiphealth or Shiphealth
        ShipbaseSize = data.ShipbaseSize or ShipbaseSize
        Shipcost = data.Shipcost or Shipcost
        ShipScan = data.ShipScan or ShipScan
        Signature = data.Signature or Signature

        if data.SHIPCardURL then
            SHIPCardURL = data.SHIPCardURL
        end
        if data.FIXED_IMAGE_URL then
            FIXED_IMAGE_URL = data.FIXED_IMAGE_URL
        end
    end

    local targetScale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
    local currentScale = self.getScale()

    if currentScale.x ~= targetScale then
        self.setScale({targetScale, targetScale, targetScale})
        print("Station scaled to " .. targetScale .. " based on " .. ShipbaseSize .. "mm base")
    end

    recoverState(data)

    if isNewShipType then
        state.health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = state.base or {}
        state.base.size = ShipbaseSize
    end

    end

    generateScanLines()

    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    RefreshModelShape()
    RecalculateSignature()
    updateAuraVisuals()

    if data.Model3DAvailable ~= nil then

    end

    end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
        state.sig = originalData.sig or Signature
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    local conditionNames = {
        "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Silent_Running", "ShipCard", "Status", "TargetSig"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}

    state.statusMenuOpen = state.statusMenuOpen or false
    state.shipCardEditMode = state.shipCardEditMode or false
end

function SetInitialState(newState)
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig;
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    local current = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    local target = current + (params.amount or 0)

    state.conditions.Aura = (target > 0) and 1 or 0

    if state.conditions.Aura > 0 then
        generateFiringArcLines()
        generateScanLines()
    end

    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus

    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)

    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig

        if state.sigAuraShown then
            generateSignatureLines()
            updateAuraVisuals()
            print("Signature updated to: " .. state.sig .. " inches")
        end
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1
        generateSignatureLines()
        print("Showing Station Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        cachedSignatureLines = nil
    end
    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0
    if params.amount == 0 then
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    state.base.color = {
        r = 190/255,
        g = 221/255,
        b = 255/255,
        a = 35/255
    }

    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        local alpha = baseColor.a or 1.0

        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            self.setColorTint({
                r = baseColor.r,
                g = baseColor.g,
                b = baseColor.b,
                a = alpha
            })
        else
            self.setColorTint({
                r = baseColor.r,
                g = baseColor.g,
                b = baseColor.b,
                a = alpha
            })
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if UIStatus[player.color] then
            local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation()
            if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end
            local targetRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180
            targetRotation = targetRotation % 360
            UIStatus[player.color].rotation = targetRotation
        end
    end

    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    if not state or not state.conditions or not Conditions then return end

    local conditionData = Conditions[name]
    if not conditionData then
        print("SyncCondition: Unknown condition '" .. tostring(name) .. "'")
        return
    end

    for _, color in ipairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0

        local isActive
        if name == "Status" then
            isActive = HasCriticalStatus()
            state.conditions.Status = isActive and 1 or 0
        else
            isActive = conditionValue > 0
        end

        local imageUrl = isActive and (conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url) or conditionData.url

        local colorBlock
        if currentUIMode == 0 then
            colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. "FF"
        else
            colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. (isActive and "FF" or "22")
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and "true" or "false",
            text = tostring(conditionValue)
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        ApplyActivatedLockState()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation()
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end

    local targetRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180

    targetRotation = targetRotation % 360

    local currentRotation = UIStatus[player.color].rotation
    if currentRotation == nil then
        currentRotation = targetRotation
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = currentRotation
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -currentRotation)
        return
    end

    local angleDiff = targetRotation - currentRotation

    if angleDiff > 180 then
        angleDiff = angleDiff - 360
    elseif angleDiff < -180 then
        angleDiff = angleDiff + 360
    end

    if math.abs(angleDiff) > 0.5 then
        local smoothSpeed = 40
        local smoothFactor = math.min(1, Time.delta_time * smoothSpeed)

        local newRotation = currentRotation + (angleDiff * smoothFactor)

        newRotation = newRotation % 360
        if newRotation < 0 then newRotation = newRotation + 360 end

        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -newRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = newRotation
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""

    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local shipCardPanel = ""
        if state.conditions.ShipCard > 0 then
            shipCardPanel = generateShipCardPanel()
        end

        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color, shipCardPanel)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end

    local fixedImagePanel = ""
    if not Model3DAvailable then
        fixedImagePanel = generateFixedImagePanel("Blue")
    end

    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]]
        .. panelContent
        .. fixedImagePanel
        .. [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

-- SPACE STATION SCRIPT V1.0 28/01/2026

-- Variables That Change Per Station

local TARGET_DIFFUSE_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/14483890135573600795/9622EC8F940C3CCA7EAE7CF86AC358A2EBA6716E/" -- Station 3D Texture

local PLACEHOLDER_DIFFUSE_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/14483890135573600795/9622EC8F940C3CCA7EAE7CF86AC358A2EBA6716E/"

local SHIP_CHILD_NICK = "SHIP3dmodel"
local modelAttachmentIndex = nil

-- Scale management
local savedModelScale = nil
local PLACEHOLDER_SCALE = 0.001

function findAndModifyShip3DModel(meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale)
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    if not attachments or #attachments == 0 then
        return false
    end

    if modelAttachmentIndex ~= nil then
        local obj = self.removeAttachment(modelAttachmentIndex)

        if obj then
            local data = obj.getData()
            if data and data.Nickname == SHIP_CHILD_NICK then
                if not Model3DAvailable and savedModelScale == nil then
                    savedModelScale = obj.getScale()
                end

                obj.setCustomObject({
                    mesh = meshUrl,
                    diffuse = diffuseUrl
                })

                if targetScale then
                    obj.setScale(targetScale)
                end

                self.addAttachment(obj)
                return true
            else
                self.addAttachment(obj)
            end
        end
        modelAttachmentIndex = nil
    end

    for i = 0, #attachments - 1 do
        local obj = self.removeAttachment(i)

        if obj then
            local objType = obj.type or "unknown"
            local data = obj.getData()
            local nickname = data and data.Nickname or ""

            if nickname == SHIP_CHILD_NICK or objType == "Custom_Model" then
                if not Model3DAvailable and savedModelScale == nil then
                    savedModelScale = obj.getScale()
                end

                local success, err = pcall(function()
                    obj.setCustomObject({
                        mesh = meshUrl,
                        diffuse = diffuseUrl
                    })
                end)

                if success then
                    if targetScale then
                        obj.setScale(targetScale)
                    end

                    modelAttachmentIndex = i
                end

                self.addAttachment(obj)
                return success
            else
                self.addAttachment(obj)
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

function apply3DModelState()
    local meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale

    if Model3DAvailable then
        meshUrl = TARGET_MESH_URL
        diffuseUrl = TARGET_DIFFUSE_URL

        if savedModelScale then
            targetScale = savedModelScale
            savedModelScale = nil
        else
            targetScale = nil
        end
    else
        meshUrl = PLACEHOLDER_MESH_URL
        diffuseUrl = PLACEHOLDER_DIFFUSE_URL
        targetScale = {x = PLACEHOLDER_SCALE, y = PLACEHOLDER_SCALE, z = PLACEHOLDER_SCALE}
    end

    local success = findAndModifyShip3DModel(meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale)

    if success then
        print("SUCCESS: 3D Model toggled!")

        Wait.frames(function()
            RefreshShip()
        end, 2)
    end
end

function debugListAllAttachments()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()

    if not attachments or #attachments == 0 then
        return
    end

    local detachedObjects = {}

    for i = 0, #attachments - 1 do
        local obj = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if obj then
            table.insert(detachedObjects, obj)
        end
    end

    for i = #detachedObjects, 1, -1 do
        self.addAttachment(detachedObjects[i])
    end
end

function safeGetAttachments(obj)

function InitFromSpawner(params)
    print("InitFromSpawner RECEIVED:")
    for k, v in pairs(params) do
        print("  " .. tostring(k) .. " = " .. tostring(v))
    end

    if not params then
        print("InitFromSpawner: params is nil")
        return
    end

    state = state or {}
    state.health = state.health or {}
    state.base = state.base or {}

    if params.shipID then SHIP_ID = tostring(params.shipID) end
    if params.baseSize then ShipbaseSize = tonumber(params.baseSize) or ShipbaseSize end
    if params.health then Shiphealth = tonumber(params.health) or Shiphealth end
    if params.sig then Signature = tonumber(params.sig) or Signature end
    if params.points then Shipcost = tonumber(params.points) or Shipcost end
    if params.scan then ShipScan = tonumber(params.scan) or ShipScan end

    if params.cardFrontImage then SHIPCardURL = tostring(params.cardFrontImage) end
    if params.modelImage then FIXED_IMAGE_URL = tostring(params.modelImage) end

    if params.has3DModel ~= nil then
        Model3DExists = params.has3DModel
        print("  3D Model Available: " .. tostring(Model3DExists))
    end

    if params.name then self.setName(tostring(params.name)) end
    if params.faction then self.setDescription("Faction: " .. tostring(params.faction)) end

    state.health.current = Shiphealth
    state.health.max = Shiphealth

    state.base.size = ShipbaseSize
    state.sig = Signature
    SignatureStorage = SignatureStorage or Signature

    if getScaleFromBaseSize then
        local targetScale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
        if targetScale then
            self.setScale({targetScale, targetScale, targetScale})
            if setUIHeightsFromScale then setUIHeightsFromScale(targetScale) end
        end
    end

    if rebuildAssets then rebuildAssets() end

    if ui then self.UI.setXml(ui()) end

    if RefreshModelShape then RefreshModelShape() end
    if RecalculateSignature then RecalculateSignature() end
    if updateAuraVisuals then updateAuraVisuals() end

    print("InitFromSpawner OK: " .. self.getName())
end

function generateFiringArcLines()
    cachedFiringArcLines = {}

    local forward = Vector(0,0,1)
    local MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS = true
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then forward = Vector(1,0,0) end

    local arcLineLength = 16 * UNIT_SCALE

    local function addAngleLines(angleDeg, lineColor)
        local rotRight = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', angleDeg)
        local rotLeft = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', -angleDeg)

        local p1 = rotRight * arcLineLength
        local p2 = rotRight * (-arcLineLength)
        p1.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p2.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p1, p2 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })

        local p3 = rotLeft * arcLineLength
        local p4 = rotLeft * (-arcLineLength)
        p3.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p4.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p3, p4 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })
    end

    addAngleLines(45, {0, 0, 0.6})
    addAngleLines(11, {0.6, 0, 0})
end

function generateScanLines()
    cachedScanLines = {}
    local circleColor = {0.5, 1, 0.5}

    local scanRadius = ShipScan * UNIT_SCALE

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * scanRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * scanRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedScanLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.1
    })
end

function generateSignatureLines()
    cachedSignatureLines = {}

    if not state.sigAuraShown or state.sig == 0 then
        return
    end

    local circleColor = {0.8, 0, 0}

    local sigRadius = state.sig * UNIT_SCALE

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * sigRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * sigRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedSignatureLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.15
    })
end

function updateAuraVisuals()
    local finalLines = {}

    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
    end

    if state.sigAuraShown and cachedSignatureLines then
        for _, l in ipairs(cachedSignatureLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
    end

    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function onLoad(save)
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    local savedShipID = data.shipID or ""
    local isNewShipType = (savedShipID ~= SHIP_ID)

    if isNewShipType then
        print("New station type detected: " .. SHIP_ID .. " - Using script default stats")
    end

    if isNewShipType then
        -- Keep defaults
    else
        Shiphealth = data.Shiphealth or Shiphealth
        ShipbaseSize = data.ShipbaseSize or ShipbaseSize
        Shipcost = data.Shipcost or Shipcost
        ShipScan = data.ShipScan or ShipScan
        Signature = data.Signature or Signature

        if data.SHIPCardURL then
            SHIPCardURL = data.SHIPCardURL
        end
        if data.FIXED_IMAGE_URL then
            FIXED_IMAGE_URL = data.FIXED_IMAGE_URL
        end
    end

    local targetScale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
    local currentScale = self.getScale()

    if currentScale.x ~= targetScale then
        self.setScale({targetScale, targetScale, targetScale})
        print("Station scaled to " .. targetScale .. " based on " .. ShipbaseSize .. "mm base")
    end

    recoverState(data)

    if isNewShipType then
        state.health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = state.base or {}
        state.base.size = ShipbaseSize
    end

    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    if isNewShipType then
        SignatureStorage = Signature
    else
        SignatureStorage = data.baseSignature or state.sig or Signature
    end

    generateFiringArcLines()
    generateScanLines()

    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    RefreshModelShape()
    RecalculateSignature()
    updateAuraVisuals()

    if data.Model3DAvailable ~= nil then
        Model3DAvailable = data.Model3DAvailable
    end
    if data.savedModelScale then
        savedModelScale = data.savedModelScale
    end

    modelAttachmentIndex = nil

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle 3D Model", function()
        if not Model3DExists then
            local modelName = self.getName()
            print("[FF4444]═══════════════════════════════════════════[-]")
            print("[FFAA00]Sadly, no one has scanned a model for " .. modelName .. " yet.[-]")
            print("[FFAA00]If you can, please contact the DFC TTS team and let them know![-]")
            print("[FF4444]═══════════════════════════════════════════[-]")
            return
        end

        Model3DAvailable = not Model3DAvailable
        print("=== TOGGLING 3D MODEL ===")
        print("New state: " .. tostring(Model3DAvailable))
        apply3DModelState()
    end)

    Wait.frames(function()
        RefreshShip()
    end, 10)

    Wait.frames(function()
        apply3DModelState()
    end, 20)
end

function onSave()

    data.baseSignature = SignatureStorage

    data.Shiphealth = Shiphealth

    data.ShipScan = ShipScan
    data.Signature = Signature
    data.SHIPCardURL = SHIPCardURL
    data.FIXED_IMAGE_URL = FIXED_IMAGE_URL

function onUpdate()
    if not state or not state.conditions then return end

    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
        end
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
        state.sig = originalData.sig or Signature
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    local conditionNames = {
        "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Silent_Running", "ShipCard", "Status", "TargetSig"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}

    state.statusMenuOpen = state.statusMenuOpen or false
    state.shipCardEditMode = state.shipCardEditMode or false
end

function SetInitialState(newState)
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig;
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    local current = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    local target = current + (params.amount or 0)

    state.conditions.Aura = (target > 0) and 1 or 0

    if state.conditions.Aura > 0 then
        generateFiringArcLines()
        generateScanLines()
    end

    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus

    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)

    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig

        if state.sigAuraShown then
            generateSignatureLines()
            updateAuraVisuals()
            print("Signature updated to: " .. state.sig .. " inches")
        end
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1
        generateSignatureLines()
        print("Showing Station Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        cachedSignatureLines = nil
    end
    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0
    if params.amount == 0 then
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    state.base.color = {
        r = 190/255,
        g = 221/255,
        b = 255/255,
        a = 35/255
    }

    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        local alpha = baseColor.a or 1.0

        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            self.setColorTint({
                r = baseColor.r,
                g = baseColor.g,
                b = baseColor.b,
                a = alpha
            })
        else
            self.setColorTint({
                r = baseColor.r,
                g = baseColor.g,
                b = baseColor.b,
                a = alpha
            })
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end
