function calculatePlayerRotation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = player.getPointerRotation() - self.getRotation().y + 180;
    end
end

function Sync()
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if UIStatus[player.color] then
            local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation()
            if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end
            local targetRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180
            targetRotation = targetRotation % 360
            UIStatus[player.color].rotation = targetRotation
        end
    end

    self.UI.setXml(ui())
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    if not state or not state.conditions or not Conditions then return end

    local conditionData = Conditions[name]
    if not conditionData then
        print("SyncCondition: Unknown condition '" .. tostring(name) .. "'")
        return
    end

    for _, color in ipairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0

        local isActive
        if name == "Status" then
            isActive = HasCriticalStatus()
            state.conditions.Status = isActive and 1 or 0
        else
            isActive = conditionValue > 0
        end

        local imageUrl = isActive and (conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url) or conditionData.url

        local colorBlock
        if currentUIMode == 0 then
            colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. "FF"
        else
            colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. (isActive and "FF" or "22")
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and "true" or "false",
            text = tostring(conditionValue)
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        ApplyActivatedLockState()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;
end

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation()
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end

    local targetRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180

    targetRotation = targetRotation % 360

    local currentRotation = UIStatus[player.color].rotation
    if currentRotation == nil then
        currentRotation = targetRotation
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = currentRotation
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -currentRotation)
        return
    end

    local angleDiff = targetRotation - currentRotation

    if angleDiff > 180 then
        angleDiff = angleDiff - 360
    elseif angleDiff < -180 then
        angleDiff = angleDiff + 360
    end

    if math.abs(angleDiff) > 0.5 then
        local smoothSpeed = 40
        local smoothFactor = math.min(1, Time.delta_time * smoothSpeed)

        local newRotation = currentRotation + (angleDiff * smoothFactor)

        newRotation = newRotation % 360
        if newRotation < 0 then newRotation = newRotation + 360 end

        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -newRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = newRotation
    end
end

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""

    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local shipCardPanel = ""
        if state.conditions.ShipCard > 0 then
            shipCardPanel = generateShipCardPanel()
        end

        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color, shipCardPanel)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end

    local fixedImagePanel = ""
    if not Model3DAvailable then
        fixedImagePanel = generateFixedImagePanel("Blue")
    end

    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]]
        .. panelContent
        .. fixedImagePanel
        .. [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};

    assets[#assets + 1] = { name = "UIBackdrop", url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Assets/UI/SHIPUI/StationMenuUI.png" };
    assets[#assets + 1] = { name = "StatusDropdown", url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Assets/UI/SHIPUI/DropdownMenu.png" };

    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
        if value.active_url then
            assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName .. "_active", url = value.active_url };
        end
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color, additionalContent)
    if not UIStatus[color] then
        return ""
    end
    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local content = getUIContent(color)
    if not content then
        return ""
    end

    local extraContent = additionalContent or ""

    local result = string.format([[
        <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 %s' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
        %s
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], color, color, tostring(-rotation), content, extraContent)
    return result
end

    ]], id, width * UI_SCALE, height * UI_SCALE, position, name, HUDSingleConditionBodyRectangular(color, name, width * UI_SCALE, height * UI_SCALE) or "")
end

function HUDSingleConditionBodyRectangular(color, name, width, height)
    if not color or not name or not width or not height or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end

    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end

    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local isActive
    if name == "Status" then
        isActive = HasCriticalStatus()
    else
        isActive = conditionValue > 0
    end
    local imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url

    local colorBlock
    if currentUIMode == 0 then
        colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"
    else
        colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
    end

    local fontSize = math.floor(height * 0.85)
    local displayText = tostring(conditionValue)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
    ]],
    color, name, imageUrl, colorBlock, width, height,
    color, name, tostring(condition.stacks and isActive), fontSize, displayText, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function HUDConditions(color)
    if not color then return "" end

        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Spikes", LeftAlign+1.2, TopRow, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Aura", LeftAlign+2.2, TopRow, size),
        HUDSingleCondition(color, "Mode", LeftAlign+4, TopRow+0.2, size),
        HUDSingleConditionRectangular(color, "Activated", LeftAlign+4.5, TopRow-3.2, 55, 30),
        HUDSingleConditionRectangular(color, "Status", LeftAlign+1.16, TopRow-2.6, 120, 60),
    }

function HUDSingleCondition(color, name, x, y, size)
    if not color or not name or not x or not y or not size then
        return ""
    end
    local id = "ConditionFrame_" .. name
    local position = string.format("%s %s 0", ((x * (size + 4) * UI_SCALE) - (1.5 * size + 4) * UI_SCALE), y * ((size + 4) * UI_SCALE))

    return string.format([[
        <Panel id="%s" width="%d" height="%d" alignment='LowerLeft' position='%s' onClick='UI_Modify%s()' onMouseEnter='UI_ShowTooltip' onMouseExit='UI_HideTooltip'>
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], id, size * UI_SCALE, size * UI_SCALE, position, name, HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size * UI_SCALE) or "")
end

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end

    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then

    end

    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0

    end
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)

    local displayText = tostring(state.conditions[name] or 0)

    return string.format([[

        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />

    color, name, imageUrl, colorBlock, size, size,

end

-- SPACE STATION SCRIPT V1.0 28/01/2026
-- Modified from Ship Script V7.3
-- Removed: All movement functions, Rewind, Atmosphere Entry
-- Space Stations are stationary orbital platforms

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Variables That Change Per Station
local SHIP_ID = "LargeSTATION" -- This needs to be changed to allow for new stats to be saved
local Shiphealth = 25      -- health variable (stations typically have more hull)
local ShipbaseSize = 50     -- base size variable (stations are typically larger)
local Shipcost = 0        -- cost variable
local ShipScan = 6          -- Scan range in inches
local Signature = 8        -- Station Signature Variable
local SHIPCardURL =  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/RemasterShips/FLE/GenericStationStats.png" -- Stat Card for the Station
local FIXED_IMAGE_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/RemasterShips/FLE/LargeSpaceStation.png" -- Station Fixed Image Configuration
local Model3DExists = false  -- Set to true if this station has a 3D model available
local TARGET_MESH_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Assets/3DModels/Template/GenericShip.obj" -- Station 3D Model
local TARGET_DIFFUSE_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/14483890135573600795/9622EC8F940C3CCA7EAE7CF86AC358A2EBA6716E/" -- Station 3D Texture

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local BigUI_Height = -65  -- Default for 60mm, will be updated in onLoad

local FIXED_IMAGE_WIDTH = 200
local FIXED_IMAGE_HEIGHT = 200
local FIXED_IMAGE_POS_X = 0
local FIXED_IMAGE_POS_Y = 0
local FIXED_IMAGE_POS_Z = -225
local FIXED_IMAGE_ROT_X = 90
local FIXED_IMAGE_ROT_Y = 270
local FIXED_IMAGE_ROT_Z = 90

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ VISUAL LINE CONFIGURATION ----------------------
local LINE_Y_OFFSET = 0.3
local UNIT_SCALE = 1.0

-- =========================================================
-- 3D MODEL TOGGLE - WITH SCALE MANAGEMENT
-- =========================================================
local Model3DAvailable = false

local PLACEHOLDER_MESH_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9677217278061704/57037684E623F5E07758B8F6811F78DD224C8668/"
local PLACEHOLDER_DIFFUSE_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/14483890135573600795/9622EC8F940C3CCA7EAE7CF86AC358A2EBA6716E/"

local SHIP_CHILD_NICK = "SHIP3dmodel"
local modelAttachmentIndex = nil

-- Scale management
local savedModelScale = nil
local PLACEHOLDER_SCALE = 0.001

function findAndModifyShip3DModel(meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale)
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    if not attachments or #attachments == 0 then
        return false
    end

    if modelAttachmentIndex ~= nil then
        local obj = self.removeAttachment(modelAttachmentIndex)

        if obj then
            local data = obj.getData()
            if data and data.Nickname == SHIP_CHILD_NICK then
                if not Model3DAvailable and savedModelScale == nil then
                    savedModelScale = obj.getScale()
                end

                obj.setCustomObject({
                    mesh = meshUrl,
                    diffuse = diffuseUrl
                })

                if targetScale then
                    obj.setScale(targetScale)
                end

                self.addAttachment(obj)
                return true
            else
                self.addAttachment(obj)
            end
        end
        modelAttachmentIndex = nil
    end

    for i = 0, #attachments - 1 do
        local obj = self.removeAttachment(i)

        if obj then
            local objType = obj.type or "unknown"
            local data = obj.getData()
            local nickname = data and data.Nickname or ""

            if nickname == SHIP_CHILD_NICK or objType == "Custom_Model" then
                if not Model3DAvailable and savedModelScale == nil then
                    savedModelScale = obj.getScale()
                end

                local success, err = pcall(function()
                    obj.setCustomObject({
                        mesh = meshUrl,
                        diffuse = diffuseUrl
                    })
                end)

                if success then
                    if targetScale then
                        obj.setScale(targetScale)
                    end

                    modelAttachmentIndex = i
                end

                self.addAttachment(obj)
                return success
            else
                self.addAttachment(obj)
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

function apply3DModelState()

        diffuseUrl = TARGET_DIFFUSE_URL

function generateFiringArcLines()
    cachedFiringArcLines = {}

    local forward = Vector(0,0,1)
    local MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS = true
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then forward = Vector(1,0,0) end

    local arcLineLength = 16 * UNIT_SCALE

    local function addAngleLines(angleDeg, lineColor)
        local rotRight = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', angleDeg)
        local rotLeft = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', -angleDeg)

        local p1 = rotRight * arcLineLength
        local p2 = rotRight * (-arcLineLength)
        p1.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p2.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p1, p2 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })

        local p3 = rotLeft * arcLineLength
        local p4 = rotLeft * (-arcLineLength)
        p3.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p4.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p3, p4 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })
    end

    addAngleLines(45, {0, 0, 0.6})
    addAngleLines(11, {0.6, 0, 0})
end

function generateScanLines()
    cachedScanLines = {}
    local circleColor = {0.5, 1, 0.5}

    local scanRadius = ShipScan * UNIT_SCALE

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * scanRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * scanRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedScanLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.1
    })
end

function generateSignatureLines()
    cachedSignatureLines = {}

    if not state.sigAuraShown or state.sig == 0 then
        return
    end

    local circleColor = {0.8, 0, 0}

    local sigRadius = state.sig * UNIT_SCALE

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * sigRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * sigRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedSignatureLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.15
    })
end

function updateAuraVisuals()
    local finalLines = {}

    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
    end

    if state.sigAuraShown and cachedSignatureLines then
        for _, l in ipairs(cachedSignatureLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
    end

    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    local current = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    local target = current + (params.amount or 0)

    state.conditions.Aura = (target > 0) and 1 or 0

    if state.conditions.Aura > 0 then
        generateFiringArcLines()
        generateScanLines()
    end

    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus

    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)

    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig

        if state.sigAuraShown then
            generateSignatureLines()
            updateAuraVisuals()
            print("Signature updated to: " .. state.sig .. " inches")
        end
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1
        generateSignatureLines()
        print("Showing Station Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0
        cachedSignatureLines = nil
    end
    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0
    if params.amount == 0 then
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    if not state or not state.conditions or not Conditions then return end

    local conditionData = Conditions[name]
    if not conditionData then
        print("SyncCondition: Unknown condition '" .. tostring(name) .. "'")
        return
    end

    for _, color in ipairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0

        local isActive
        if name == "Status" then
            isActive = HasCriticalStatus()
            state.conditions.Status = isActive and 1 or 0
        else
            isActive = conditionValue > 0
        end

        local imageUrl = isActive and (conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url) or conditionData.url

        local colorBlock
        if currentUIMode == 0 then
            colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. "FF"
        else
            colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. (isActive and "FF" or "22")
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and "true" or "false",
            text = tostring(conditionValue)
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        ApplyActivatedLockState()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for k, color in pairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end

function IsPlayerSuscribed(color)
    return UIStatus[color] ~= nil;

function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation()
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end

    local targetRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180

    targetRotation = targetRotation % 360

    local currentRotation = UIStatus[player.color].rotation
    if currentRotation == nil then
        currentRotation = targetRotation
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = currentRotation
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -currentRotation)
        return
    end

    local angleDiff = targetRotation - currentRotation

    if angleDiff > 180 then
        angleDiff = angleDiff - 360
    elseif angleDiff < -180 then
        angleDiff = angleDiff + 360
    end

    if math.abs(angleDiff) > 0.5 then
        local smoothSpeed = 40
        local smoothFactor = math.min(1, Time.delta_time * smoothSpeed)

        local newRotation = currentRotation + (angleDiff * smoothFactor)

        newRotation = newRotation % 360
        if newRotation < 0 then newRotation = newRotation + 360 end

        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -newRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = newRotation
    end
end

    ]]
    return result

function PlayerHUDPivot(color, additionalContent)
    if not UIStatus[color] then
        return ""
    end
    local rotation = UIStatus[color].rotation or 0
    local content = getUIContent(color)
    if not content then
        return ""
    end

function HUDSingleConditionBodyRectangular(color, name, width, height)
    if not color or not name or not width or not height or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end

    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end

    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local isActive
    if name == "Status" then
        isActive = HasCriticalStatus()
    else
        isActive = conditionValue > 0
    end
    local imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url

    local colorBlock
    if currentUIMode == 0 then
        colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"
    else
        colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
    end

    local fontSize = math.floor(height * 0.85)
    local displayText = tostring(conditionValue)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />

    color, name, tostring(condition.stacks and isActive), fontSize, displayText, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)

function ApplyActivatedLockState()
    local activated = (state and state.conditions and (state.conditions.Activated or 0) > 0)

    if activated then
        if not self.getLock() then
            self.setLock(true)
        end
    else
        if self.getLock() then
            self.setLock(false)
        end
    end
end

function RefreshShip()
    local currentState = {
        conditions = state.conditions,
        health = state.health,
        base = state.base,
        imageScale = state.imageScale,
        sig = state.sig,
        sigAuraShown = state.sigAuraShown,
    }

    rebuildAssets()

    Wait.frames(function()
        for key, value in pairs(currentState) do
            state[key] = value
        end

        self.UI.setXml(ui())
        Sync()
        RefreshModelShape()
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            showSigAura()
        end

        RecalculateSignature()

        print(self.getName() .. " has been refreshed.")
    end, 2)
end

function SetShipCardURL(params)
    if params and params.url then
        SHIPCardURL = params.url
        print("Station card URL set to: " .. SHIPCardURL)
    end
end

function UI_ToggleShipCardEditMode(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        state.shipCardEditMode = not state.shipCardEditMode
        Sync()
        if state.shipCardEditMode then
            print("Station Card Edit Mode: ON")
        else
            print("Station Card Edit Mode: OFF")
        end
    end
end

function UI_ModifyShipcost(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        local change = (alt == '-1' and 5 or (alt == '-2' and -5) or 0)
        Shipcost = math.max(0, Shipcost + change)
        Sync()
        print("Station Cost: " .. Shipcost)
    end
end

function UI_ModifyShipScan(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        local change = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0)
        ShipScan = math.max(0, ShipScan + change)

        generateScanLines()
        updateAuraVisuals()

        Sync()
        print("Station Scan: " .. ShipScan .. '"')
    end
end

function UI_ModifyShipSignature(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        local change = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0)
        SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + change)
        RecalculateSignature()
        Sync()
        print("Base Signature: " .. SignatureStorage .. '"')
    end
end

function UI_CloseShipCard(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        state.conditions.ShipCard = 0
        print("Closing Station Card")
        Sync()
    end
end

function trackSceneryObject(side, obj)

		elseif side == "blue" then

function cloneSceneryFromGUID(guid, position, label)
	if not guid or guid == "" then
		print("Warning: Missing GUID for " .. tostring(label))
		return nil
	end
	local source = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
	if not source then
		print("Error: Could not find source for " .. tostring(label) .. " (" .. tostring(guid) .. ")")
		return nil
	end

	local clone = source.clone({
		position = {0, 0, 0},
		snap_to_grid = false,
	})
	if clone == nil then
		return nil
	end

	Wait.frames(function()
		if clone ~= nil and not clone.isDestroyed() then
			clone.setPosition(position)
			clone.setRotation({0, 0, 0})
			clone.setLock(true)
		end
	end, 1)

	return clone
end

function spawnMoon(size, position, locked)

--------------------------
-- Feature Token Functions
--------------------------

-- Determine city size from GUID
function getCitySizeFromGUID(guid)
	if guid == LargeCity then
		return "Large"
	elseif guid == MediumCity then
		return "Medium"
	elseif guid == SmallCity then
		return "Small"
	elseif guid == SmallStation or guid == MediumStation or guid == LargeStation then
		return "Station"
	end
	return nil
end

-- Spawn a single feature token from a bag at a specific position
function spawnFeatureToken(bagGUID, position)
	local bag = getObjectFromGUID(bagGUID)
	if not bag then
		print("Error: Could not find feature bag with GUID: " .. tostring(bagGUID))
		return nil
	end
	
	local token = bag.takeObject({
		position = position,
		rotation = FEATURE_ROTATION,
		smooth = false,
	})
	
	if token then
		token.setLock(true)
		table.insert(spawnedFeatureTokens, token)
	end
	
	return token
end

-- Spawn feature tokens for a city at relative positions
function spawnCityFeatures(cityGUID, cityPosition, features)
	if not features or not cityPosition then return end

	local citySize = getCitySizeFromGUID(cityGUID)
	if not citySize then return end

	local slots = FEATURE_SLOTS[citySize]
	if not slots then
		print("Warning: No feature slots defined for city size: " .. tostring(citySize))
		return
	end

	-- Spawn features in order, matching feature i -> slot i (stop if we run out of slots)
	for i, featureType in ipairs(features) do
		local slot = slots[i]
		if not slot then break end
		local bagGUID = FEATURE_BAGS[featureType]
		if not bagGUID then
			print("Warning: Unknown feature type: " .. tostring(featureType))
		else
			local featurePosition = {
				cityPosition[1] + slot[1],
				cityPosition[2] + slot[2],
				cityPosition[3] + slot[3],
			}
			spawnFeatureToken(bagGUID, featurePosition)
		end
	end
end

-- Clear all spawned feature tokens
function clearFeatureTokens()
	for _, token in ipairs(spawnedFeatureTokens) do
		if token ~= nil and not token.isDestroyed() then
			token.destruct()
		end
	end
	spawnedFeatureTokens = {}
end

function spawnDeploymentZone(assetName, locationName, overrideColor)
	-- Look up the asset
	local asset = DEPLOYMENT_ASSETS[assetName]
	if not asset then
		print("Warning: Unknown deployment asset: " .. tostring(assetName))
		return
	end
	
	-- Look up the location
	local location = DEPLOYMENT_LOCATIONS[locationName]
	if not location then
		print("Warning: Unknown deployment location: " .. tostring(locationName))
		return
	end
	
	-- Determine color: use override if provided, otherwise use side-based default
	local tint = COLOR_LEFT
	if overrideColor then
		-- Use override color
		if overrideColor == "Red" then
			tint = COLOR_LEFT
		elseif overrideColor == "Blue" then
			tint = COLOR_RIGHT
		else
			print("Warning: Unknown color override: " .. tostring(overrideColor) .. ". Using default.")
			tint = location.side == "Right" and COLOR_RIGHT or COLOR_LEFT
		end
	else
		-- Use default color based on side
		if location.side == "Right" then
			tint = COLOR_RIGHT
		end
	end
	
	-- Compute spawn rotation. For corner assets, rotate 90° on spawn around Y axis.
	-- TopLeft and BottomRight need a 90° clockwise rotation (add 90), others rotate counterclockwise (subtract 90)
	local spawn_rotation = {location.rotation[1], location.rotation[2], location.rotation[3]}
	if assetName:match("^Corner") then
		if locationName == "TopLeft" or locationName == "BottomRight" then
			spawn_rotation[2] = spawn_rotation[2] - 0
			if spawn_rotation[2] >= 360 then spawn_rotation[2] = spawn_rotation[2] - 360 end
		else
			spawn_rotation[2] = spawn_rotation[2] - 90
			if spawn_rotation[2] < 0 then spawn_rotation[2] = spawn_rotation[2] + 360 end
		end
	end

	-- Spawn the deployment object
	local obj = spawnObject({
		type = "Custom_Model",
		position = location.position,
		rotation = spawn_rotation,
		scale = {1, 1, 1},
		sound = false,
		snap_to_grid = false,
	})
	
	-- Set Custom Object properties
	obj.setCustomObject({
		mesh = asset,
		collider = DEPLOYMENT_COLLIDER,
		type = 0,
		material = 3,
	})
	
	-- Set properties
	obj.setName(assetName .. " at " .. locationName)
	obj.setColorTint(tint)
	obj.setLock(true)
	updateDeploymentZoneVisibilityForObject(obj)
	
	-- Track spawned object separately from other scene objects
	table.insert(spawnedScenarioObjects, obj)
	table.insert(spawnedDeploymentZones, obj)
end

function createPremadeNavButtons()
	local function toLocalArray(worldPos)
		local v = self.positionToLocal({x = worldPos[1], y = worldPos[2], z = worldPos[3]})
		return {v.x, v.y, v.z}
	end

	premadeButtonLocalPositions = {
		[PREMADE_BTN.prev] = toLocalArray(PREMADE_BTN_WORLD.prev),
		[PREMADE_BTN.next] = toLocalArray(PREMADE_BTN_WORLD.next),
		[PREMADE_BTN.toggle_deploy] = toLocalArray(PREMADE_BTN_WORLD.toggle),
		[PREMADE_BTN.back] = toLocalArray(PREMADE_BTN_WORLD.back),

		width = SCENERY_BUTTON_WIDTH, height = SCENERY_BUTTON_HEIGHT, font_size = SCENERY_BUTTON_FONT,
		color = {0,0,0}, font_color = {1,1,1}
	})

	-- Position the scenery buttons (convert world to local coordinates)
	local redButtonPos = toLocalArray(SCENERY_BUTTON_RED_POS)
	local blueButtonPos = toLocalArray(SCENERY_BUTTON_BLUE_POS)
	-- The scenery buttons were created after the other four buttons, so their indices are 4 and 5 respectively
	self.editButton({index = 4, position = redButtonPos, rotation = {0,90,0}})
	self.editButton({index = 5, position = blueButtonPos, rotation = {0,-90,0}})
end

function setPremadeNavVisible(visible)
	if visible then
		self.editButton({index = PREMADE_BTN.prev, label = "<", position = premadeButtonLocalPositions[PREMADE_BTN.prev], rotation = {0, 180, 0}})
		self.editButton({index = PREMADE_BTN.next, label = ">", position = premadeButtonLocalPositions[PREMADE_BTN.next], rotation = {0, 180, 0}})
		self.editButton({index = PREMADE_BTN.toggle_deploy, label = "Show/Hide\nDeployment\nZones", position = premadeButtonLocalPositions[PREMADE_BTN.toggle_deploy], rotation = {0, 180, 0}})
		self.editButton({index = PREMADE_BTN.back, label = "Back", position = premadeButtonLocalPositions[PREMADE_BTN.back], rotation = {0, 180, 0}})
		-- Ensure the scenery buttons are at their world-local positions but label shown only when scenery exists
		self.editButton({index = 4, label = "", position = self.positionToLocal({x = SCENERY_BUTTON_RED_POS[1], y = SCENERY_BUTTON_RED_POS[2], z = SCENERY_BUTTON_RED_POS[3]}), rotation = {0,90,0}})
		self.editButton({index = 5, label = "", position = self.positionToLocal({x = SCENERY_BUTTON_BLUE_POS[1], y = SCENERY_BUTTON_BLUE_POS[2], z = SCENERY_BUTTON_BLUE_POS[3]}), rotation = {0,-90,0}})
	else
		for i = 0, 5 do
			self.editButton({index = i, label = "", position = PREMADE_HIDDEN_POS, rotation = {0, 180, 0}})
		end
	end
end

function enablePremadeMode()
	setPremadeNavVisible(true)
	updateScenarioSelection(CURRENT_SCENARIO_INDEX)
end

function disablePremadeMode()
	clearScenarioObjects()
	setPremadeNavVisible(false)
	deploymentZonesHidden = false
	CURRENT_SCENARIO_INDEX = 1
end

function changeScenario(delta)
	local newIndex = CURRENT_SCENARIO_INDEX + delta
	if newIndex < 1 then newIndex = #SCENARIOS end
	if newIndex > #SCENARIOS then newIndex = 1 end
	updateScenarioSelection(newIndex)
end

function updateScenarioSelection(index)
	CURRENT_SCENARIO_INDEX = index
	local scenario = SCENARIOS[index]
	if not scenario then return end

	-- Spawn layout objects (planets, cities, stations) and the scenario tile
	spawnScenarioLayout(scenario)
	spawnScenarioTile(scenario)
end


-- Tile display configuration and current tile reference
TILE_DISPLAY_POSITION = {0.00, 1.11, 27.44}
TILE_DISPLAY_ROTATION = {0.00, 180.00, 0.00}
TILE_DISPLAY_SCALE = {3.33, 1.00, 3.33}
currentScenarioTile = nil

function spawnScenarioTile(scenario)
	if not scenario or not scenario.tileimageURL then
		print("[Scenario] spawnScenarioTile skipped (no tileimageURL)")
		return
	end

	-- Remove existing tile if present
	if currentScenarioTile ~= nil and not currentScenarioTile.isDestroyed() then
		currentScenarioTile.destruct()
	end
	currentScenarioTile = nil

	-- Spawn a Custom_Tile
	local obj = spawnObject({
		type = "Custom_Tile",
		position = TILE_DISPLAY_POSITION,
		rotation = TILE_DISPLAY_ROTATION,
		scale = TILE_DISPLAY_SCALE,
		sound = false,
		callback_function = function(spawned_obj)
			if spawned_obj == nil or spawned_obj.isDestroyed() then return end
			spawned_obj.setLock(true)
			spawned_obj.setName(scenario.name or "")
		end
	})

	obj.setCustomObject({
		image = scenario.tileimageURL,
		thickness = 0.2,
	})

	currentScenarioTile = obj
end

function onPrevScenario(obj, player_color, alt_click)
	changeScenario(-1)
end

function onNextScenario(obj, player_color, alt_click)
	changeScenario(1)
end

function onToggleDeploymentZones(obj, player_color, alt_click)
	toggleDeploymentZones()
end

function onBackToModeHub(obj, player_color, alt_click)
	disablePremadeMode()
	local builder = getObjectFromGUID(BUILDER_OBJECT_GUID)
	if builder then
		builder.call("returnToModeHubFromPremade")
	end
end



function clearScenarioObjects()
	for _, obj in ipairs(spawnedScenarioObjects) do
		if obj ~= nil and not obj.isDestroyed() then
			obj.destruct()
		end
	end
	spawnedScenarioObjects = {}
	spawnedDeploymentZones = {}

	-- Clear feature tokens
	clearFeatureTokens()

	-- Clear any static scenery presented to players
	clearSceneryObjects()

	if currentScenarioTile ~= nil and not currentScenarioTile.isDestroyed() then
		currentScenarioTile.destruct()
	end
	currentScenarioTile = nil
end

function cloneFromGUID(guid, position, label)
	if not guid or guid == "" then
		print("Warning: Missing GUID for " .. tostring(label))
		return nil
	end
	local source = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
	if not source then
		print("Error: Could not find source for " .. tostring(label) .. " (" .. tostring(guid) .. ")")
		return nil
	end

	local clone = source.clone({
		position = {0, 0, 0},
		snap_to_grid = false,
	})
	if clone == nil then
		return nil
	end

	-- Determine rotation for clones:
	local variable_rotation = {0, 0, 0}
	if guid == SmallCity or guid == MediumCity or guid == LargeCity then
		variable_rotation = {0, 180, 0}
	elseif guid == SmallStation or guid == MediumStation or guid == LargeStation then
		variable_rotation = {0, 90, 0}
	end

	Wait.frames(function()
		if clone ~= nil and not clone.isDestroyed() then
			clone.setPosition(position)
			clone.setRotation(variable_rotation)
			clone.setLock(true)
		end
	end, 1)

	table.insert(spawnedScenarioObjects, clone)
	return clone
end

function spawnScenarioLayout(scenario)
	clearScenarioObjects()
	if scenario == nil or scenario.layout == nil then return end

	for _, entry in ipairs(scenario.layout) do
		local id = entry[1] or entry.guid or entry.asset or entry.type

		if not id then
			print("Warning: Missing layout id in scenario: " .. tostring(scenario.name))
		else
			-- Deployment zone entries use 'location'
			if entry.location then
				spawnDeploymentZone(id, entry.location, entry.color)
			-- Moon shorthand: allow {Moon12in, position = {...}}
			elseif type(id) == "string" then
				if id == PlanetaryRing then
					spawnPlanetaryRing(entry.position)
				else
					local moonSize = id:match("^Moon(%d+in)$")
					if moonSize then
						spawnMoon(moonSize, entry.position, entry.locked)
					else
						-- Regular object (city/station) - clone from GUID
						cloneFromGUID(id, entry.position, scenario.name)
						-- Check if this city has features to spawn
						if entry.features and entry.position then
							spawnCityFeatures(id, entry.position, entry.features)
						end
					end
				end
			else
				-- Regular object (city/station) - clone from GUID
				cloneFromGUID(id, entry.position, scenario.name)
				-- Check if this city has features to spawn
				if entry.features and entry.position then
					spawnCityFeatures(id, entry.position, entry.features)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Spawn the static scenery for both players (present them for placement/removal)
	spawnStaticScenery()
end

function noop() end

--[[
	RANDOMIZATION & FAIRNESS EXPLANATION:
	This script utilizes a robust randomization process that works as follows:
	1. Seeding: We generate a seed by taking the last ~27 hours in seconds from the current system time, mixing that with a fractional part of the CPU clock (fractional microseconds), 
	   the individual dice's unique GUID, and a rolling counter as the mod is being played.
	   This prevents same-frame duplicate seeds and ensures unpredictability.
	2. Reseeding: Before every roll or spawn event, `math.randomseed` is called again with this unique seed.
	   Additional `math.random()` calls are made immediately once again to discard the first few values,
	   further decorrelating the stream, in case of any platform-specific quirks which can affect the first roll.
	3. Rolling: The final result is determined by `math.random(6)`, which, backed by the
	   robust pre-seeding above, provides a full randomized distribution of individual dice.
--]]

-- Dropfleet Dice Roller (focused feature set)

end

	{ name = "PHR",       url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/15230805997601119317/1AACFF593345C291630202AAE7DD5567DC60EB8C/" },
	{ name = "Shaltari",  url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1259268007356462351/D36502FE301442811D56B927B6F941C02EE1F158/" },
	{ name = "Resistance",url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1259268007359566684/911C100A27899A36EDB4EB228D61F1ABD36F0121/" },

-- XML UI Position/Size Parameters (Edit these to fine-tune the input field)

-- Global button offset. Change to shift all button positions if the mat size is ever changed.

local function scaleUIPosition(pos)

	return { (pos[1] + (BUTTON_OFFSET_X or 0)) * UI_SCALE, pos[2] + (BUTTON_OFFSET_Y or 0), (pos[3] + (BUTTON_OFFSET_Z or 0)) * UI_SCALE }
end

local function scaleUISize(value)

local function updateCycleButton()
	local function getCycleButtonColors(idx)
		local colors = {
			{0.13,0.13,0.13,1}, -- Default dark grey
			{0.4,0.8,0.4,1},    -- UCM soft green
			{0.6,0.4,0.8,1},    -- Scourge soft purple
			{0.98,0.95,0.8,1},  -- PHR eggshell
			{1.0,0.55,0.0,1},   -- Shaltari orange
			{0.4,0.7,1.0,1},    -- Resistance light blue
			{0.6,0.1,0.1,1}     -- Bioficer blood red
		}
		local c = colors[idx] or colors[1]
		local luminance = 0.299*c[1] + 0.587*c[2] + 0.114*c[3]
		local font = {1,1,1}
		if luminance > 0.7 then font = {0,0,0} end
		return c, font
	end

end

local function getGridRowColFromOffset(offset)
	local grid = 0
	local row = 0
	local col = 0
	for _ = 1, offset do
		col = col + 1
		if col > 4 then
			col = 0
			row = row + 1
			if row > 4 then
				row = 0
				grid = grid + 1
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, row, col
end

local function setDieValueAndRotation(die, value)
	local rotValues = die.getRotationValues()
	if rotValues and rotValues[value] and rotValues[value].rotation then
		local rotY = self.getRotation().y
		die.setRotation(rotValues[value].rotation + Vector(0, 180.0 + rotY, 0))
	else
		die.setValue(value)
	end
end

-- After shakeCoroutine() runs (see below) this function is called to  
-- finalize the roll with one last randomize and place the dice.
local function rollAndArrange(dice)
	-- Decorrelate from the visual shake loop
	for i = 1, math.random(10, 20) do math.random() end

	if not dice or #dice == 0 then
		return
	end
	--Dice spawn positioning
	local rows = {}
	local position = self.getPosition()
	local rotation = self.getRotation()
	local rotY = rotation.y
	local deg = 0.0174532
	local step = 0.7 -- how far apart the dice are spaced
	local startX = -6.8 -- starting X position (left/right)
	local startZ = -2.65 -- starting Z position (up/down)

	for _, die in ipairs(dice) do
		local val = math.random(6)
		setDieValueAndRotation(die, val)
		rows[val] = (rows[val] or 0) + 1
		local newXPos = startX + (rows[val] * step)
		local newZPos = startZ + (val * step)
		local worldPos = {
			position.x + (newXPos * math.cos((180 + rotY) * deg)) - (newZPos * math.sin((180 + rotY) * deg)),
			position.y + 2,
			position.z + (newXPos * math.sin((rotY) * deg)) + (newZPos * math.cos((0 + rotY) * deg))
		}
		die.setPositionSmooth(worldPos, false, true)
	end
end

-- Hold the dice in the air and repeatedly randomize their values/rotations to make it clear its VERY random.
function shakeCoroutine()
	-- Wait a frame to ensure spawned dice are ready
	coroutine.yield(0)
	
	local dice = shakingDice
	if not dice or #dice == 0 then return 1 end

	local shakeDuration = 0.75 --seconds
	local liftHeight = 3.0
	
	-- Organize in a visual row in the air
	local count = #dice
	for i, die in ipairs(dice) do
		if die and not die.isDestroyed() then
			-- Single row of dice is spawned
			local localX = (i - 5 - (count-1)/2) * 0.3 --spacing
			local localPos = { -localX, liftHeight, 0 }
			local worldPos = self.positionToWorld(localPos)
			
			die.setLock(true)
			die.setPositionSmooth(worldPos, false, true)
			die.setRotation(Vector(math.random(360), math.random(360), math.random(360)))
		end
	end

	local startTime = os.clock()
	local nextShake = startTime
	local shakeInterval = 0.12

	while os.clock() - startTime < shakeDuration do
		if os.clock() >= nextShake then
			for _, die in ipairs(dice) do
				if die and not die.isDestroyed() then
					local val = math.random(6)
					setDieValueAndRotation(die, val)
					-- Add tumble spin
					local currentRot = die.getRotation()
					local spin = Vector(math.random() * 60 - 30, math.random() * 60 - 30, math.random() * 60 - 30)
					die.setRotation(currentRot + spin)
				end
			end
			nextShake = os.clock() + shakeInterval
		end
		coroutine.yield(0)
	end
	
	-- Unlock
	for _, die in ipairs(dice) do
		if die and not die.isDestroyed() then
			die.setLock(false)
		end
	end
	
	-- Finalize
	rollAndArrange(dice)

	-- Broadcast hits/crits to all players if a lock is selected
	if selectedLockValue ~= nil then
		broadcastHitsAndCrits(dice)
	end

	shakingDice = {}
	return 1
end

local function spawnDice(count)
	local existing = #getDiceOnMat()
	local total = math.min(count, MAX_DICE - existing)
	local grid, row, col = getGridRowColFromOffset(existing)
	local spawned = {}

	for _ = 1, total do
		local localPos = {
			0.8 - grid * 0.3 - col * 0.25,
			0.5,
			-0.3 + row * 0.25
		}
		local worldPos = self.positionToWorld(localPos)
		local die = spawnObject({
			type = "Custom_Dice",
			position = worldPos,
			rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0.0, 180.0, 0.0),
			snap_to_grid = false,
			sound = false
		})

		if die then
			die.setCustomObject({ image = getCurrentDiceImage(), type = 1 })
			table.insert(spawned, die)
		end

		col = col + 1
		if col > 4 then
			col = 0
			row = row + 1
			if row > 4 then
				row = 0
				grid = grid + 1
			end
		end
	end

	if #spawned > 0 then
		shakingDice = spawned
		startLuaCoroutine(self, "shakeCoroutine")
	end
end

local function updateSummary()
	local dice = getDiceOnMat()
	local counts = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}
	local total = 0
	local totalDice = 0

	for _, die in ipairs(dice) do
		if die.resting then
			local val = tonumber(die.getValue())
			if val and val >= 1 and val <= 6 then
				counts[val] = counts[val] + 1
				total = total + val
				totalDice = totalDice + 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- Update each summary value button with appropriate color
	for i = 1, 6 do
		if summaryValueButtonIndices[i] ~= nil then
			local label = tostring(i) .. ": " .. tostring(counts[i])
			local fontColor = {1, 1, 1, 100}  -- Default white
			
			-- Determine color based on Lock and Crit settings
			if selectedLockValue ~= nil and i >= selectedLockValue then
				-- This value is a hit (at or above lock)
				local critThreshold = selectedLockValue + critModifier
				if critEnabled and i >= critThreshold then
					-- This is a crit (blue)
					fontColor = {0.3, 0.6, 1, 100}  -- Blue for crits
				else
					-- This is a regular hit (green)
					fontColor = {0.3, 1, 0.3, 100}  -- Green for hits
				end
			end
			
			self.editButton({
				index = summaryValueButtonIndices[i],
				label = label,
				font_color = fontColor
			})
		end
	end

	-- Totals: count hits and crits based on selected lock and crit settings
	local hitsCount = 0
	local critsCount = 0
	if selectedLockValue ~= nil then
		if critEnabled then
			local critThreshold = selectedLockValue + critModifier
			-- Count crits (values at or above the crit threshold)
			if critThreshold <= 6 then
				for v = critThreshold, 6 do
					critsCount = critsCount + counts[v]
				end
			end
			-- Count hits as values at or above lock but below crit threshold
			local hitEnd = 6
			if critThreshold and critThreshold <= 6 then
				hitEnd = critThreshold - 1
			end
			for v = selectedLockValue, hitEnd do
				hitsCount = hitsCount + counts[v]
			end
		else
			-- Crits disabled: hits include all values at or above lock
			for v = selectedLockValue, 6 do
				hitsCount = hitsCount + counts[v]
			end
		end
	end

	-- Update totals buttons if they exist (show only when enabled)
	if totalHitsButtonIndex ~= nil then
		if selectedLockValue ~= nil then
			self.editButton({
				index = totalHitsButtonIndex,
				label = "Hits: " .. tostring(hitsCount),
				font_color = {0.3, 1, 0.3, 100}
			})
		else
			-- hide hits when no lock is selected
			self.editButton({
				index = totalHitsButtonIndex,
				label = "",
				font_color = {0.3, 1, 0.3, 0}
			})
		end
	end
	if totalCritsButtonIndex ~= nil then
		if critEnabled then
			self.editButton({
				index = totalCritsButtonIndex,
				label = "Crits: " .. tostring(critsCount),
				font_color = {0.3, 0.6, 1, 100}
			})
		else
			-- hide crits when crits are disabled
			self.editButton({
				index = totalCritsButtonIndex,
				label = "",
				font_color = {0.3, 0.6, 1, 0}
			})
		end
	end
end

function broadcastHitsAndCrits(dice)
	if not dice or #dice == 0 then return end

	-- Tally face counts
	local counts = {0,0,0,0,0,0}
	for _, die in ipairs(dice) do
		if die and not die.isDestroyed() then
			local val = tonumber(die.getValue())
			if val and val >= 1 and val <= 6 then
				counts[val] = counts[val] + 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- Only broadcast when a lock is selected
	if selectedLockValue == nil then return end

	local hitsCount = 0
	local critsCount = 0
	if critEnabled then
		local critThreshold = selectedLockValue + critModifier
		if critThreshold <= 6 then
			for v = critThreshold, 6 do
				critsCount = critsCount + counts[v]
			end
		end
		local hitEnd = 6
		if critThreshold and critThreshold <= 6 then
			hitEnd = critThreshold - 1
		end
		for v = selectedLockValue, hitEnd do
			hitsCount = hitsCount + counts[v]
		end
	else
		for v = selectedLockValue, 6 do
			hitsCount = hitsCount + counts[v]
		end
	end

	-- Broadcast header and results to all players with matching colors
	-- Header indicates this is the Red Player's roller
	broadcastToAll("Red Player", {1, 0.3, 0.3})
	broadcastToAll("Hits: " .. tostring(hitsCount), {0.3, 1, 0.3})
	if critEnabled then
		broadcastToAll("Crits: " .. tostring(critsCount), {0.3, 0.6, 1})
	end
end

function cycleDiceImage()
	currentDiceIndex = currentDiceIndex + 1
	if currentDiceIndex > #DICE_IMAGES then
		currentDiceIndex = 1
	end
	updateCycleButton()
end

-- Update Lock/Crit UI display (forward declaration needed)
local function updateLockCritDisplay()
	-- Update Lock radio buttons (show filled circle if selected)
	for i = 1, 6 do
		if lockRadioButtonIndices[i] ~= nil then
			local label = "○"  -- Empty circle
			if selectedLockValue == i then
				label = "●"  -- Filled circle
			end
			self.editButton({
				index = lockRadioButtonIndices[i],
				label = label
			})
		end
	end
	
	-- Update Crit radio button
	if critRadioButtonIndex ~= nil then
		local label = "○"
		if critEnabled then
			label = "●"
		end
		self.editButton({
			index = critRadioButtonIndex,
			label = label
		})
	end
	
	-- Update Crit value button
	if critValueButtonIndex ~= nil then
		self.editButton({
			index = critValueButtonIndex,
			label = "Crit +" .. tostring(critModifier)
		})
	end
end

-- Helper function to handle lock value selection
local function selectLockValue(value)
	if selectedLockValue == value then
		-- Clicking the same value deselects it
		selectedLockValue = nil
	else
		selectedLockValue = value
	end
	updateLockCritDisplay()
	updateSummary()
end

-- Lock Radio Button Click Handlers (one for each value 1-6)
function clickLockRadio1(obj, player, alt_click)
	selectLockValue(1)
end

function clickLockRadio2(obj, player, alt_click)
	selectLockValue(2)
end

function clickLockRadio3(obj, player, alt_click)
	selectLockValue(3)
end

function clickLockRadio4(obj, player, alt_click)
	selectLockValue(4)
end

function clickLockRadio5(obj, player, alt_click)
	selectLockValue(5)
end

function clickLockRadio6(obj, player, alt_click)
	selectLockValue(6)
end

-- Crit Radio Button Click Handler
function clickCritRadio(obj, player, alt_click)
	critEnabled = not critEnabled
	updateLockCritDisplay()
	updateSummary()
end

-- Crit Value Button Click Handler (left click increases, right click decreases)
function clickCritValue(obj, player, alt_click)
	if alt_click then
		-- Right click decreases
		critModifier = critModifier - 1
		if critModifier < 1 then
			critModifier = 1
		end
	else
		-- Left click increases
		critModifier = critModifier + 1
		if critModifier > 5 then
			critModifier = 5
		end
	end
	updateLockCritDisplay()
	updateSummary()
end

function onDiceCountChanged(player, value, id)
	local num = tonumber(value)
	if num and num >= 1 and num <= MAX_DICE then
		pendingDiceCount = math.floor(num)
	else
		pendingDiceCount = nil
	end
end

function onDiceCountReturn(player, value, id)
	if pendingDiceCount and pendingDiceCount > 0 then
		-- 'player' here is the Player Object, rollDice expects string color
		rollDice(self, player.color, false)
	else
		printToColor("Invalid number. Enter 1 to " .. MAX_DICE .. ".", player.color, "Red")
	end
end

function rollDice(obj, player, alt)
	-- Reseed Random on every roll to ensure fresh unpredictability
	math.randomseed(os.time() + math.floor(os.clock() * 100000))
	-- Burn a few random numbers just to be sure
	math.random(); math.random(); math.random()

	if pendingDiceCount and pendingDiceCount > 0 then
		clearDiceInternal()
		spawnDice(pendingDiceCount)
		pendingDiceCount = nil
		self.UI.setAttribute("diceCountInput", "text", "")
		return
	end

	local dice = getDiceOnMat()
	if #dice == 0 then
		printToColor("No dice to roll. Enter # of dice first.", player, "Yellow")
		return
	end

	shakingDice = dice
	startLuaCoroutine(self, "shakeCoroutine")
end

function clearDice(obj, player, alt)
	clearDiceInternal()
	updateSummary()
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--[[
	RANDOMIZATION & FAIRNESS EXPLANATION:
	This script utilizes a robust randomization process that works as follows:
	1. Seeding: We generate a seed by taking the last ~27 hours in seconds from the current system time, mixing that with a fractional part of the CPU clock (fractional microseconds), 
	   the individual dice's unique GUID, and a rolling counter as the mod is being played.
	   This prevents same-frame duplicate seeds and ensures unpredictability.
	2. Reseeding: Before every roll or spawn event, `math.randomseed` is called again with this unique seed.
	   Additional `math.random()` calls are made immediately once again to discard the first few values,
	   further decorrelating the stream, in case of any platform-specific quirks which can affect the first roll.
	3. Rolling: The final result is determined by `math.random(6)`, which, backed by the
	   robust pre-seeding above, provides a full randomized distribution of individual dice.
--]]

-- Dropfleet Dice Roller (focused feature set)
function none()
end

local UI_SCALE = 1 / 2.75
local Yoffset = 0.1
local MAX_DICE = 99
local CHECK_INTERVAL = 0.3
local DICE_ZONE_GUID = "623e2a"

local DEFAULT_DICE_IMAGE = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9921891006855089007/7DADADC6612F73365CDC52D0349DB37867E2CABC/"

local DICE_IMAGES = {
	{ name = "Default",   url = DEFAULT_DICE_IMAGE },
	{ name = "UCM",       url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1259268007356475725/000F5FBDDABF3F6030D15DFB7558249D264A64C3/" },
	{ name = "Scourge",   url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9677217278510838/5328775872B8584D08D56B7FDF97A01B546EAC54/" },
	{ name = "PHR",       url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/15230805997601119317/1AACFF593345C291630202AAE7DD5567DC60EB8C/" },
	{ name = "Shaltari",  url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1259268007356462351/D36502FE301442811D56B927B6F941C02EE1F158/" },
	{ name = "Resistance",url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1259268007359566684/911C100A27899A36EDB4EB228D61F1ABD36F0121/" },
	{ name = "Bioficer",  url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2452862258292070229/AC8997C4B34A33D3837EE1F41A7231CC78FB081F/" },
}

-- XML UI Position/Size Parameters (Edit these to fine-tune the input field)
local XML_POS_X = 210.0
local XML_POS_Y = -112
local XML_POS_Z = -9
local XML_WIDTH = 350
local XML_HEIGHT = 100
local XML_FONT_SIZE = 60
-- Rotation (try 0 0 0, or 90 0 0 if it stands up)
local XML_ROT_X = 0  
local XML_ROT_Y = 0
local XML_ROT_Z = 180
-- Scale of the UI element (0.01 makes 100px = 1 unit)
local XML_SCALE = 0.20

local currentDiceIndex = 1
local pendingDiceCount = nil
local shakingDice = {}

-- Lock and Crit state variables
local selectedLockValue = nil  -- nil means no lock selected, 1-6 for lock values
local critEnabled = false
local critModifier = 2  -- Default +2 for crits

-- Button indices for Lock/Crit UI
local lockLabelButtonIndex = nil
local lockRadioButtonIndices = {}  -- indices for radio buttons 1-6
local critRadioButtonIndex = nil
local critValueButtonIndex = nil
local summaryValueButtonIndices = {}  -- indices for the 6 value display buttons

local buttonIndexCounter = 0
local summaryButtonIndex = nil
local rollButtonIndex = nil
local clearButtonIndex = nil
local cycleButtonIndex = nil
local inputIndex = 0

local totalHitsButtonIndex = nil
local totalCritsButtonIndex = nil

local function nextButtonIndex()
	local idx = buttonIndexCounter
	buttonIndexCounter = buttonIndexCounter + 1
	return idx
end

-- Global button offset. Change to shift all button positions if the mat size is ever changed.
-- This does NOT include the XML Dice input field.
local BUTTON_OFFSET_X = 5.75  -- left (-) / right (+)
local BUTTON_OFFSET_Y = 0  -- down (-) / up (+)
local BUTTON_OFFSET_Z = 0  -- forward/back on Z axis

local function scaleUIPosition(pos)
	-- Apply global offset before scaling for X and Z, and add Y offset directly.
	return { (pos[1] + (BUTTON_OFFSET_X or 0)) * UI_SCALE, pos[2] + (BUTTON_OFFSET_Y or 0), (pos[3] + (BUTTON_OFFSET_Z or 0)) * UI_SCALE }
end

local function scaleUISize(value)
	return math.floor(value * UI_SCALE + 0.5)
end

local function getCurrentDiceImage()
	return DICE_IMAGES[currentDiceIndex].url
end

local function getCurrentDiceLabel()
	return DICE_IMAGES[currentDiceIndex].name
end

local function isDiceObject(obj)
	return obj and (obj.tag == "Dice" or obj.type == "Dice")
end

local function getDiceOnMat()
	local zone = getObjectFromGUID(DICE_ZONE_GUID)
	if not zone then
		return {}
	end
	
	local dice = {}
	for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
		if isDiceObject(obj) then
			table.insert(dice, obj)
		end
	end
	return dice
end

local function clearDiceInternal()
	for _, die in ipairs(getDiceOnMat()) do
		die.destroy()
	end
end

local function updateCycleButton()
	local function getCycleButtonColors(idx)
		local colors = {
			{0.13,0.13,0.13,1}, -- Default dark grey
			{0.4,0.8,0.4,1},    -- UCM soft green
			{0.6,0.4,0.8,1},    -- Scourge soft purple
			{0.98,0.95,0.8,1},  -- PHR eggshell
			{1.0,0.55,0.0,1},   -- Shaltari orange
			{0.4,0.7,1.0,1},    -- Resistance light blue
			{0.6,0.1,0.1,1}     -- Bioficer blood red
		}
		local c = colors[idx] or colors[1]
		local luminance = 0.299*c[1] + 0.587*c[2] + 0.114*c[3]
		local font = {1,1,1}
		if luminance > 0.7 then font = {0,0,0} end
		return c, font
	end

	if cycleButtonIndex ~= nil then
		local bg, font = getCycleButtonColors(currentDiceIndex)
		self.editButton({
			index = cycleButtonIndex,
			label = getCurrentDiceLabel(),
			color = bg,
			font_color = font
		})
	end
end

local function getGridRowColFromOffset(offset)
	local grid = 0
	local row = 0
	local col = 0
	for _ = 1, offset do
		col = col + 1
		if col > 4 then
			col = 0
			row = row + 1
			if row > 4 then
				row = 0
				grid = grid + 1
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, row, col
end

local function setDieValueAndRotation(die, value)
	local rotValues = die.getRotationValues()
	if rotValues and rotValues[value] and rotValues[value].rotation then
		local rotY = self.getRotation().y
		die.setRotation(rotValues[value].rotation + Vector(0, 180.0 + rotY, 0))
	else
		die.setValue(value)
	end
end

-- After shakeCoroutine() runs (see below) this function is called to  
-- finalize the roll with one last randomize and place the dice.
local function rollAndArrange(dice)
	-- Decorrelate from the visual shake loop
	for i = 1, math.random(10, 20) do math.random() end

	if not dice or #dice == 0 then
		return
	end
	--Dice spawn positioning
	local rows = {}
	local position = self.getPosition()
	local rotation = self.getRotation()
	local rotY = rotation.y
	local deg = 0.0174532
	local step = 0.7 -- how far apart the dice are spaced
	local startX = -6.8 -- starting X position (left/right)
	local startZ = -2.65 -- starting Z position (up/down)

	for _, die in ipairs(dice) do
		local val = math.random(6)
		setDieValueAndRotation(die, val)
		rows[val] = (rows[val] or 0) + 1
		local newXPos = startX + (rows[val] * step)
		local newZPos = startZ + (val * step)
		local worldPos = {
			position.x + (newXPos * math.cos((180 + rotY) * deg)) - (newZPos * math.sin((180 + rotY) * deg)),
			position.y + 2,
			position.z + (newXPos * math.sin((rotY) * deg)) + (newZPos * math.cos((0 + rotY) * deg))
		}
		die.setPositionSmooth(worldPos, false, true)
	end
end

-- Hold the dice in the air and repeatedly randomize their values/rotations to make it clear its VERY random.
function shakeCoroutine()
	-- Wait a frame to ensure spawned dice are ready
	coroutine.yield(0)
	
	local dice = shakingDice
	if not dice or #dice == 0 then return 1 end

	local shakeDuration = 0.75 --seconds
	local liftHeight = 3.0
	
	-- Organize in a visual row in the air
	local count = #dice
	for i, die in ipairs(dice) do
		if die and not die.isDestroyed() then
			-- Single row of dice is spawned
			local localX = (i - 5 - (count-1)/2) * 0.3 --spacing
			local localPos = { -localX, liftHeight, 0 }
			local worldPos = self.positionToWorld(localPos)
			
			die.setLock(true)
			die.setPositionSmooth(worldPos, false, true)
			die.setRotation(Vector(math.random(360), math.random(360), math.random(360)))
		end
	end

	local startTime = os.clock()
	local nextShake = startTime
	local shakeInterval = 0.12

	while os.clock() - startTime < shakeDuration do
		if os.clock() >= nextShake then
			for _, die in ipairs(dice) do
				if die and not die.isDestroyed() then
					local val = math.random(6)
					setDieValueAndRotation(die, val)
					-- Add tumble spin
					local currentRot = die.getRotation()
					local spin = Vector(math.random() * 60 - 30, math.random() * 60 - 30, math.random() * 60 - 30)
					die.setRotation(currentRot + spin)
				end
			end
			nextShake = os.clock() + shakeInterval
		end
		coroutine.yield(0)
	end
	
	-- Unlock
	for _, die in ipairs(dice) do
		if die and not die.isDestroyed() then
			die.setLock(false)
		end
	end
	
	-- Finalize
	rollAndArrange(dice)

	-- Broadcast hits/crits to all players if a lock is selected
	if selectedLockValue ~= nil then
		broadcastHitsAndCrits(dice)
	end

	shakingDice = {}
	return 1
end

local function spawnDice(count)
	local existing = #getDiceOnMat()
	local total = math.min(count, MAX_DICE - existing)
	local grid, row, col = getGridRowColFromOffset(existing)
	local spawned = {}

	for _ = 1, total do
		local localPos = {
			0.8 - grid * 0.3 - col * 0.25,
			0.5,
			-0.3 + row * 0.25
		}
		local worldPos = self.positionToWorld(localPos)
		local die = spawnObject({
			type = "Custom_Dice",
			position = worldPos,
			rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0.0, 180.0, 0.0),
			snap_to_grid = false,
			sound = false
		})

		if die then
			die.setCustomObject({ image = getCurrentDiceImage(), type = 1 })
			table.insert(spawned, die)
		end

		col = col + 1
		if col > 4 then
			col = 0
			row = row + 1
			if row > 4 then
				row = 0
				grid = grid + 1
			end
		end
	end

	if #spawned > 0 then
		shakingDice = spawned
		startLuaCoroutine(self, "shakeCoroutine")
	end
end

local function updateSummary()
	local dice = getDiceOnMat()
	local counts = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}
	local total = 0
	local totalDice = 0

	for _, die in ipairs(dice) do
		if die.resting then
			local val = tonumber(die.getValue())
			if val and val >= 1 and val <= 6 then
				counts[val] = counts[val] + 1
				total = total + val
				totalDice = totalDice + 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- Update each summary value button with appropriate color
	for i = 1, 6 do
		if summaryValueButtonIndices[i] ~= nil then
			local label = tostring(i) .. ": " .. tostring(counts[i])
			local fontColor = {1, 1, 1, 100}  -- Default white
			
			-- Determine color based on Lock and Crit settings
			if selectedLockValue ~= nil and i >= selectedLockValue then
				-- This value is a hit (at or above lock)
				local critThreshold = selectedLockValue + critModifier
				if critEnabled and i >= critThreshold then
					-- This is a crit (blue)
					fontColor = {0.3, 0.6, 1, 100}  -- Blue for crits
				else
					-- This is a regular hit (green)
					fontColor = {0.3, 1, 0.3, 100}  -- Green for hits
				end
			end
			
			self.editButton({
				index = summaryValueButtonIndices[i],
				label = label,
				font_color = fontColor
			})
		end
	end

	-- Totals: count hits and crits based on selected lock and crit settings
	local hitsCount = 0
	local critsCount = 0
	if selectedLockValue ~= nil then
		if critEnabled then
			local critThreshold = selectedLockValue + critModifier
			-- Count crits (values at or above the crit threshold)
			if critThreshold <= 6 then
				for v = critThreshold, 6 do
					critsCount = critsCount + counts[v]
				end
			end
			-- Count hits as values at or above lock but below crit threshold
			local hitEnd = 6
			if critThreshold and critThreshold <= 6 then
				hitEnd = critThreshold - 1
			end
			for v = selectedLockValue, hitEnd do
				hitsCount = hitsCount + counts[v]
			end
		else
			-- Crits disabled: hits include all values at or above lock
			for v = selectedLockValue, 6 do
				hitsCount = hitsCount + counts[v]
			end
		end
	end

	-- Update totals buttons if they exist (show only when enabled)
	if totalHitsButtonIndex ~= nil then
		if selectedLockValue ~= nil then
			self.editButton({
				index = totalHitsButtonIndex,
				label = "Hits: " .. tostring(hitsCount),
				font_color = {0.3, 1, 0.3, 100}
			})
		else
			-- hide hits when no lock is selected
			self.editButton({
				index = totalHitsButtonIndex,
				label = "",
				font_color = {0.3, 1, 0.3, 0}
			})
		end
	end
	if totalCritsButtonIndex ~= nil then
		if critEnabled then
			self.editButton({
				index = totalCritsButtonIndex,
				label = "Crits: " .. tostring(critsCount),
				font_color = {0.3, 0.6, 1, 100}
			})
		else
			-- hide crits when crits are disabled
			self.editButton({
				index = totalCritsButtonIndex,
				label = "",
				font_color = {0.3, 0.6, 1, 0}
			})
		end
	end
end

function broadcastHitsAndCrits(dice)
	if not dice or #dice == 0 then return end

	-- Tally face counts
	local counts = {0,0,0,0,0,0}
	for _, die in ipairs(dice) do
		if die and not die.isDestroyed() then
			local val = tonumber(die.getValue())
			if val and val >= 1 and val <= 6 then
				counts[val] = counts[val] + 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- Only broadcast when a lock is selected
	if selectedLockValue == nil then return end

	local hitsCount = 0
	local critsCount = 0
	if critEnabled then
		local critThreshold = selectedLockValue + critModifier
		if critThreshold <= 6 then
			for v = critThreshold, 6 do
				critsCount = critsCount + counts[v]
			end
		end
		local hitEnd = 6
		if critThreshold and critThreshold <= 6 then
			hitEnd = critThreshold - 1
		end
		for v = selectedLockValue, hitEnd do
			hitsCount = hitsCount + counts[v]
		end
	else
		for v = selectedLockValue, 6 do
			hitsCount = hitsCount + counts[v]
		end
	end

	-- Broadcast header and results to all players with matching colors
	-- Header indicates this is the Red Player's roller
	broadcastToAll("Blue Player", {1, 0.3, 0.3})
	broadcastToAll("Hits: " .. tostring(hitsCount), {0.3, 1, 0.3})
	if critEnabled then
		broadcastToAll("Crits: " .. tostring(critsCount), {0.3, 0.6, 1})
	end
end

	if selectedLockValue == value then
		-- Clicking the same value deselects it
		selectedLockValue = nil
	else
		selectedLockValue = value
	end
	updateLockCritDisplay()
	updateSummary()

-- Crit Value Button Click Handler (left click increases, right click decreases)
function clickCritValue(obj, player, alt_click)
	if alt_click then
		-- Right click decreases
		critModifier = critModifier - 1
		if critModifier < 1 then
			critModifier = 1
		end
	else
		-- Left click increases
		critModifier = critModifier + 1
		if critModifier > 5 then
			critModifier = 5
		end
	end
	updateLockCritDisplay()
	updateSummary()
end

function onDiceCountChanged(player, value, id)
	local num = tonumber(value)
	if num and num >= 1 and num <= MAX_DICE then
		pendingDiceCount = math.floor(num)
	else
		pendingDiceCount = nil
	end
end

function onDiceCountReturn(player, value, id)
	if pendingDiceCount and pendingDiceCount > 0 then
		-- 'player' here is the Player Object, rollDice expects string color
		rollDice(self, player.color, false)
	else
		printToColor("Invalid number. Enter 1 to " .. MAX_DICE .. ".", player.color, "Blue")
	end
end

function rollDice(obj, player, alt)
	-- Reseed Random on every roll to ensure fresh unpredictability
	math.randomseed(os.time() + math.floor(os.clock() * 100000))
	-- Burn a few random numbers just to be sure
	math.random(); math.random(); math.random()

	if pendingDiceCount and pendingDiceCount > 0 then
		clearDiceInternal()
		spawnDice(pendingDiceCount)
		pendingDiceCount = nil
		self.UI.setAttribute("diceCountInput", "text", "")
		return
	end

	local dice = getDiceOnMat()
	if #dice == 0 then
		printToColor("No dice to roll. Enter # of dice first.", player, "Yellow")
		return
	end

	shakingDice = dice
	startLuaCoroutine(self, "shakeCoroutine")
end

function clearDice(obj, player, alt)
	clearDiceInternal()
	updateSummary()
end

local CIRCLE_SIZES = {0, 3, 6} -- inches; 0 = off
local CIRCLE_Y = 0.1
local circleIndex = 1 -- 1=off, 2=3in, 3=6in

function onLoad()
    local TOOLTIP_OFFSET = '0 -60'
    local TOOLTIP_FONT = 20
    self.UI.setCustomAssets({{ name = 'ui_arcs', url = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/17313271084180371587/27C386E11B305D7E36E066A9F5F8379EB863BBC1/' }})

    local xml = [[
        <Panel position="0 70 -7" width="300" height="120" rotation="0 0 180" scale="1.4 1.4 1.4">
            <Button id="btn_circle" image="ui_arcs" onClick="toggleCircle" onMouseEnter="showCircleTooltip" onMouseExit="hideCircleTooltip" width="30" height="30" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" offsetXY='0 0' />
            <Panel id="circle_tooltip_bg" color="#000000CC" rectAlignment="Center" offsetXY="]] .. TOOLTIP_OFFSET .. [[" width="0" height="0" active="false" />
            <Text id="circle_tooltip" text="" fontSize="]] .. TOOLTIP_FONT .. [[" fontStyle="Bold" color="#FFFFFF" outline="#000000" outlineSize="3 3" rectAlignment="UpperCenter" offsetXY="]] .. TOOLTIP_OFFSET .. [[" height="80" width="420" active="false" />
        </Panel>
    ]]

    self.UI.setXml(xml)
end

function toggleCircle()
    circleIndex = (circleIndex % #CIRCLE_SIZES) + 1
    local radius = CIRCLE_SIZES[circleIndex]

    if radius == 0 then
        self.setVectorLines({})
        return
    end

    local segments = 360
    local step = 1
    local points = {}
    local scaleFactor = 1/self.getScale().x

    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * radius * scaleFactor
        local y = math.sin(angle) * radius * scaleFactor
        table.insert(points, { x = x, z = CIRCLE_Y, y = y })
    end

    local thickness = 0.13 * scaleFactor

    local lines = {
        { points = points, color = {1,1,1}, thickness = thickness, rotation = {270,0,0} }
    }
    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

function showCircleTooltip(player, value)
    self.UI.setAttribute("circle_tooltip", "text", 'Toggle Range Circles')
    self.UI.setAttribute("circle_tooltip", "active", "true")
    self.UI.setAttribute("circle_tooltip_bg", "active", "true")
end

function hideCircleTooltip(player, value)
    self.UI.setAttribute("circle_tooltip", "active", "false")
    self.UI.setAttribute("circle_tooltip_bg", "active", "false")
end

function onDestroy()
    self.setVectorLines({})
    -- clear object UI if present
    self.UI.setXml("")
end

--------------------------------
-- Health Tracker
--------------------------------
function onload()
        generateButtonParameters()
        Sector_Health = 25
        self.createButton(b_display_health)

        -- Set default values
        current_health = Sector_Health
        damage_display()
end

function damage_counter(obj, color, alt_click)
    if (alt_click) then
        current_health = current_health + 1
    else
        current_health = current_health - 1
    end

    damage_display()
end

function damage_display()

    if (current_health < 0) then
        current_health = 0
    end

    b_display_health.label = tostring(current_health)
    b_display_health.tooltip = tostring(current_health)
    self.editButton(b_display_health)

end


function generateButtonParameters()
    b_display_health ={
        index=0,
        click_function='damage_counter',
        function_owner=self, label='',
        position={0,0.05,0},
        rotation={0,0,0},
        width = 500,
        height=500,
        font_size=450
}

end

--------------------------------
--Range Rings
--------------------------------
local CIRCLE_SIZES = {0, 3, 6} -- inches; 0 = off
local CIRCLE_Y = 0.1
local circleIndex = 1 -- 1=off, 2=3in, 3=6in

function onLoad()
    local TOOLTIP_OFFSET = '0 -60'
    local TOOLTIP_FONT = 20
    self.UI.setCustomAssets({{ name = 'ui_arcs', url = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/17313271084180371587/27C386E11B305D7E36E066A9F5F8379EB863BBC1/' }})

    local xml = [[
        <Panel position="0 70 -7" width="300" height="120" rotation="0 0 180" scale="1 1 1">
            <Button id="btn_circle" image="ui_arcs" onClick="toggleCircle" onMouseEnter="showCircleTooltip" onMouseExit="hideCircleTooltip" width="30" height="30" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" offsetXY='0 0' />
            <Panel id="circle_tooltip_bg" color="#000000CC" rectAlignment="Center" offsetXY="]] .. TOOLTIP_OFFSET .. [[" width="0" height="0" active="false" />
            <Text id="circle_tooltip" text="" fontSize="]] .. TOOLTIP_FONT .. [[" fontStyle="Bold" color="#FFFFFF" outline="#000000" outlineSize="3 3" rectAlignment="UpperCenter" offsetXY="]] .. TOOLTIP_OFFSET .. [[" height="80" width="420" active="false" />
        </Panel>
    ]]

    self.UI.setXml(xml)
end

function toggleCircle()
    circleIndex = (circleIndex % #CIRCLE_SIZES) + 1
    local radius = CIRCLE_SIZES[circleIndex]

    if radius == 0 then
        self.setVectorLines({})
        return
    end

    local segments = 360
    local step = 1
    local points = {}
    local scaleFactor = 1/self.getScale().x

    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * radius * scaleFactor
        local y = math.sin(angle) * radius * scaleFactor
        table.insert(points, { x = x, z = CIRCLE_Y, y = y })
    end

    local thickness = 0.13 * scaleFactor

    local lines = {
        { points = points, color = {1,1,1}, thickness = thickness, rotation = {270,0,0} }
    }
    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

function showCircleTooltip(player, value)
    self.UI.setAttribute("circle_tooltip", "text", 'Toggle Range Circles')
    self.UI.setAttribute("circle_tooltip", "active", "true")
    self.UI.setAttribute("circle_tooltip_bg", "active", "true")
end

function hideCircleTooltip(player, value)
    self.UI.setAttribute("circle_tooltip", "active", "false")
    self.UI.setAttribute("circle_tooltip_bg", "active", "false")
end

function onDestroy()
    self.setVectorLines({})
    -- clear object UI if present
    self.UI.setXml("")
end
