--==============================================================================
-- CONFIGURATION
--==============================================================================

CONFIG = {
    -- Faction name (used in broadcasts and UI title)
    FACTION_NAME = "Scourge",

    -- UI appearance settings
    UI = {
        -- Main panel dimensions
        PANEL_WIDTH = 720,
        PANEL_HEIGHT = 820,

        -- Colors
        PANEL_COLOR = "rgba(0.1, 0.1, 0.15, 1)",
        TAB_COLOR = "rgba(0.2, 0.2, 0.3, 1)",
        TAB_SELECTED_COLOR = "rgba(0.4, 0.4, 0.6, 1)",
        CARD_COLOR = "rgba(0.25, 0.25, 0.35, 1)",
        CARD_SELECTED_COLOR = "rgba(0.2, 0.8, 0.3, 1)",
        BUTTON_COLOR = "rgba(0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 1)",
        CLOSE_BUTTON_COLOR = "rgba(0.8, 0.2, 0.2, 1)",
        TEXT_COLOR = "#FFFFFF",
        SEARCH_BG_COLOR = "rgba(0.15, 0.15, 0.2, 1)",

        -- Element size controls
        SEARCH_ROW_HEIGHT = 28,
        SEARCH_INPUT_WIDTH = 200,
        CLEAR_BUTTON_WIDTH = 100,
        CLEAR_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 28,
        CLOSE_BUTTON_WIDTH = 28,
        CLOSE_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 28,
        TABS_ROW_HEIGHT = 26,
        ARROW_BUTTON_WIDTH = 50,
        SPAWN_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 45,

        -- Font sizes
        FONT_SIZE_SEARCH = 13,
        FONT_SIZE_TABS = 18,
        FONT_SIZE_CLASS_TABS = 12,
        FONT_SIZE_ARROWS = 60,
        FONT_SIZE_SPAWN = 32,
        FONT_SIZE_CLOSE = 14,

        -- Tooltip sizing
        TOOLTIP_WIDTH = 600,
        TOOLTIP_HEIGHT = 90,
        TOOLTIP_FONT_SIZE = 29,
    },

    -- Player spawn positions
    PLAYER_SPAWN_POSITIONS = {
        ["Red"] = {
            position = {x = -32.82, y = 1.20 , z = 15.77},
            rotation = {x = 0, y = 270, z = 0},
            direction = {x = 0, y = 0, z = -1.9},
        },
        ["Blue"] = {
            position = {x = 32.82, y = 1.20 , z = -15.77},
            rotation = {x = 0, y = 90, z = 0},
            direction = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 1.9},
        },
    },

    -- Spacing between spawned cards
    CARD_SPAWN_SPACING = 2.92,

    -- Class categories (ship class/type sorting)
    CLASS_CATEGORIES = {
        "Other", "Cell", "Corvette", "Lighter", "Frigate", "Carrier", "Monitor",
        "Cutter", "Destroyer", "Runner", "Light Cruiser", "Cruiser", "Heavy Cruiser",
        "Troopship", "Battlecruiser", "Battleship", "Supercarrier", "Super Battleship",
        "Dreadnaught"
    },

    -- Tonnage categories (ship size/weight sorting based on ShipbaseSize)
    TONNAGE_CATEGORIES = {"Light", "Medium", "Heavy", "Colossal"},

    -- ShipbaseSize to Tonnage mapping
    SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE = {
        [30] = "Light",
        [40] = "Medium",
        [50] = "Heavy",
        [60] = "Colossal",
    }
}

--==============================================================================
-- STATE VARIABLES
--==============================================================================

savedShipCards = {}
savedShipCardsBackup = {}
playerSelections = {}
playerCardIndices = {}
playerSearchFilters = {}
playerActiveTabs = {}
playerActiveTonnageTabs = {}
playerSpawnCounts = {}
playerListInputs = {}
playerListUIVisible = {}
playerListInputText = {}
fresh = true
selfGUID = ""

--==============================================================================
-- SAVE/LOAD FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

function updateSave()
        local script = self.getLuaScript()

        -- Find where the embedded data section starts
        local dataStartPattern = "\n%-%-EMBEDDED_DATA_START"
        local dataStart = script:find(dataStartPattern)

        if dataStart then
            script = script:sub(1, dataStart - 1)
        end

        -- Build the embedded data section
        local embeddedData = "\n--EMBEDDED_DATA_START\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "savedShipCards = {\n"

        for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            embeddedData = embeddedData .. "  {\n"
            embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    name = [====[" .. (card.name or "Unknown") .. "]====],\n"
            embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    imageURL = [====[" .. (card.imageURL or "") .. "]====],\n"
            embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    tonnage = [====[" .. (card.tonnage or "Light") .. "]====],\n"
            embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    shipTonnage = [====[" .. (card.shipTonnage or "Light") .. "]====],\n"
            embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    baseScale = " .. (card.baseScale or 1) .. ",\n"
            if card.json then
                embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    json = [====[" .. card.json .. "]====],\n"
            end
            embeddedData = embeddedData .. "  },\n"
        end

        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "}\n\n"
        embeddedData = embeddedData .. "fresh = " .. tostring(fresh) .. "\n"

        script = script .. embeddedData
        self.setLuaScript(script)
    end

function onLoad(saved_data)
        selfGUID = self.getGUID()

        -- Initialize variables if they don't exist
        if savedShipCards == nil then
            savedShipCards = {}
        end
        if fresh == nil then
            fresh = true
        end

        -- Update fresh status based on data
        if #savedShipCards > 0 then
            fresh = false
        end

        -- Initialize player state tables
        playerSelections = {}
        playerCardIndices = {}
        playerSearchFilters = {}
        playerActiveTabs = {}
        playerActiveTonnageTabs = {}
        playerSpawnCounts = {}

        -- Clean loaded data
        for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            if card.json then card.json = stripBrackets(card.json) end
            if card.imageURL then card.imageURL = stripBrackets(card.imageURL) end
        end

        -- Ensure all cards have shipTonnage extracted from their JSON
        ensureShipTonnage()

    -- Show appropriate buttons
    if fresh then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMainButtonsWithList()
    end
end

--==============================================================================
-- BUTTON CREATION FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

function createButton_helper(params)
        local defaults = {
            function_owner = self,
            rotation = {0, 0, 0},
            font_color = {1, 1, 1}
        }
        
        -- Merge params with defaults
        local buttonConfig = {}
        for k, v in pairs(defaults) do
            buttonConfig[k] = v
        end
        for k, v in pairs(params) do
            buttonConfig[k] = v
        end
    
    self.createButton(buttonConfig)
end

function createSetupButton()
        self.clearButtons()
        self.clearInputs()

        createButton_helper({
            label = "Setup",
            click_function = "buttonClick_setup",
            position = {0, 1, 0},
            height = 350,
            width = 800,
            font_size = 250,
        color = {0.2, 0.2, 0.3}
    })
end

function createSetupActionButtons()
        self.clearButtons()
        self.clearInputs()

        -- Compact stacked layout (vertical) — smaller buttons
        local btnHeight = 60
        local btnWidth  = 380
        local btnFont   = 60
        local zStart    = 1.2
        local zSpacing  = -0.25

        -- Cancel button (top)
        createButton_helper({
            label = "Cancel",
            click_function = "buttonClick_cancel",
            position = {0, 1, zStart},
            height = btnHeight,
            width = btnWidth,
            font_size = btnFont,
            color = {0.4, 0.2, 0.2}
        })

        -- Add button (below Cancel)
        createButton_helper({
            label = "Add Ships",
            click_function = "buttonClick_add",
            position = {0, 1, zStart + zSpacing},
            height = btnHeight,
            width = btnWidth,
            font_size = btnFont,
            color = {0.2, 0.5, 0.2}
        })

        -- Remove button (only if cards exist)
        if not fresh then
            createButton_helper({
                label = "Remove Ships",
                click_function = "buttonClick_remove",
                position = {0, 1, zStart + (2 * zSpacing)},
                height = btnHeight,
                width = btnWidth,
                font_size = btnFont,
                color = {0.5, 0.2, 0.2}
            })
        end

        -- Reset button (bottom)
        createButton_helper({
            label = "Reset",
            click_function = "buttonClick_reset",
            position = {0, 1, zStart + (3 * zSpacing)},
            height = btnHeight,
            width = btnWidth,
            font_size = btnFont,
            color = {0.3, 0.3, 0.3}
        })
    end

--==============================================================================
-- SETUP MODE FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

function buttonClick_setup()
        savedShipCardsBackup = duplicateTable(savedShipCards)
    createSetupActionButtons()
    broadcastToAll("Setup Mode: Box-select ship cards, then click Add/Remove", {1, 1, 1})
end

function buttonClick_cancel()
        savedShipCards = savedShipCardsBackup

        if #savedShipCards == 0 then
            createSetupButton()
        else
            createMainButtonsWithList()
        end

    broadcastToAll("Setup Canceled", {1, 1, 1})
end

function buttonClick_add(obj, player_color)
        local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
        local count = 0

        for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
            if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() and selectedObj ~= self then
                -- Check if it's a card or tile
                if selectedObj.tag == "Card" or selectedObj.tag == "Tile" then
                    -- Check if already saved (by name comparison)
                    local cardName = selectedObj.getName()
                    local alreadyExists = false

                    for _, saved in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
                        if saved.name == cardName then
                            alreadyExists = true
                            break
                        end
                    end

                    if not alreadyExists then
                        -- Extract card data
                        local cardData = extractCardData(selectedObj)
                        if cardData then
                            table.insert(savedShipCards, cardData)
                            count = count + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if count > 0 then
            fresh = false
            -- Sort cards alphabetically
            sortShipCards()
            updateSave()
            broadcastToAll(count .. " ship card(s) added to " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker", {0.2, 1, 0.2})
        else
            broadcastToAll("No new cards to add (select Card objects)", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
        end

    createMainButtonsWithList()
end

function buttonClick_remove(obj, player_color)
        local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
        local count = 0

        local newSavedCards = {}

        for _, saved in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            local shouldRemove = false

            for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
                if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() then
                    if selectedObj.getName() == saved.name then
                        shouldRemove = true
                        count = count + 1
                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            if not shouldRemove then
                table.insert(newSavedCards, saved)
            end
        end

        savedShipCards = newSavedCards

        if #savedShipCards == 0 then
            fresh = true
            createSetupButton()
        else
            createMainButtonsWithList()
        end

        updateSave()
    broadcastToAll(count .. " ship card(s) removed from " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
end

function buttonClick_reset()
        fresh = true
        savedShipCards = {}
        savedShipCardsBackup = {}
        playerSelections = {}
        playerSearchFilters = {}
        playerActiveTabs = {}
        playerSpawnCounts = {}

        createSetupButton()
        updateSave()
    broadcastToAll(CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker Reset", {1, 1, 1})
end

--==============================================================================
-- CARD DATA EXTRACTION
--==============================================================================

function extractCardData(cardObj)
        if not cardObj then return nil end

        -- Only allow Tile objects
        if cardObj.tag ~= "Tile" then
            broadcastToAll("Ignored object: Only Tile objects can be saved.", {1, 0.5, 0})
            return nil
        end

        local cardData = {
            name = cardObj.getName() or "Unknown Ship",
            json = nil,
            imageURL = "",
            tonnage = "Light",
            baseScale = 1,
        }

        -- Capture the exact JSON of the object (Tile)
        -- We use this exactly as saved for spawning
        cardData.json = cardObj.getJSON()

        -- Extract Image URL for the UI listing (from CustomObject)
        local customObj = cardObj.getCustomObject()
        if customObj and customObj.image then
            cardData.imageURL = customObj.image
        end

        -- Tonnage detection from Description (check for specific ship types)
        local desc = cardObj.getDescription() or ""
        local descLower = string.lower(desc)
        local name = cardObj.getName() or ""
        nameLower = string.lower(name)

        -- Check both description and name for ship type
        local text = descLower .. " " .. nameLower

        -- Ordered from largest to smallest for proper detection
        if string.find(text, "dreadnought") or string.find(text, "dreadnaught") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Dreadnaught"
        elseif string.find(text, "super battleship") or string.find(text, "superbattleship") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Super Battleship"
        elseif string.find(text, "supercarrier") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Supercarrier"
        elseif string.find(text, "battleship") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Battleship"
        elseif string.find(text, "battlecruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Battlecruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "troopship") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Troopship"
        elseif string.find(text, "heavy cruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Heavy Cruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "cruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Cruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "light cruiser") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Light Cruiser"
        elseif string.find(text, "runner") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Runner"
        elseif string.find(text, "destroyer") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Destroyer"
        elseif string.find(text, "cutter") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Cutter"
        elseif string.find(text, "monitor") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Monitor"
        elseif string.find(text, "carrier") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Carrier"
        elseif string.find(text, "frigate") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Frigate"
        elseif string.find(text, "lighter") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Lighter"
        elseif string.find(text, "corvette") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Corvette"
        elseif string.find(text, "cell") then
            cardData.tonnage = "Cell"
        else
            cardData.tonnage = "Other" -- Default for unrecognized types
        end

        -- Attempt to find baseScale in the Lua script for Tonnage Category sorting
        -- (This preserves the existing logic for categorizing ships in the UI)
        local script = cardObj.getLuaScript()
        if script then
            local scale = script:match("baseScale%s*=%s*([%d%.]+)")
            if scale then
                cardData.baseScale = tonumber(scale)
            end
        end

        -- Extract ShipbaseSize from the card's JSON to determine ship tonnage
        -- ShipbaseSize is embedded in the ship model's LuaScript within the card JSON
        cardData.shipTonnage = extractShipTonnageFromObj(cardObj)

    return cardData
end

-- Extracts the ship tonnage (Light/Medium/Heavy/Colossal) from a card object's JSON
-- by finding the ShipbaseSize variable in the embedded ship model LuaScript
function extractShipTonnageFromObj(cardObj)
    local jsonStr = cardObj.getJSON()
    if jsonStr then
        return extractShipTonnageFromJSON(jsonStr)
    end
    return "Light" -- Default fallback
end

-- Extracts the ship tonnage from a raw JSON string by searching for ShipbaseSize
function extractShipTonnageFromJSON(jsonStr)
    if not jsonStr then return "Light" end
    local shipbaseSize = jsonStr:match("ShipbaseSize%s*=%s*(%d+)")
    if shipbaseSize then
        local size = tonumber(shipbaseSize)
        if CONFIG.SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE[size] then
            return CONFIG.SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE[size]
        end
    end
    return "Light" -- Default fallback
end

-- Ensures all savedShipCards have shipTonnage set (backward compat for old embedded data)
function ensureShipTonnage()
    for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        if not card.shipTonnage or card.shipTonnage == "" then
            if card.json then
                card.shipTonnage = extractShipTonnageFromJSON(card.json)
            else
                card.shipTonnage = "Light"
            end
        end
    end
end

function sortShipCards()
        table.sort(savedShipCards, function(a, b)
        return (a.name or "") < (b.name or "")
    end)
end

function buttonClick_viewShips(obj, player_color)
        if #savedShipCards == 0 then
            broadcastToColor("No ships saved! Use Setup to add ship cards.", player_color, {1, 0.5, 0.5})
            return
        end

        if not playerSearchFilters[player_color] then playerSearchFilters[player_color] = "" end
        if not playerActiveTabs[player_color] then playerActiveTabs[player_color] = nil end
        if not playerActiveTonnageTabs[player_color] then playerActiveTonnageTabs[player_color] = nil end
        if not playerCardIndices[player_color] then playerCardIndices[player_color] = 1 end

        -- Clear object buttons before showing UI
        self.clearButtons()

    -- Generate and display the UI
    showShipPickerUI(player_color)
end

function showShipPickerUI(playerColor)
    local shipPickerXML = generateShipPickerXML(playerColor)
    self.UI.setXml(shipPickerXML)
end

function uiShowCustomTooltip(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color
        local tooltipText = value or ""

        -- Support a "BIG|" prefix to indicate a larger tooltip for emphasis (used for class and tonnage tabs)
        local isBig = false
        if tooltipText:sub(1,4) == "BIG|" then
            isBig = true
            tooltipText = tooltipText:sub(5)
        end

        local cfg = CONFIG.UI

        if isBig then
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "width", tostring(cfg.TOOLTIP_WIDTH))
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "height", tostring(cfg.TOOLTIP_HEIGHT))
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "fontSize", tostring(cfg.TOOLTIP_FONT_SIZE))
        else
            -- Ensure defaults for normal tooltips
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "width", "400")
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "height", "60")
            self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "fontSize", "18")
        end

        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "active", "true")
    self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "text", tooltipText)
end

function uiHideCustomTooltip(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color

        -- Reset to defaults and hide
        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "active", "false")
        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "width", "400")
        self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltip_" .. playerColor, "height", "60")
    self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "text", "")
    self.UI.setAttribute("customTooltipText_" .. playerColor, "fontSize", "18")
end

function getFilteredCards(activeTab, activeTonnageTab, searchFilter)
        local filtered = {}
        local searchLower = string.lower(searchFilter or "")

        for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            local matchesClassTab = (not activeTab) or (card.tonnage == activeTab)
            local matchesTonnageTab = (not activeTonnageTab) or (card.shipTonnage == activeTonnageTab)
            local matchesSearch = (searchFilter == "") or string.find(string.lower(card.name or ""), searchLower, 1, true)

            if matchesClassTab and matchesTonnageTab and matchesSearch then
                local cardCopy = duplicateTable(card)
                cardCopy.originalIndex = i
                table.insert(filtered, cardCopy)
            end
        end

    return filtered
end

function countCardsInCategory(categoryName)
        local count = 0
        for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            if card.tonnage == categoryName then
                count = count + 1
            end
        end
    return count
end

function countCardsInTonnage(tonnageName)
        local count = 0
        for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
            if card.shipTonnage == tonnageName then
                count = count + 1
            end
        end
    return count
end

function escapeXml(str)
        if not str then return "" end
        str = str:gsub("&", "&")
        str = str:gsub("<", "<")
        str = str:gsub(">", ">")
        str = str:gsub('"', """)
        str = str:gsub("'", "'")
    return str
end

        local playerColor = player.color
        playerSearchFilters[playerColor] = value or ""
    Wait.time(function() showShipPickerUI(playerColor) end, 0.1)
end

function uiClearSearch(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color
        playerSearchFilters[playerColor] = ""
    playerCardIndices[playerColor] = 1
    Wait.time(function() showShipPickerUI(playerColor) end, 0.1)
end

function uiTabClicked(player, value, id)
    local playerColor = player.color
    -- Toggle behavior: if clicking the same tab, deactivate it; otherwise switch to new tab
    if playerActiveTabs[playerColor] == value then
        playerActiveTabs[playerColor] = nil
    else
        playerActiveTabs[playerColor] = value
    end
    -- Clear tonnage filter when selecting a class filter
    playerActiveTonnageTabs[playerColor] = nil
    playerCardIndices[playerColor] = 1
    Wait.time(function() showShipPickerUI(playerColor) end, 0.1)
end

function uiTonnageTabClicked(player, value, id)
    local playerColor = player.color
    -- Toggle behavior: if clicking the same tab, deactivate it; otherwise switch to new tab
    if playerActiveTonnageTabs[playerColor] == value then
        playerActiveTonnageTabs[playerColor] = nil
    else
        playerActiveTonnageTabs[playerColor] = value
    end
    -- Clear class filter when selecting a tonnage filter
    playerActiveTabs[playerColor] = nil
    playerCardIndices[playerColor] = 1
    Wait.time(function() showShipPickerUI(playerColor) end, 0.1)
end

function uiNextCard(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color

        local activeTab = playerActiveTabs[playerColor]
        local activeTonnageTab = playerActiveTonnageTabs[playerColor]
        local searchFilter = playerSearchFilters[playerColor] or ""
        local filteredCards = getFilteredCards(activeTab, activeTonnageTab, searchFilter)
        local total = #filteredCards

        if total == 0 then return end

        local index = playerCardIndices[playerColor] or 1
        index = index + 1
        if index > total then index = 1 end

    playerCardIndices[playerColor] = index
    Wait.time(function() showShipPickerUI(playerColor) end, 0.1)
end

function uiPrevCard(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color

        local activeTab = playerActiveTabs[playerColor]
        local activeTonnageTab = playerActiveTonnageTabs[playerColor]
        local searchFilter = playerSearchFilters[playerColor] or ""
        local filteredCards = getFilteredCards(activeTab, activeTonnageTab, searchFilter)
        local total = #filteredCards

        if total == 0 then return end

        local index = playerCardIndices[playerColor] or 1
        index = index - 1
        if index < 1 then index = total end

    playerCardIndices[playerColor] = index
    Wait.time(function() showShipPickerUI(playerColor) end, 0.1)
end

function uiSpawnCards(player, value, id)
        local playerColor = player.color

        local activeTab = playerActiveTabs[playerColor]
        local activeTonnageTab = playerActiveTonnageTabs[playerColor]
        local searchFilter = playerSearchFilters[playerColor] or ""
        local filteredCards = getFilteredCards(activeTab, activeTonnageTab, searchFilter)
        local index = playerCardIndices[playerColor] or 1

        local card = filteredCards[index]

        if not card then
            broadcastToColor("No ship selected to spawn.", playerColor, {1, 0.5, 0.5})
        return
    end

    spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, {card.originalIndex})
    broadcastToColor("Spawned " .. card.name .. " in " .. playerColor .. " play area!", playerColor, {0.2, 1, 0.2})
end

    --==============================================================================
    -- CARD SPAWNING FUNCTIONS
    --==============================================================================

    -- Spawns selected cards for a player at their play area
    function spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, cardIndices)
        if not playerSpawnCounts then playerSpawnCounts = {} end

        local spawnConfig = CONFIG.PLAYER_SPAWN_POSITIONS[playerColor]

        if not spawnConfig then
            -- Default spawn position if player color not configured
            spawnConfig = {
                position = {x = 0, y = 1, z = 0},
                rotation = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0},
                direction = {x = 1, y = 0, z = 0},
            }
            broadcastToColor("Warning: No spawn position configured for " .. playerColor .. ", using center.", playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
        end

        local startPos = spawnConfig.position
        local rotation = spawnConfig.rotation
        local direction = spawnConfig.direction
        local spacing = CONFIG.CARD_SPAWN_SPACING

        -- Get persistent spawn count for this player
        local currentCount = playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] or 0

        for i, cardIndex in ipairs(cardIndices) do
            local card = savedShipCards[cardIndex]
            if card and card.json then
                -- Calculate spawn position based on cumulative count
                local offset = currentCount * spacing
                local spawnPos = {
                    x = startPos.x + (direction.x * offset),
                    y = startPos.y + (direction.y * offset),
                    z = startPos.z + (direction.z * offset),
                }

                -- Spawn the card
                spawnObjectJSON({
                    json = card.json,
                    position = spawnPos,
                    rotation = rotation,
                    sound = true,
                })

                -- Increment count for next card
                currentCount = currentCount + 1
            end
        end

    -- Update persistent count
    playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] = currentCount
end

--==============================================================================
-- UTILITY FUNCTIONS
--==============================================================================

function duplicateTable(oldTable)
        if type(oldTable) ~= "table" then return oldTable end

        local newTable = {}
        for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
            if type(v) == "table" then
                newTable[k] = duplicateTable(v)
            else
                newTable[k] = v
            end
        end
    return newTable
end

function round(num, dec)
        local mult = 10 ^ (dec or 0)
    return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function stripBrackets(str)
        if not str then return "" end
        -- Check for [=[ ... ]=] style first
        local s, e = str:find("^%[=%[.*%]=%]$")
        if s then return str:sub(4, -4) end

        -- Check for [[ ... ]] style
        s, e = str:find("^%[%[.*%]%]$")
        if s then return str:sub(3, -3) end

    return str
end

function getFactionColor(factionName)
    local n = trimString((factionName or "")):lower()
    local colors = {
        phr = {0.58, 0.498, 0.231},

        resistance = {0.231, 0.463, 0.58},
        shaltari = {0.58, 0.325, 0.231},
        ucm = {0.341, 0.569, 0.337},
        bioficers = {0.58, 0.231, 0.231},
        civilian = {0.231, 0.576, 0.58},
        industrial = {0.58, 0.576, 0.231},
    }
    return colors[n] or {0.55, 0.5, 0.35}
end

function parseAndSpawnList(listText, playerColor)
    local lines = splitIntoLines(listText)
    local shipEntries = extractShipEntries(lines)

    if #shipEntries == 0 then
        broadcastToColor("No ships found in the list. Make sure the format is correct.", playerColor, {1, 0.5, 0})
        return
    end

    local spawnedCount = 0
    local notFoundList = {}

    -- Only spawn one of each ship from the list (duplicates and quantities are ignored)
    local seen = {}
    local uniqueEntries = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(shipEntries) do
        local key = (entry.name or ""):lower()
        key = trimString(key)
        if key ~= "" and not seen[key] then
            seen[key] = true
            table.insert(uniqueEntries, entry)
        end
    end

    for _, entry in ipairs(uniqueEntries) do
        local shipName = entry.name
        local matchedCards = findMatchingCards(shipName)

        if #matchedCards > 0 then
            local cardIndex = matchedCards[1]
            spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, {cardIndex})
            spawnedCount = spawnedCount + 1
        else
            table.insert(notFoundList, shipName)
        end
    end

    if spawnedCount > 0 then
        broadcastToColor("Spawned " .. spawnedCount .. " ship cards from list.", playerColor, {0.2, 1, 0.3})
    end

    if #notFoundList > 0 then
        local notFoundMsg = "Warning: Could not find cards for: "
        for i, name in ipairs(notFoundList) do
            if i > 1 then notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. ", " end
            notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. name
            if i >= 5 then
                notFoundMsg = notFoundMsg .. " (and more...)"
                break
            end
        end
        broadcastToColor(notFoundMsg, playerColor, {1, 1, 0})
    end
end

function splitIntoLines(text)
        local lines = {}
        local currentLine = ""
        for i = 1, #text do
            local char = text:sub(i, i)
            if char == "\n" or char == "\r" then
                if #currentLine > 0 then
                    table.insert(lines, currentLine)
                    currentLine = ""
                end
            else
                currentLine = currentLine .. char
            end
        end
        if #currentLine > 0 then
            table.insert(lines, currentLine)
        end
    return lines
end

function removeLineNumber(line)
        local dotPos = findChar(line, ".")
        if dotPos and dotPos < 5 then
            local beforeDot = trimString(line:sub(1, dotPos - 1))
            if isNumeric(beforeDot) then
                return trimString(line:sub(dotPos + 1))
            end
        end
    return line
end

function extractShipEntries(lines)
        local entries = {}
        for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
            line = trimString(line)
            if #line > 0 and not isHeaderLine(line) then
                local entry = parseShipLine(line)
                if entry then
                    table.insert(entries, entry)
                end
            end
        end
    return entries
end

function isHeaderLine(line)
        if #line == 0 then return true end
        if line:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return true end

    local lowerLine = line:lower()

    if contains(lowerLine, "configuration") or
       contains(lowerLine, "game size") or
       contains(lowerLine, "fleet ++") or
       contains(lowerLine, "famous admirals") then
        return true
    end

    if (contains(lowerLine, "admirals") or contains(lowerLine, "groups")) and
       contains(lowerLine, "[") and contains(lowerLine, "pts]") then
        if not contains(lowerLine, "•") and not contains(line, "x ") then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

function parseShipLine(line)
    line = trimString(line)
    if #line == 0 then return nil end

    line = removeLineNumber(line)
    line = trimString(line)

    local colonPos = findChar(line, ":")
    local bulletPresent = (line:sub(1, 1) == "•" or line:sub(1, 1) == "-" or line:sub(1, 1) == "*")

    if colonPos == #line and not bulletPresent then
        local hasQuantity = false
        for i = 1, 6 do
            if i < #line and line:sub(i, i) == "x" and line:sub(i+1, i+1) == " " then
                hasQuantity = true
                break
            end
        end
        if not hasQuantity then
            return nil
        end
    end

    if bulletPresent then
        line = trimString(line:sub(2))
    end

    local quantity = 1
    local xPos = findChar(line, "x")
    if xPos and xPos < 6 then
        local beforeX = trimString(line:sub(1, xPos - 1))
        if isNumeric(beforeX) then
            quantity = tonumber(beforeX) or 1
            line = trimString(line:sub(xPos + 2))
        end
    end

    local bracketPos = findChar(line, "[")
    colonPos = findChar(line, ":")

    local nameEnd = #line
    if bracketPos and (not colonPos or bracketPos < colonPos) then
        nameEnd = bracketPos - 1
    elseif colonPos then
        nameEnd = colonPos - 1
    end

    local shipName = trimString(line:sub(1, nameEnd))

    if #shipName < 3 then return nil end

    local lowerName = shipName:lower()

    if contains(lowerName, "lvl ") or contains(lowerName, "captain") or contains(lowerName, "admiral") then
        return nil
    end

    if contains(shipName, " - ") and (shipName:sub(-2) == " -" or contains(shipName, "pts]")) then
        return nil
    end

    return {name = shipName, quantity = quantity}
end

function findMatchingCards(searchName)
    local matches = {}
    local searchLower = searchName:lower()

    for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
        local cardName = (card.name or "")
        local cardLower = cardName:lower()

        if cardLower == searchLower then
            table.insert(matches, i)
        elseif contains(searchLower, cardLower) then
            table.insert(matches, i)
        elseif contains(cardLower, searchLower) then
            table.insert(matches, i)
        end
    end

    return matches
end
function trimString(str)
    if not str then return "" end
    local startPos = 1
    while startPos <= #str do
        local char = str:sub(startPos, startPos)
        if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
            break
        end
        startPos = startPos + 1
    end
    local endPos = #str
    while endPos >= 1 do
        local char = str:sub(endPos, endPos)
        if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
            break
        end
        endPos = endPos - 1
    end
    if startPos > endPos then return "" end
    return str:sub(startPos, endPos)
end

function findChar(str, char)
    for i = 1, #str do
        if str:sub(i, i) == char then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function contains(str, substr)
    if not str or not substr then return false end
    if #substr > #str then return false end
    for i = 1, #str - #substr + 1 do
        local match = true
        for j = 1, #substr do
            if str:sub(i + j - 1, i + j - 1) ~= substr:sub(j, j) then
                match = false
                break
            end
        end
        if match then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function isNumeric(str)
    if not str or #str == 0 then return false end
    for i = 1, #str do
        local char = str:sub(i, i)
        if char < "0" or char > "9" then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

-- SPAWNER TILE: Hydra
-- Click the button to spawn the model on this tile

function onLoad()
  local pos = self.getPosition()
  rebuildUI()
end

function rebuildUI()
    local ui = {
        {tag='Defaults', children={
            {tag='Text', attributes={color='#cccccc', fontSize='18', alignment='MiddleLeft'}},
            {tag='InputField', attributes={fontSize='24', preferredHeight='40'}},
            {tag='ToggleButton', attributes={fontSize='18', preferredHeight='40', colors='#ffcc33|#ffffff|#808080|#606060', selectedBackgroundColor='#dddddd', deselectedBackgroundColor='#999999'}},
            {tag='Button', attributes={fontSize='12',textColor='#111111', preferredHeight='40', colors='#dddddd|#ffffff|#808080|#f6f6f6'}},
            {tag='Toggle', attributes={textColor='#cccccc'}},
        }},

        {tag='button', attributes={onClick='ui_createModel',text='Spawn Ship',  colors='#ccccccff|#ffffffff|#404040ff|#808080ff', width='120', height='20', position='0 110 -5', rotation='0 0 180' }}
    }

    self.UI.setXmlTable(ui)
end

function ui_createModel(player, value, id)
    local color = player.color  -- "Red", "Blue", etc.
    local pos = self.getPosition()
    spawnObjectJSON({
        json = objectJSON,
        position = {x = pos.x, y = pos.y + 2, z = pos.z},
        callback_function = function(spawned_object)
            spawned_object.call("SetPlayerColor", {playerColor = color})
        end
    })
    broadcastToAll("Spawned: Hydra (" .. color .. ")", {0, 1, 0})
end

local PLACEHOLDER_DIFFUSE_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/14483890135573600795/9622EC8F940C3CCA7EAE7CF86AC358A2EBA6716E/"

local SHIP_CHILD_NICK = "SHIP3dmodel"
local modelAttachmentIndex = nil  -- Track which index the model is at

-- Scale management
local savedModelScale = nil  -- Store the original scale
local PLACEHOLDER_SCALE = 0.001  -- Extremely small (invisible)

function findAndModifyShip3DModel(meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale)
    --print("=== Finding and modifying SHIP3dmodel ===")
    --print("Looking for mesh: " .. (meshUrl:match("([^/]+)$") or meshUrl:sub(1, 40)))
    --print("Cached index: " .. tostring(modelAttachmentIndex))

    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    if not attachments or #attachments == 0 then
      --  print("ERROR: No attachments found!")
        return false
    end

    --print("Found " .. #attachments .. " attachments")

    -- If we know the index, try it first
    if modelAttachmentIndex ~= nil then
        --print("Trying cached index " .. modelAttachmentIndex)
        local obj = self.removeAttachment(modelAttachmentIndex)

        if obj then
            local data = obj.getData()
            if data and data.Nickname == SHIP_CHILD_NICK then
              --  print("Found cached model, updating...")

                -- Save current scale if switching TO placeholder
                if not Model3DAvailable and savedModelScale == nil then
                    savedModelScale = obj.getScale()
                  --  print("Saved original scale: " .. savedModelScale.x .. ", " .. savedModelScale.y .. ", " .. savedModelScale.z)
                end

                -- Update mesh/diffuse
                obj.setCustomObject({
                    mesh = meshUrl,
                    diffuse = diffuseUrl
                })

                -- Update scale
                if targetScale then
                    obj.setScale(targetScale)
                  --  print("Set scale to: " .. targetScale.x .. ", " .. targetScale.y .. ", " .. targetScale.z)
                end

                self.addAttachment(obj)
            --    print("SUCCESS: Model updated via cached index!")
                return true
            else
                -- Wrong object, put it back
                self.addAttachment(obj)
            end
        end
        modelAttachmentIndex = nil  -- Clear invalid cache
    end

    -- Search through all attachments
    for i = 0, #attachments - 1 do
      --  print("Trying attachment index " .. i)

        local obj = self.removeAttachment(i)

        if obj then
            local objType = obj.type or "unknown"
            local data = obj.getData()
            local nickname = data and data.Nickname or ""

          --  print("  Detached object: Type=" .. objType .. ", Nick=" .. nickname)

            -- Check if this is our model
            if nickname == SHIP_CHILD_NICK or objType == "Custom_Model" then
            --    print("  *** MATCH FOUND! ***")

                -- Save current scale if switching TO placeholder
                if not Model3DAvailable and savedModelScale == nil then
                    savedModelScale = obj.getScale()
                  --  print("  Saved original scale: " .. savedModelScale.x .. ", " .. savedModelScale.y .. ", " .. savedModelScale.z)
                end

                -- Update the mesh/diffuse
                local success, err = pcall(function()
                    obj.setCustomObject({
                        mesh = meshUrl,
                        diffuse = diffuseUrl
                    })
                end)

                if success then
                --    print("  Model mesh updated successfully")

                    -- Update scale
                    if targetScale then
                        obj.setScale(targetScale)
                  --      print("  Scale set to: " .. targetScale.x .. ", " .. targetScale.y .. ", " .. targetScale.z)
                    end

                    modelAttachmentIndex = i  -- Cache the index
                else
                    print("  ERROR updating: " .. tostring(err))
                end

                -- Reattach at the SAME index
                self.addAttachment(obj)
            --    print("  Model reattached at index " .. i)

                return success
            else
                -- Not our model, put it back
                self.addAttachment(obj)
              --  print("  Not the model, reattached")
            end
        else
          --  print("  removeAttachment returned nil")
        end
    end

    --print("ERROR: Could not find SHIP3dmodel in attachments")
    return false
end

function apply3DModelState()
  --  print("==========================================")
  --  print("APPLY 3D MODEL STATE")
  --  print("Model3DAvailable = " .. tostring(Model3DAvailable))
  --  print("==========================================")

    local meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale

    if Model3DAvailable then
        -- Switching TO target model
        meshUrl = TARGET_MESH_URL
        diffuseUrl = TARGET_DIFFUSE_URL

        if savedModelScale then
            -- Restore saved scale
            targetScale = savedModelScale
      --      print("Restoring saved scale: " .. savedModelScale.x .. ", " .. savedModelScale.y .. ", " .. savedModelScale.z)
            savedModelScale = nil  -- Clear saved scale
        else
            targetScale = nil  -- Keep current scale
      --      print("No saved scale to restore")
        end
    else
        -- Switching TO placeholder
        meshUrl = PLACEHOLDER_MESH_URL
        diffuseUrl = PLACEHOLDER_DIFFUSE_URL
        targetScale = {x = PLACEHOLDER_SCALE, y = PLACEHOLDER_SCALE, z = PLACEHOLDER_SCALE}
  --      print("Setting placeholder to tiny scale: " .. PLACEHOLDER_SCALE)
    end

  --  print("Target: " .. (Model3DAvailable and "REAL MODEL" or "PLACEHOLDER"))

    local success = findAndModifyShip3DModel(meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale)

    if success then
        print("SUCCESS: 3D Model toggled!")

        -- Refresh the entire ship UI to show/hide fixed image
        Wait.frames(function()
        --    print("Refreshing ship UI after 3D model toggle...")
            RefreshShip()
        end, 2)
    else
        --print("FAILED: Could not toggle 3D model")
    end

  --  print("==========================================")
end

    if params.scan then ShipScan = tonumber(params.scan) or ShipScan end
    if params.thrust then ShipThrust = tonumber(params.thrust) or ShipThrust end

    if params.cardFrontImage then SHIPCardURL = tostring(params.cardFrontImage) end
    if params.modelImage then FIXED_IMAGE_URL = tostring(params.modelImage) end

    -- NEW: Support for 3D model availability
    if params.has3DModel ~= nil then
        Model3DExists = params.has3DModel
        print("  3D Model Available: " .. tostring(Model3DExists))
    end

    if params.name then self.setName(tostring(params.name)) end
    if params.faction then self.setDescription("Faction: " .. tostring(params.faction)) end

    -- SAFE table writes
    state.health.current = Shiphealth
    state.health.max = Shiphealth

    state.base.size = ShipbaseSize
    state.sig = Signature
    SignatureStorage = SignatureStorage or Signature

    -- Only call these if they exist in your ship script
    if getScaleFromBaseSize then
        local targetScale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
        if targetScale then
            self.setScale({targetScale, targetScale, targetScale})
            if setUIHeightsFromScale then setUIHeightsFromScale(targetScale) end

    if rebuildAssets then rebuildAssets() end

    if ui then self.UI.setXml(ui()) end

    if showMeasurementLine then showMeasurementLine() end
    if RecalculateSignature then RecalculateSignature() end
    if updateAuraVisuals then updateAuraVisuals() end

    print("InitFromSpawner OK: " .. self.getName())
end

function generateFiringArcLines()
    cachedFiringArcLines = {}

    local forward = Vector(0,0,1)
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then forward = Vector(1,0,0) end

    -- Calculate scan radius to match scan lines
    local scanRadius = ShipScan * (10/3) * UNIT_SCALE

    -- Set arc line length to 16" (extends 16" on each side = 32" total)
        local arcLineLength = 16 * UNIT_SCALE

    -- Helper to add symmetric lines with custom color
    local function addAngleLines(angleDeg, lineColor)
        local rotRight = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', angleDeg)
        local rotLeft = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', -angleDeg)

        -- Line 1 (Right side) - extends from -arcLineLength to +arcLineLength
        local p1 = rotRight * arcLineLength
        local p2 = rotRight * (-arcLineLength)
        p1.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p2.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p1, p2 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })

        -- Line 2 (Left side)
        local p3 = rotLeft * arcLineLength
        local p4 = rotLeft * (-arcLineLength)
        p3.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p4.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p3, p4 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })
    end

    -- Front/Side/Rear (45 degrees) - Dark Red
    addAngleLines(45, {0, 0, 0.6})

    -- Front/Rear Narrow (11 degrees) - Dark Blue
    addAngleLines(11, {0.6, 0, 0})
end

function generateScanLines()
    cachedScanLines = {}
    local circleColor = {0.5, 1, 0.5}    -- Light Green

    -- Circle Scan Range - use ShipScan variable
    local scanRadius = ShipScan * UNIT_SCALE

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * scanRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * scanRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedScanLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.1
    })
end

function onPickUp(player_color)
      -- Reset move tracker when starting a new radial move
      accumulatedDistance = 0
      UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()

      -- Check if MoveOff is active - if so, skip radial movement setup
      if state.conditions.MoveOff and state.conditions.MoveOff > 0 then
          isHeld = false
          return
      end

    isHeld = true
    holdingPlayerColor = player_color

    -- Store pickup position/rotation for undo (do this FIRST)
    pickupPosition = self.getPosition()
    pickupRotation = self.getRotation()

    -- Record the position and rotation where the object was picked up
    pivotPosition = self.getPosition()  -- Always use current position as pivot
    startRotation = self.getRotation()
    currentSmoothedPos = self.getPosition()

    -- For Course Change: check if we're starting a new maneuver or continuing to phase 2
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        -- If we just dropped and are picking up again, move to phase 2
        if courseChangePhase == 1 and courseChangeDistance > 0 then
            courseChangePhase = 2
            print("[FFAA00]Course Change: Phase 2 - Turn up to 45° more (total 90°), NO MOVEMENT [-]")
        else
            -- Starting fresh phase 1
            courseChangePhase = 1
            courseChangeDistance = 0
        end
    else
        -- Reset for other orders
        courseChangePhase = 1
        courseChangeDistance = 0
    end

    -- Determine the starting "Forward" vector based on the model configuration
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformRight() -- Local X-axis
    else
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformForward() -- Local Z-axis
    end
    -- Flatten Y to ensure 2D calculations
    startForwardVec.y = 0
    startForwardVec:normalize()
end

function onDrop(player_color)
    -- TRACKING: Add current segment to accumulated distance
    if isHeld and pickupPosition then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        local dist = Vector.distance(pickupPosition, currentPos) / UNIT_SCALE
        accumulatedDistance = accumulatedDistance + dist
        -- Update UI immediately
        UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()
    end

    isHeld = false
    holdingPlayerColor = nil

    -- Clear physics velocities to prevent "fling" effect on release
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))

    -- For Course Change: lock distance after phase 1 drop
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" and courseChangePhase == 1 then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        local diffX = currentPos.x - pivotPosition.x
        local diffZ = currentPos.z - pivotPosition.z
        local movedDistance = math.sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffZ * diffZ) / UNIT_SCALE

        if movedDistance > 0.1 then  -- Minimum movement threshold
            courseChangeDistance = movedDistance
            print("[22AA22]Course Change: Phase 1 complete - Moved " .. string.format("%.1f", courseChangeDistance) .. " inches. Pick up again to turn additional 45° [-]")
        else
            -- Reset if they didn't actually move
            courseChangePhase = 1
            courseChangeDistance = 0
        end
    end

    -- Update visuals based on Aura state
    updateAuraVisuals()
end

function updateRadialMovement(player)
    local pointerPos = player.getPointerPosition()

    -- Get movement parameters based on active special order
    local MIN_RANGE, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC, MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC = getMovementParameters()

    -- 1. Calculate Direction and Distance
    local diffX = pointerPos.x - pivotPosition.x
    local diffZ = pointerPos.z - pivotPosition.z
    local directionVec = Vector(diffX, 0, diffZ)
    local currentDist = directionVec:magnitude()

    -- 2. Deadzone / Movement Threshold Check
    if currentDist < MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD * UNIT_SCALE then
        self.setPosition(pivotPosition)
        self.setRotation(startRotation)
        self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
        self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))

        currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition

        updateAuraVisuals()
        return
    end

    -- 3. Calculate Direction & Clamp Angle
    local moveDir = directionVec:normalized()

    -- Calculate angle difference between Start Forward and Current Direction
    local angleDiff = Vector.angle(startForwardVec, moveDir)

    -- Check if angle exceeds limit (use dynamic max turn angle)
    if angleDiff > MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC then
        local cross = startForwardVec:cross(moveDir)
        local sign = 1
        if cross.y < 0 then sign = -1 end
        moveDir = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', sign * MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
    end

    -- 4. Calculate New Position with MIN and MAX range
    local targetPos  -- Declare here so it's available throughout the function

    -- Special handling for Course Change order
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        if courseChangePhase == 1 then
            -- Phase 1: Normal movement up to half thrust
            local currentDistInches = currentDist / UNIT_SCALE
            local clampDistInches = math.max(MIN_RANGE, math.min(currentDistInches, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC))
            local clampDist = clampDistInches * UNIT_SCALE
            targetPos = pivotPosition + (moveDir * clampDist)
        else
            -- Phase 2: NO MOVEMENT - ship stays at pivot position and only rotates
            targetPos = pivotPosition
            -- Note: Rotation is handled separately below in step 5
        end
    else
        -- Standard clamping for other orders
        local currentDistInches = currentDist / UNIT_SCALE
        local clampDistInches = math.max(MIN_RANGE, math.min(currentDistInches, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC))
        local clampDist = clampDistInches * UNIT_SCALE
        targetPos = pivotPosition + (moveDir * clampDist)
    end

    -- Preserve the object's current height
    local currentHandPos = self.getPosition()
    targetPos.y = currentHandPos.y

    -- Smooth interpolation
    if currentSmoothedPos == nil then currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition end
    currentSmoothedPos = currentSmoothedPos:lerp(targetPos, Time.delta_time * SMOOTH_SPEED)
    currentSmoothedPos.y = targetPos.y
    self.setPosition(currentSmoothedPos)

    -- 5. Calculate Rotation
    local targetAngle = moveDir:heading("y")
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        targetAngle = targetAngle - 90
    end
    self.setRotation(Vector(0, targetAngle, 0))

    -- 6. Physics Cleanup
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))

    -- 7. Visual Feedback
    local finalLines = {}

    -- Add Aura visuals if enabled (firing arcs + scan)
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
    end

    if DRAW_RAIL_LINE then
        local visualDir = moveDir
        local shipOffset = currentSmoothedPos - pivotPosition
        shipOffset.y = 0

        if shipOffset:magnitude() > 0.1 then
             visualDir = shipOffset:normalized()
        end

        -- Use dynamic max range for visual
        local railEnd = pivotPosition + (visualDir * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)

        local localStart = self.positionToLocal(pivotPosition)
        localStart.y = localStart.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localEnd = self.positionToLocal(railEnd)
        localEnd.y = localEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

        -- Use dynamic max turn angle for limit lines
        local leftLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', -MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
        local rightLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)

        local leftLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)
        local rightLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)

        local localLeftEnd = self.positionToLocal(leftLimitEnd)
        localLeftEnd.y = localLeftEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localRightEnd = self.positionToLocal(rightLimitEnd)
        localRightEnd.y = localRightEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

        -- Main range line (white)
        table.insert(finalLines, {
            points = { localStart, localEnd },
            color = {1, 1, 1},
            thickness = 0.1,
            rotation = {0,0,0}
        })

        -- Only draw turn limit lines if turning is allowed
        if MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC > 0 then
            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localLeftEnd },
                color = {1, 0, 0},
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localRightEnd },
                color = {1, 0, 0},
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end

        -- Draw minimum range circle if MIN_RANGE > 0
        if MIN_RANGE > 0 then
            local minCirclePoints = {}
            local segments = 32
            local step = 360 / segments
            for i = 0, segments do
                local angle = math.rad(i * step)
                local x = math.cos(angle) * MIN_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE
                local z = math.sin(angle) * MIN_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE
                local worldPos = pivotPosition + Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z)
                table.insert(minCirclePoints, self.positionToLocal(worldPos))
            end

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = minCirclePoints,
                color = {1, 1, 0},  -- Yellow for minimum range
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end
    end

    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function generateSignatureLines()
    cachedSignatureLines = {}

    if not state.sigAuraShown or state.sig == 0 then
        return  -- Don't generate if not shown or sig is 0
    end

    local circleColor = {0.8, 0, 0}  -- Red for signature

    -- Calculate signature radius
    local sigRadius = state.sig * UNIT_SCALE

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * sigRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * sigRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedSignatureLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.15  -- Slightly thicker than scan lines
    })
end

function getMovementParameters()
    -- Safety check - ensure ShipThrust exists
    if not ShipThrust or ShipThrust == 0 then
        ShipThrust = 9  -- Default value
    end

    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    local halfThrust = ShipThrust / 2
    local fullThrust = ShipThrust
    local doubleThrust = ShipThrust * 2

    -- Return: minRange, maxRange, maxTurnAngle
    if activeOrder == "GeneralQuarters" then
        -- Move between half and full thrust, turn up to 45°
        return halfThrust, fullThrust, 45

    elseif activeOrder == "SilentRunningOrder" then
        -- Move between half and full thrust, NO TURNING
        return halfThrust, fullThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "WeaponsFree" then
        -- Move between half and full thrust, NO TURNING
        return halfThrust, fullThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        -- Phase 1: Turn up to 45°, move up to half thrust
        -- Phase 2: Turn another 45° (total 90°), NO MOVEMENT AT ALL
        if courseChangePhase == 1 then
            return 0, halfThrust, 45
        else
            -- Phase 2: ZERO movement, can only rotate
            return 0, 0, 45  -- Changed from courseChangeDistance to 0,0
        end

    elseif activeOrder == "MaxThrust" then
        -- Move between full and double thrust, NO TURNING
        return fullThrust, doubleThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "DamageControl" then
        -- Turn up to 45°, move up to half thrust
        return 0, halfThrust, 45

    else
        -- Default to General Quarters
        return halfThrust, fullThrust, 45
    end
end

function updateAuraVisuals()
    local finalLines = {}

    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
    end

    if state.sigAuraShown and cachedSignatureLines then
        for _, l in ipairs(cachedSignatureLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
    end

    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function onLoad(save)

    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}

    -- ===== SHIP ID CHECK =====
    local savedShipID = data.shipID or ""
    local isNewShipType = (savedShipID ~= SHIP_ID)

    if isNewShipType then
        print("New ship type detected: " .. SHIP_ID .. " - Using script default stats")
    end

    state.moveNumber = data.moveNumber or 5
    state.fractionNumber = data.fractionNumber or 0

    -- Load ALL ship stats - use defaults if new ship type, otherwise use saved
    if isNewShipType then
        -- Keep all the values defined at the top of the script
    else
        -- Load saved stats
        Shiphealth = data.Shiphealth or Shiphealth
        ShipbaseSize = data.ShipbaseSize or ShipbaseSize
        Shipcost = data.Shipcost or Shipcost
        ShipScan = data.ShipScan or ShipScan
        ShipThrust = data.ShipThrust or ShipThrust
        Signature = data.Signature or Signature

        -- Load URLs if they were saved
        if data.SHIPCardURL then
            SHIPCardURL = data.SHIPCardURL
        end
        if data.FIXED_IMAGE_URL then
            FIXED_IMAGE_URL = data.FIXED_IMAGE_URL
        end
    end

    -- ===== NEW: Scale model based on base size =====
    local targetScale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
    local currentScale = self.getScale()

    -- Only rescale if it's different (avoids unnecessary scaling)
    if currentScale.x ~= targetScale then
        self.setScale({targetScale, targetScale, targetScale})
        print("Ship scaled to " .. targetScale .. " based on " .. ShipbaseSize .. "mm base")
    end
    -- ===== END NEW CODE =====

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Reset health if new ship type
    if isNewShipType then
        state.health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = state.base or {}
        state.base.size = ShipbaseSize
    end

    -- Initialize pickup vars as nil
    pickupPosition = nil
    pickupRotation = nil

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage
    if isNewShipType then
        SignatureStorage = Signature
    else
        SignatureStorage = data.baseSignature or state.sig or Signature
    end

    -- Generate firing arc and scan lines
    generateFiringArcLines()
    generateScanLines()

function onUpdate()
    if not state or not state.conditions then return end

    -- Handle radial movement when held (but not if MoveOff is active)
    if isHeld and pivotPosition and holdingPlayerColor and (not state.conditions.MoveOff or state.conditions.MoveOff == 0) then
        local player = Player[holdingPlayerColor]
        if player then
            updateRadialMovement(player)
        else
            onDrop(nil)
        end
    end

    -- Add safe checks for ProjectArcs condition
    if state.conditions.ProjectArcs and state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0 and
       ((ChildObjs.aura_obj) or (state.sigAuraShown and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj)) then
        ProjectArcsForward()
    end

    -- UPDATE REGULAR UI (camera-facing for each player)
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
        end
    end

    -- Update measurement line when ship rotates
    if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
        local rotation = self.getRotation()
        ChildObjs.measurement_line.setRotation({0, rotation.y + 90, 0})
    end

    UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()
end

function recoverState(save)

        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
        state.sig = originalData.sig or Signature
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise",
        "CounterClockwise", "MoveNumber", "ShipCard", "Status", "SpecialOrders",
        "TargetSig", "ProjectArcs", "MoveOff", "Rewind", "FractionNumber", "Move"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}

    state.statusMenuOpen = state.statusMenuOpen or false

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    local current = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    local target = current + (params.amount or 0)

    -- clamp to 0/1 so it can never stack
    state.conditions.Aura = (target > 0) and 1 or 0

    if state.conditions.Aura > 0 then
        generateFiringArcLines()
        generateScanLines()
    end

    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end


function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus

    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)

    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig

        -- Regenerate signature lines if they're being shown
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            generateSignatureLines()
            updateAuraVisuals()
            print("Signature updated to: " .. state.sig .. " inches")
        end
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        generateSignatureLines()  -- Generate the circle
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
        cachedSignatureLines = nil  -- Clear the lines
    end
    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

-- Update the ModifyCondition function to handle fractionNumber wrapping (0-9)
function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            -- Special handling for FractionNumber
            if params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                -- Increment or decrement and wrap around 0-9
                local newValue = (previousValue + params.amount) % 10
                if newValue < 0 then newValue = 9 end  -- Handle negative wrap-around
                state.conditions[params.name] = newValue
                state.fractionNumber = newValue  -- Update the state variable
            else
                state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
            end
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        if params.name ~= "MoveNumber" and params.name ~= "FractionNumber" then
            print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        else
            if params.name == "MoveNumber" then
                state.moveNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            elseif params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                state.fractionNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            end
        end
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Set specific color values (light blue from color picker)
    -- RGB: 190, 221, 255 (normalized to 0-1 range)
    -- Alpha: 35 (normalized to 0-1 range)
    state.base.color = {
        r = 190/255,  -- 0.745
        g = 221/255,  -- 0.867
        b = 255/255,  -- 1.0
        a = 35/255    -- 0.137 (alpha/transparency)
    }

    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        local alpha = baseColor.a or 1.0  -- Use stored alpha or default to fully opaque

        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            -- Not activated - use the light blue color with stored alpha
            self.setColorTint({
                r = baseColor.r,
                g = baseColor.g,
                b = baseColor.b,
                a = alpha
            })
        else
            -- Activated - use the same light blue color with stored alpha
            self.setColorTint({
                r = baseColor.r,
                g = baseColor.g,
                b = baseColor.b,
                a = alpha
            })
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

function Sync()
    -- Calculate current rotations for all players BEFORE rebuilding UI
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if UIStatus[player.color] then
            local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation()
            if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end
            local targetRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180
            -- Normalize to 0-360

            -- Store the calculated rotation so PlayerHUDPivot uses it
            UIStatus[player.color].rotation = targetRotation
        end

function SyncCondition(name)
    if not state or not state.conditions or not Conditions then return end

    local conditionData = Conditions[name]
    if not conditionData then
        print("SyncCondition: Unknown condition '" .. tostring(name) .. "'")
        return
    end

    for _, color in ipairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0

        -- Special handling for Status button - show active if any critical status is active
        local isActive
        if name == "Status" then
            isActive = HasCriticalStatus()
            state.conditions.Status = isActive and 1 or 0
        else
            isActive = conditionValue > 0
        end

        local imageUrl = isActive and (conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url) or conditionData.url

        local colorBlock
        if currentUIMode == 0 then
            colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. "FF"
        else
            colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. (isActive and "FF" or "22")
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and "true" or "false",
            text = tostring(conditionValue)
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        ApplyActivatedLockState()
    end

-- Improved smooth rotation tracking for camera-facing UI
function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation()
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end

    -- Calculate the exact rotation needed to face the player's camera
    local targetRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180

    -- Normalize angle to 0-360 range
    targetRotation = targetRotation % 360

    -- Get the current stored rotation (or initialize if not set)
    local currentRotation = UIStatus[player.color].rotation
    if currentRotation == nil then
        -- First time - snap to target immediately
        currentRotation = targetRotation
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = currentRotation
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -currentRotation)
        return
    end

    -- Calculate the shortest angle difference for smooth interpolation
    local angleDiff = targetRotation - currentRotation

    -- Handle wrap-around (e.g., going from 350 to 10 degrees)
    if angleDiff > 180 then
        angleDiff = angleDiff - 360
    elseif angleDiff < -180 then
        angleDiff = angleDiff + 360
    end

    -- Only update if there's a meaningful difference (reduces unnecessary UI updates)
    if math.abs(angleDiff) > 0.5 then
        -- Smooth interpolation using Time.delta_time for framerate independence
        local smoothSpeed = 40 -- Adjust speed as needed
        local smoothFactor = math.min(1, Time.delta_time * smoothSpeed)

        local newRotation = currentRotation + (angleDiff * smoothFactor)

        -- Normalize the new rotation to 0-360
        newRotation = newRotation % 360
        if newRotation < 0 then newRotation = newRotation + 360 end

        -- Apply the rotation to the UI element
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -newRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = newRotation
    end
end

function HUDSingleConditionBodyRectangular(color, name, width, height)
    if not color or not name or not width or not height or not state.conditions then
        return ""

    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end

    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local isActive
    if name == "Status" then
        isActive = HasCriticalStatus()
    else
        isActive = conditionValue > 0
    end
    local imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url

    -- Match the logic from HUDSingleConditionBody exactly
    local colorBlock
    if currentUIMode == 0 then  -- High Visibility mode - always fully opaque

    else  -- Subtle mode (1) - transparent when inactive
