    local wasOnSilentRunning = (state.activeSpecialOrder == "SilentRunningOrder")

    state.activeSpecialOrder = orderName
    state.specialOrdersMenuOpen = false
    state.conditions.SpecialOrders = 0

    -- Reset Course Change phases when changing orders
    courseChangePhase = 1
    courseChangeDistance = 0

    -- Handle Silent Running activation/deactivation
    if orderName == "SilentRunningOrder" then
        -- Activate Silent Running
        state.conditions.Silent_Running = 1
        cloaked = 1
        print("Special Order selected: Silent Running Order - Signature Set to 0")
        RecalculateSignature()
        SyncCondition("Silent_Running")
    elseif wasOnSilentRunning then
        -- Deactivate Silent Running when switching away from Silent Running Order
        state.conditions.Silent_Running = 0
        cloaked = 0
        print("Special Order selected: " .. orderName .. " - Signature Restored")
        RecalculateSignature()
        SyncCondition("Silent_Running")
    else
        print("Special Order selected: " .. orderName)
    end

    Sync()
end

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end

    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end

    -- Special handling for Rewind button - show MoveOff icon when MoveOff is active
    local imageUrl
    if name == "Rewind" then
        if state.conditions.MoveOff and state.conditions.MoveOff > 0 then
            imageUrl = Conditions["MoveOff"].active_url
        else
            imageUrl = condition.url
        end
    else
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
        local isActive = conditionValue > 0
        imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url
    end

    local colorBlock
    if currentUIMode == 0 then  -- High Visibility mode - always fully opaque
        colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"
    else  -- Subtle mode (1) - transparent when inactive
        local isActive = (state.conditions[name] or 0) > 0
        -- For Rewind, consider it "active" if MoveOff is on
        if name == "Rewind" and state.conditions.MoveOff and state.conditions.MoveOff > 0 then
            isActive = true
        end
        colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
    end
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)

    local displayText = name == "Move" and "Move" or tostring(state.conditions[name] or 0)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
    ]],

    color, name, tostring(condition.stacks and ((state.conditions[name] or 0) > 0)), fontSize, displayText, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)

-- Update the UI_ModifyMove function to use fractional movement
function UI_ModifyMove(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

        if moveAmount > 0 then
            if not self.getLock() then
                self.setLock(true)
            end

            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()

            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

            local directionMultiplier = alt == '-2' and -1 or 1

            local deltaX = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)

            local newPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }

            self.setPosition(newPos)

            local direction = directionMultiplier == 1 and "forward" or "backward"
            local modelName = self.getName()

            local colorCode = directionMultiplier == 1 and "22AA22" or "AA2222"
            print(modelName .. " has moved " ..
                "[" .. colorCode .. "]" .. direction .. "[-][F4641D] " ..
                string.format("%.1f", moveAmount) .. "[-] inches ")

            showMeasurementLine()
        end
    end
end

function ToggleProjectedArcs()
    local isProjected = state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0

    if isProjected then
        ProjectArcsForward()
        print("[22AA22] Projecting ship arcs [-]")
    else
        ResetArcs()
        print("[AA2222] Resetting ship arcs [-]")
    end
end

function ProjectArcsForward()
    if state._projectingArcs then return end
    state._projectingArcs = true

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

        if moveAmount > 0 then
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()

            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

            local deltaX = moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)

            local projectedPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('originalParent', self)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', nil)

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(projectedPos)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint({r = 0, g = 1, b = 0, a = 0.6})

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
                function onUpdate()
                    -- Keep position static when projected
                end
            ]])
        end
    end

    state._projectingArcs = false
end

function ResetArcs()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self)
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())

        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint(clr)

        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
            function onUpdate()
                if parent and parent.getPosition then
                    self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                    self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                end
            end
        ]])
    end
end

function ApplyActivatedLockState()
    local activated = (state and state.conditions and (state.conditions.Activated or 0) > 0)

    if activated then
        if not self.getLock() then
            self.setLock(true)
        end
    else
        if self.getLock() then

    end

-------- Rewind Function -------------------

function rewindPosition()
    if pickupPosition and pickupRotation then
        self.setPositionSmooth(pickupPosition)
        self.setRotationSmooth(pickupRotation)
        print("Ship rewound to position before pickup")
    else
        print("No pickup position available")
    end
end

function UI_ModifyRewind(p, alt)
    if alt == '-3' then return end  -- Ignore mouse enter/exit

    local moveOffActive = state.conditions.MoveOff and state.conditions.MoveOff > 0

    if alt == '-2' then  -- Right click
        if not moveOffActive then
            -- Activate MoveOff
            state.conditions.MoveOff = 1
            print("Radial Movement DISABLED - Ship can be moved freely")
        else
            -- Deactivate MoveOff
            state.conditions.MoveOff = 0
            print("Radial Movement ENABLED - Ship will use movement restrictions")
        end
        Sync()
    else  -- Left click (alt == '-1' or default)
        if moveOffActive then
            -- Deactivate MoveOff
            state.conditions.MoveOff = 0
            print("Radial Movement ENABLED - Ship will use movement restrictions")
            Sync()
        else
            -- Execute rewind
            rewindPosition()
        end
    end
end

end

function showMeasurementLine()
    local ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER = 0.5
    local ARROW_WIDTH = 1.05
    local ARROW_HEIGHT = 1
    local ARROW_Y_OFFSET = 0
    local ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET = 0
    local ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET = 270
    local ARROW_COLOR = {r=0, g=1, b=0, a=0.7}
    local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION = {0, 0, 0}

    local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
    local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
    local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

    if moveAmount > 0 then
        local rotation = self.getRotation()
        local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
        local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

        local currentPos = self.getPosition()

        local arrowPos = {
            x = currentPos.x + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.sin(moveAngle),
            y = currentPos.y + ARROW_Y_OFFSET,
            z = currentPos.z + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.cos(moveAngle)
        }

        if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setPosition(arrowPos)
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setRotation({
                ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1],
                rotation.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET,
                ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3]
            })
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setScale({ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER, ARROW_HEIGHT, moveAmount * ARROW_WIDTH})
        else
            ChildObjs.measurement_line = spawnObject({
                type = 'Custom_Model',
                position = arrowPos,
                rotation = {
                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1],
                    rotation.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET,
                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3]
                },
                scale = {ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER, ARROW_HEIGHT, ARROW_WIDTH},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(obj)
                    obj.setColorTint(ARROW_COLOR)
                    obj.setVar('parent', self)
                    obj.setLuaScript([[
                        local ARROW_Y_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_Y_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_X = ]] .. ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1] .. [[
                        local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_Z = ]] .. ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3] .. [[

                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                local shipPos = parent.getPosition()
                                local shipRot = parent.getRotation()

                                local shipAngle = math.rad(shipRot.y)
                                local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

                                local arrowPos = {
                                    x = shipPos.x + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.sin(moveAngle),
                                    y = shipPos.y + ARROW_Y_OFFSET,
                                    z = shipPos.z + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.cos(moveAngle)
                                }

                                self.setPosition(arrowPos)
                                self.setRotation({
                                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_X,
                                    shipRot.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET,
                                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_Z
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    obj.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })

            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9677217278061704/57037684E623F5E07758B8F6811F78DD224C8668/',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                type = 0,
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0.1,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    else
        if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        end
    end
end

function RefreshShip()
    local currentState = {
        conditions = state.conditions,
        health = state.health,
        base = state.base,
        imageScale = state.imageScale,
        sig = state.sig,
        sigAuraShown = state.sigAuraShown,
    }
    --print("Rebuilding Assets")
    rebuildAssets()
--print("Wait")
    Wait.frames(function()
        for key, value in pairs(currentState) do
            state[key] = value
        end

        self.UI.setXml(ui())
        Sync()
        RefreshModelShape()
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            showSigAura()
        end
        showMeasurementLine()

        RecalculateSignature()

        --print(self.getName() .. " has been refreshed.")
    end, 2)
end

-- SHIP SCRIPT V7.3 24/01/2026
-- Shrank the UI Overall
-- Fixed Subtle UI
-- Fixed Ship card
-- Fixed scaling
-- Generalised Ship Model for Any ship
-- Fixed Ship Stat Saving (By Adding Ship ID Variable, Make sure to pass this from the card)
-- Moved all passed variables to top of Code for ease of reading
-- Rolled the Pickup Button into the Rewind Button
-- Raikoh edits: 
    --split the pickup and rewind buttons up again, 
    -- removed a bunch of unused code related to the old movement system
    -- change scaling/size of HP text

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Variables That Change Per ship
local SHIP_ID = "Hydra" -- This needs to be changed to allow for new stats to be saved
local Shiphealth = 10       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 40     -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 135        -- cost variable
local ShipScan = 6          -- Scan range in inches (NEW)
local ShipThrust = 10 		-- Ship Thrust Value
local Signature = 8        -- Ship Signature Variable
local SHIPCardURL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/RemasterShips/SCO/Hydra_CardFrontImage.png" -- Stat Card for the Ship
local FIXED_IMAGE_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/RemasterShips/SCO/Hydra_ModelImage.png" -- Ship Fixed Image Configuration
local Model3DExists = false  -- Set to true if this ship has a 3D model available
local TARGET_MESH_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Assets/3DModels/Template/GenericShip.obj" -- Ship 3D Model Assets/3DModels/Template/GenericShip.obj
local TARGET_DIFFUSE_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/14483890135573600795/9622EC8F940C3CCA7EAE7CF86AC358A2EBA6716E/" -- Ship 3D Texture Assets/3DModels/Template/MedCOLIDER.obj

-- Player Color: determines which team this ship belongs to ("Red" or "Blue")
-- Used for UI backdrop and future team-specific features
local playerColor = "Blue"

-- Backdrop URLs per player color
local BACKDROP_URLS = {
    Red  = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/11411152731605401542/96D9085C03E2FAD4373813AC83478E6B7A9330CF/",
    Blue = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/16446385735819959258/499E85FAE15E7E131D95BD02DCAD1A8B90D600E6/",
}

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local BigUI_Height = -50  -- Default for 30mm, will be updated in onLoad

local FIXED_IMAGE_WIDTH = 200
local FIXED_IMAGE_HEIGHT = 200
local FIXED_IMAGE_POS_X = 0
local FIXED_IMAGE_POS_Y = 0
local FIXED_IMAGE_POS_Z = -225 -- Negative Height Up from Base
local FIXED_IMAGE_ROT_X = 90  -- X-axis rotation (pitch)
local FIXED_IMAGE_ROT_Y = 270  -- Horizontal rotation
local FIXED_IMAGE_ROT_Z = 90  -- Vertical tilt

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ RADIAL MOVEMENT CONFIGURATION ----------------------
local MAX_RANGE = 10
local MAX_TURN_ANGLE = 45
local MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD = 0.1
local SMOOTH_SPEED = 6
local MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS = true
local DRAW_RAIL_LINE = true
local UNIT_SCALE = 1.0
local LINE_Y_OFFSET = 0.3

-- Movement state variables
local isHeld = false
local holdingPlayerColor = nil
local pivotPosition = nil
local startRotation = nil
local startForwardVec = nil
local currentSmoothedPos = nil
local courseChangePhase = 1  -- Track phase for Course Change: 1 or 2
local courseChangeDistance = 0  -- Track distance moved in phase 1
local pickupPosition = nil
local pickupRotation = nil

-- Movement Tracking
local accumulatedDistance = 0

--- =========================================================
-- 3D MODEL TOGGLE - WITH SCALE MANAGEMENT
-- =========================================================
local Model3DAvailable = false



local PLACEHOLDER_MESH_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9677217278061704/57037684E623F5E07758B8F6811F78DD224C8668/"
local PLACEHOLDER_DIFFUSE_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/14483890135573600795/9622EC8F940C3CCA7EAE7CF86AC358A2EBA6716E/"

local SHIP_CHILD_NICK = "SHIP3dmodel"
local modelAttachmentIndex = nil  -- Track which index the model is at

-- Scale management
local savedModelScale = nil  -- Store the original scale
local PLACEHOLDER_SCALE = 0.001  -- Extremely small (invisible)

function findAndModifyShip3DModel(meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale)
    --print("=== Finding and modifying SHIP3dmodel ===")
    --print("Looking for mesh: " .. (meshUrl:match("([^/]+)$") or meshUrl:sub(1, 40)))
    --print("Cached index: " .. tostring(modelAttachmentIndex))

    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    if not attachments or #attachments == 0 then
      --  print("ERROR: No attachments found!")
        return false
    end

    --print("Found " .. #attachments .. " attachments")

    -- If we know the index, try it first
    if modelAttachmentIndex ~= nil then
        --print("Trying cached index " .. modelAttachmentIndex)
        local obj = self.removeAttachment(modelAttachmentIndex)

        if obj then
            local data = obj.getData()
            if data and data.Nickname == SHIP_CHILD_NICK then
              --  print("Found cached model, updating...")

                -- Save current scale if switching TO placeholder
                if not Model3DAvailable and savedModelScale == nil then
                    savedModelScale = obj.getScale()
                  --  print("Saved original scale: " .. savedModelScale.x .. ", " .. savedModelScale.y .. ", " .. savedModelScale.z)
                end

                -- Update mesh/diffuse
                obj.setCustomObject({
                    mesh = meshUrl,
                    diffuse = diffuseUrl
                })

                -- Update scale
                if targetScale then
                    obj.setScale(targetScale)
                  --  print("Set scale to: " .. targetScale.x .. ", " .. targetScale.y .. ", " .. targetScale.z)
                end

                self.addAttachment(obj)
            --    print("SUCCESS: Model updated via cached index!")
                return true
            else
                -- Wrong object, put it back
                self.addAttachment(obj)
            end
        end
        modelAttachmentIndex = nil  -- Clear invalid cache
    end

    -- Search through all attachments
    for i = 0, #attachments - 1 do
      --  print("Trying attachment index " .. i)

        local obj = self.removeAttachment(i)

        if obj then
            local objType = obj.type or "unknown"
            local data = obj.getData()
            local nickname = data and data.Nickname or ""

          --  print("  Detached object: Type=" .. objType .. ", Nick=" .. nickname)

            -- Check if this is our model
            if nickname == SHIP_CHILD_NICK or objType == "Custom_Model" then
            --    print("  *** MATCH FOUND! ***")

                -- Save current scale if switching TO placeholder
                if not Model3DAvailable and savedModelScale == nil then
                    savedModelScale = obj.getScale()
                  --  print("  Saved original scale: " .. savedModelScale.x .. ", " .. savedModelScale.y .. ", " .. savedModelScale.z)
                end

                -- Update the mesh/diffuse
                local success, err = pcall(function()
                    obj.setCustomObject({
                        mesh = meshUrl,
                        diffuse = diffuseUrl
                    })
                end)

                if success then
                --    print("  Model mesh updated successfully")

                    -- Update scale
                    if targetScale then
                        obj.setScale(targetScale)
                  --      print("  Scale set to: " .. targetScale.x .. ", " .. targetScale.y .. ", " .. targetScale.z)
                    end

                    modelAttachmentIndex = i  -- Cache the index
                else
                    print("  ERROR updating: " .. tostring(err))
                end

                -- Reattach at the SAME index
                self.addAttachment(obj)
            --    print("  Model reattached at index " .. i)

                return success
            else
                -- Not our model, put it back
                self.addAttachment(obj)
              --  print("  Not the model, reattached")
            end
        else
          --  print("  removeAttachment returned nil")
        end
    end

    --print("ERROR: Could not find SHIP3dmodel in attachments")
    return false
end

function apply3DModelState()
  --  print("==========================================")
  --  print("APPLY 3D MODEL STATE")
  --  print("Model3DAvailable = " .. tostring(Model3DAvailable))
  --  print("==========================================")

    local meshUrl, diffuseUrl, targetScale

    if Model3DAvailable then

    end

function generateFiringArcLines()
    cachedFiringArcLines = {}

    local forward = Vector(0,0,1)
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then forward = Vector(1,0,0) end

    -- Calculate scan radius to match scan lines
    local scanRadius = ShipScan * (10/3) * UNIT_SCALE

    -- Set arc line length to 16" (extends 16" on each side = 32" total)
        local arcLineLength = 16 * UNIT_SCALE

    -- Helper to add symmetric lines with custom color
    local function addAngleLines(angleDeg, lineColor)
        local rotRight = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', angleDeg)
        local rotLeft = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', -angleDeg)

        -- Line 1 (Right side) - extends from -arcLineLength to +arcLineLength
        local p1 = rotRight * arcLineLength
        local p2 = rotRight * (-arcLineLength)
        p1.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p2.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p1, p2 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })

        -- Line 2 (Left side)
        local p3 = rotLeft * arcLineLength
        local p4 = rotLeft * (-arcLineLength)
        p3.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p4.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p3, p4 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })
    end

    -- Front/Side/Rear (45 degrees) - Dark Red
    addAngleLines(45, {0, 0, 0.6})

    -- Front/Rear Narrow (11 degrees) - Dark Blue
    addAngleLines(11, {0.6, 0, 0})
end

function generateScanLines()
    cachedScanLines = {}
    local circleColor = {0.5, 1, 0.5}    -- Light Green

    -- Circle Scan Range - use ShipScan variable
    local scanRadius = ShipScan * UNIT_SCALE

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * scanRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * scanRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedScanLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.1
    })
end

function onPickUp(player_color)
      -- Reset move tracker when starting a new radial move
      accumulatedDistance = 0
      UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()

      -- Check if MoveOff is active - if so, skip radial movement setup
      if state.conditions.MoveOff and state.conditions.MoveOff > 0 then
          isHeld = false
          return
      end

    isHeld = true
    holdingPlayerColor = player_color

    -- Store pickup position/rotation for undo (do this FIRST)
    pickupPosition = self.getPosition()
    pickupRotation = self.getRotation()

    -- Record the position and rotation where the object was picked up
    pivotPosition = self.getPosition()  -- Always use current position as pivot
    startRotation = self.getRotation()
    currentSmoothedPos = self.getPosition()

    -- For Course Change: check if we're starting a new maneuver or continuing to phase 2
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        -- If we just dropped and are picking up again, move to phase 2
        if courseChangePhase == 1 and courseChangeDistance > 0 then
            courseChangePhase = 2
            print("[FFAA00]Course Change: Phase 2 - Turn up to 45° more (total 90°), NO MOVEMENT [-]")
        else
            -- Starting fresh phase 1
            courseChangePhase = 1
            courseChangeDistance = 0
        end
    else
        -- Reset for other orders
        courseChangePhase = 1
        courseChangeDistance = 0
    end

    -- Determine the starting "Forward" vector based on the model configuration
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformRight() -- Local X-axis
    else
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformForward() -- Local Z-axis
    end
    -- Flatten Y to ensure 2D calculations
    startForwardVec.y = 0
    startForwardVec:normalize()
end

function onDrop(player_color)
    -- TRACKING: Add current segment to accumulated distance
    if isHeld and pickupPosition then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        local dist = Vector.distance(pickupPosition, currentPos) / UNIT_SCALE
        accumulatedDistance = accumulatedDistance + dist
        -- Update UI immediately
        UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()
    end

    isHeld = false
    holdingPlayerColor = nil

    -- Clear physics velocities to prevent "fling" effect on release
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))

    -- For Course Change: lock distance after phase 1 drop
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" and courseChangePhase == 1 then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        local diffX = currentPos.x - pivotPosition.x
        local diffZ = currentPos.z - pivotPosition.z
        local movedDistance = math.sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffZ * diffZ) / UNIT_SCALE

        if movedDistance > 0.1 then  -- Minimum movement threshold
            courseChangeDistance = movedDistance
            print("[22AA22]Course Change: Phase 1 complete - Moved " .. string.format("%.1f", courseChangeDistance) .. " inches. Pick up again to turn additional 45° [-]")
        else
            -- Reset if they didn't actually move
            courseChangePhase = 1
            courseChangeDistance = 0
        end
    end

    -- Update visuals based on Aura state
    updateAuraVisuals()
end

function updateRadialMovement(player)
    local pointerPos = player.getPointerPosition()

    -- Get movement parameters based on active special order
    local MIN_RANGE, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC, MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC = getMovementParameters()

    -- 1. Calculate Direction and Distance
    local diffX = pointerPos.x - pivotPosition.x
    local diffZ = pointerPos.z - pivotPosition.z
    local directionVec = Vector(diffX, 0, diffZ)
    local currentDist = directionVec:magnitude()

    -- 2. Deadzone / Movement Threshold Check
    if currentDist < MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD * UNIT_SCALE then
        self.setPosition(pivotPosition)
        self.setRotation(startRotation)
        self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
        self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))

        currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition

        updateAuraVisuals()
        return
    end

    -- 3. Calculate Direction & Clamp Angle
    local moveDir = directionVec:normalized()

    -- Calculate angle difference between Start Forward and Current Direction
    local angleDiff = Vector.angle(startForwardVec, moveDir)

    -- Check if angle exceeds limit (use dynamic max turn angle)
    if angleDiff > MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC then
        local cross = startForwardVec:cross(moveDir)
        local sign = 1
        if cross.y < 0 then sign = -1 end
        moveDir = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', sign * MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
    end

    -- 4. Calculate New Position with MIN and MAX range
    local targetPos  -- Declare here so it's available throughout the function

    -- Special handling for Course Change order
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        if courseChangePhase == 1 then
            -- Phase 1: Normal movement up to half thrust
            local currentDistInches = currentDist / UNIT_SCALE
            local clampDistInches = math.max(MIN_RANGE, math.min(currentDistInches, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC))
            local clampDist = clampDistInches * UNIT_SCALE
            targetPos = pivotPosition + (moveDir * clampDist)
        else
            -- Phase 2: NO MOVEMENT - ship stays at pivot position and only rotates
            targetPos = pivotPosition
            -- Note: Rotation is handled separately below in step 5
        end
    else
        -- Standard clamping for other orders
        local currentDistInches = currentDist / UNIT_SCALE
        local clampDistInches = math.max(MIN_RANGE, math.min(currentDistInches, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC))
        local clampDist = clampDistInches * UNIT_SCALE
        targetPos = pivotPosition + (moveDir * clampDist)
    end

    -- Preserve the object's current height
    local currentHandPos = self.getPosition()
    targetPos.y = currentHandPos.y

    -- Smooth interpolation
    if currentSmoothedPos == nil then currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition end
    currentSmoothedPos = currentSmoothedPos:lerp(targetPos, Time.delta_time * SMOOTH_SPEED)
    currentSmoothedPos.y = targetPos.y
    self.setPosition(currentSmoothedPos)

    -- 5. Calculate Rotation
    local targetAngle = moveDir:heading("y")
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        targetAngle = targetAngle - 90
    end
    self.setRotation(Vector(0, targetAngle, 0))

    -- 6. Physics Cleanup
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))

    -- 7. Visual Feedback
    local finalLines = {}

    -- Add Aura visuals if enabled (firing arcs + scan)
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
    end

    if DRAW_RAIL_LINE then
        local visualDir = moveDir
        local shipOffset = currentSmoothedPos - pivotPosition
        shipOffset.y = 0

        if shipOffset:magnitude() > 0.1 then
             visualDir = shipOffset:normalized()
        end

        -- Use dynamic max range for visual
        local railEnd = pivotPosition + (visualDir * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)

        local localStart = self.positionToLocal(pivotPosition)
        localStart.y = localStart.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localEnd = self.positionToLocal(railEnd)
        localEnd.y = localEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

        -- Use dynamic max turn angle for limit lines
        local leftLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', -MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
        local rightLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)

        local leftLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)
        local rightLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)

        local localLeftEnd = self.positionToLocal(leftLimitEnd)
        localLeftEnd.y = localLeftEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localRightEnd = self.positionToLocal(rightLimitEnd)
        localRightEnd.y = localRightEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

        -- Main range line (white)
        table.insert(finalLines, {
            points = { localStart, localEnd },
            color = {1, 1, 1},
            thickness = 0.1,
            rotation = {0,0,0}
        })

        -- Only draw turn limit lines if turning is allowed
        if MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC > 0 then
            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localLeftEnd },
                color = {1, 0, 0},
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localRightEnd },
                color = {1, 0, 0},
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end

        -- Draw minimum range circle if MIN_RANGE > 0
        if MIN_RANGE > 0 then
            local minCirclePoints = {}
            local segments = 32
            local step = 360 / segments
            for i = 0, segments do
                local angle = math.rad(i * step)
                local x = math.cos(angle) * MIN_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE
                local z = math.sin(angle) * MIN_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE
                local worldPos = pivotPosition + Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z)
                table.insert(minCirclePoints, self.positionToLocal(worldPos))
            end

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = minCirclePoints,
                color = {1, 1, 0},  -- Yellow for minimum range
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end
    end

    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function generateSignatureLines()
    cachedSignatureLines = {}

    if not state.sigAuraShown or state.sig == 0 then
        return  -- Don't generate if not shown or sig is 0
    end

    local circleColor = {0.8, 0, 0}  -- Red for signature

    -- Calculate signature radius
    local sigRadius = state.sig * UNIT_SCALE

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * sigRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * sigRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedSignatureLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.15  -- Slightly thicker than scan lines
    })
end

function getMovementParameters()
    -- Safety check - ensure ShipThrust exists
    if not ShipThrust or ShipThrust == 0 then
        ShipThrust = 9  -- Default value
    end

    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    local halfThrust = ShipThrust / 2
    local fullThrust = ShipThrust
    local doubleThrust = ShipThrust * 2

    -- Return: minRange, maxRange, maxTurnAngle
    if activeOrder == "GeneralQuarters" then
        -- Move between half and full thrust, turn up to 45°
        return halfThrust, fullThrust, 45

    elseif activeOrder == "SilentRunningOrder" then
        -- Move between half and full thrust, NO TURNING
        return halfThrust, fullThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "WeaponsFree" then
        -- Move between half and full thrust, NO TURNING
        return halfThrust, fullThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        -- Phase 1: Turn up to 45°, move up to half thrust
        -- Phase 2: Turn another 45° (total 90°), NO MOVEMENT AT ALL
        if courseChangePhase == 1 then
            return 0, halfThrust, 45
        else
            -- Phase 2: ZERO movement, can only rotate
            return 0, 0, 45  -- Changed from courseChangeDistance to 0,0
        end

    elseif activeOrder == "MaxThrust" then
        -- Move between full and double thrust, NO TURNING
        return fullThrust, doubleThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "DamageControl" then
        -- Turn up to 45°, move up to half thrust
        return 0, halfThrust, 45

    else
        -- Default to General Quarters
        return halfThrust, fullThrust, 45
    end
end

function updateAuraVisuals()
    local finalLines = {}

    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
    end

    if state.sigAuraShown and cachedSignatureLines then
        for _, l in ipairs(cachedSignatureLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
    end

    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

    if isHeld and pivotPosition and holdingPlayerColor and (not state.conditions.MoveOff or state.conditions.MoveOff == 0) then
        local player = Player[holdingPlayerColor]
        if player then
            updateRadialMovement(player)
        else

        end
    end

    if state.conditions.ProjectArcs and state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0 and
       ((ChildObjs.aura_obj) or (state.sigAuraShown and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj)) then
        ProjectArcsForward()
    end

    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    local current = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    local target = current + (params.amount or 0)

    -- clamp to 0/1 so it can never stack
    state.conditions.Aura = (target > 0) and 1 or 0

    if state.conditions.Aura > 0 then
        generateFiringArcLines()
        generateScanLines()
    end

    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end


function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus

    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)

    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig

        -- Regenerate signature lines if they're being shown
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            generateSignatureLines()
            updateAuraVisuals()
            print("Signature updated to: " .. state.sig .. " inches")
        end
    end
end

        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        generateSignatureLines()  -- Generate the circle
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else

        cachedSignatureLines = nil  -- Clear the lines
    end

    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

-- Update the ModifyCondition function to handle fractionNumber wrapping (0-9)
function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            -- Special handling for FractionNumber
            if params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                -- Increment or decrement and wrap around 0-9
                local newValue = (previousValue + params.amount) % 10
                if newValue < 0 then newValue = 9 end  -- Handle negative wrap-around
                state.conditions[params.name] = newValue
                state.fractionNumber = newValue  -- Update the state variable
            else
                state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
            end
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        if params.name ~= "MoveNumber" and params.name ~= "FractionNumber" then
            print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        else
            if params.name == "MoveNumber" then
                state.moveNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            elseif params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                state.fractionNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            end
        end
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Set specific color values (light blue from color picker)
    -- RGB: 190, 221, 255 (normalized to 0-1 range)
    -- Alpha: 35 (normalized to 0-1 range)
    state.base.color = {
        r = 190/255,  -- 0.745
        g = 221/255,  -- 0.867
        b = 255/255,  -- 1.0
        a = 35/255    -- 0.137 (alpha/transparency)
    }

    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        local alpha = baseColor.a or 1.0  -- Use stored alpha or default to fully opaque

        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            -- Not activated - use the light blue color with stored alpha
            self.setColorTint({
                r = baseColor.r,
                g = baseColor.g,
                b = baseColor.b,
                a = alpha
            })
        else
            -- Activated - use the same light blue color with stored alpha
            self.setColorTint({
                r = baseColor.r,
                g = baseColor.g,
                b = baseColor.b,
                a = alpha
            })
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    if not state or not state.conditions or not Conditions then return end

    local conditionData = Conditions[name]
    if not conditionData then
        print("SyncCondition: Unknown condition '" .. tostring(name) .. "'")
        return
    end

    for _, color in ipairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0

        -- Special handling for Status button - show active if any critical status is active
        local isActive
        if name == "Status" then
            isActive = HasCriticalStatus()
            state.conditions.Status = isActive and 1 or 0
        else
            isActive = conditionValue > 0
        end

        local imageUrl
        local colorBlock
        if name == "MoveOff" then
            local moveCond = Conditions["MoveOff"]
            imageUrl = isActive and (moveCond.active_url or moveCond.url) or moveCond.url
            colorBlock = isActive and "#00FF00FF" or "#000000FF"
        else
            imageUrl = isActive and (conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url) or conditionData.url
            if currentUIMode == 0 then
                colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. "FF"
            else
                colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. (isActive and "FF" or "22")
            end
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and "true" or "false",
            text = tostring(conditionValue)
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then

    end

-- Improved smooth rotation tracking for camera-facing UI
function HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
    local playerRotation = player.getPointerRotation()
    if playerRotation == nil then playerRotation = 0 end

    -- Calculate the exact rotation needed to face the player's camera
    local targetRotation = playerRotation - self.getRotation().y + 180

    -- Normalize angle to 0-360 range
    targetRotation = targetRotation % 360

    -- Get the current stored rotation (or initialize if not set)
    local currentRotation = UIStatus[player.color].rotation
    if currentRotation == nil then
        -- First time - snap to target immediately
        currentRotation = targetRotation
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = currentRotation
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -currentRotation)
        return
    end

    -- Calculate the shortest angle difference for smooth interpolation
    local angleDiff = targetRotation - currentRotation

    -- Handle wrap-around (e.g., going from 350 to 10 degrees)
    if angleDiff > 180 then
        angleDiff = angleDiff - 360
    elseif angleDiff < -180 then
        angleDiff = angleDiff + 360
    end

    -- Only update if there's a meaningful difference (reduces unnecessary UI updates)
    if math.abs(angleDiff) > 0.5 then
        -- Smooth interpolation using Time.delta_time for framerate independence
        local smoothSpeed = 40 -- Adjust speed as needed
        local smoothFactor = math.min(1, Time.delta_time * smoothSpeed)

        local newRotation = currentRotation + (angleDiff * smoothFactor)

        -- Normalize the new rotation to 0-360
        newRotation = newRotation % 360
        if newRotation < 0 then newRotation = newRotation + 360 end

        -- Apply the rotation to the UI element
        self.UI.setAttribute(player.color .. '_PlayerHUDPivot', 'rotation', '0 0 ' .. -newRotation)
        UIStatus[player.color].rotation = newRotation
    end
end

    if name == "Status" then

    local wasOnSilentRunning = (state.activeSpecialOrder == "SilentRunningOrder")

    state.activeSpecialOrder = orderName
    state.specialOrdersMenuOpen = false
    state.conditions.SpecialOrders = 0

    -- Reset Course Change phases when changing orders
    courseChangePhase = 1
    courseChangeDistance = 0

    -- Handle Silent Running activation/deactivation
    if orderName == "SilentRunningOrder" then

        state.conditions.Silent_Running = 1
        cloaked = 1
        print("Special Order selected: Silent Running Order - Signature Set to 0")

    end

    Sync()

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end

    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end

    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local isActive = conditionValue > 0

    local imageUrl
    if name == "MoveOff" then
        local moveCond = Conditions["MoveOff"]
        imageUrl = isActive and (moveCond.active_url or moveCond.url) or moveCond.url
    else
        imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url
    end

    local colorBlock
    if name == "MoveOff" then
        colorBlock = (isActive and "#00FF00FF" or "#ffffff")
    else
        if currentUIMode == 0 then
            colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"
        else
            local isActive2 = (state.conditions[name] or 0) > 0
            colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive2 and 'FF' or '22')
        end
    end
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85)

    local displayText = name == "Move" and "Move" or tostring(state.conditions[name] or 0)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />

-- Update the UI_ModifyMove function to use fractional movement
function UI_ModifyMove(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

        if moveAmount > 0 then
            if not self.getLock() then
                self.setLock(true)
            end

            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()

            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

            local directionMultiplier = alt == '-2' and -1 or 1

            local deltaX = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)

            local newPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }

            self.setPosition(newPos)

            local direction = directionMultiplier == 1 and "forward" or "backward"
            local modelName = self.getName()

            local colorCode = directionMultiplier == 1 and "22AA22" or "AA2222"
            print(modelName .. " has moved " ..
                "[" .. colorCode .. "]" .. direction .. "[-][F4641D] " ..
                string.format("%.1f", moveAmount) .. "[-] inches ")

            showMeasurementLine()
        end
    end
end

function ToggleProjectedArcs()
    local isProjected = state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0

    if isProjected then
        ProjectArcsForward()
        print("[22AA22] Projecting ship arcs [-]")
    else
        ResetArcs()
        print("[AA2222] Resetting ship arcs [-]")
    end
end

function ProjectArcsForward()
    if state._projectingArcs then return end
    state._projectingArcs = true

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

        if moveAmount > 0 then
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()

            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

            local deltaX = moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)

            local projectedPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('originalParent', self)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', nil)

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(projectedPos)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint({r = 0, g = 1, b = 0, a = 0.6})

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
                function onUpdate()
                    -- Keep position static when projected
                end
            ]])
        end
    end

    state._projectingArcs = false
end

function ResetArcs()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self)
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())

        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint(clr)

        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
            function onUpdate()
                if parent and parent.getPosition then
                    self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                    self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                end
            end
        ]])
    end
end

end

function UI_ModifyStatus(p, alt)

function ApplyActivatedLockState()
    local activated = (state and state.conditions and (state.conditions.Activated or 0) > 0)

    if activated then
        if not self.getLock() then
            self.setLock(true)
        end
    else
        if self.getLock() then
            self.setLock(false)
        end
    end
end

    else

    Sync()
end
---------------SHIP MOVEMENT PROJECTION-----------------
function showMeasurementLine()
    local ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER = 0.5
    local ARROW_WIDTH = 1.05
    local ARROW_HEIGHT = 1
    local ARROW_Y_OFFSET = 0
    local ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET = 0
    local ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET = 270
    local ARROW_COLOR = {r=0, g=1, b=0, a=0.7}
    local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION = {0, 0, 0}

    local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
    local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
    local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

    if moveAmount > 0 then
        local rotation = self.getRotation()
        local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
        local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

        local currentPos = self.getPosition()

        local arrowPos = {
            x = currentPos.x + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.sin(moveAngle),
            y = currentPos.y + ARROW_Y_OFFSET,
            z = currentPos.z + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.cos(moveAngle)
        }

        if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setPosition(arrowPos)
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setRotation({
                ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1],
                rotation.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET,
                ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3]
            })
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setScale({ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER, ARROW_HEIGHT, moveAmount * ARROW_WIDTH})
        else
            ChildObjs.measurement_line = spawnObject({
                type = 'Custom_Model',
                position = arrowPos,
                rotation = {
                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1],
                    rotation.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET,
                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3]
                },
                scale = {ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER, ARROW_HEIGHT, ARROW_WIDTH},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(obj)
                    obj.setColorTint(ARROW_COLOR)
                    obj.setVar('parent', self)
                    obj.setLuaScript([[
                        local ARROW_Y_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_Y_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_X = ]] .. ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1] .. [[
                        local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_Z = ]] .. ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3] .. [[

                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                local shipPos = parent.getPosition()
                                local shipRot = parent.getRotation()

                                local shipAngle = math.rad(shipRot.y)
                                local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

                                local arrowPos = {
                                    x = shipPos.x + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.sin(moveAngle),
                                    y = shipPos.y + ARROW_Y_OFFSET,
                                    z = shipPos.z + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.cos(moveAngle)
                                }

                                self.setPosition(arrowPos)
                                self.setRotation({
                                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_X,
                                    shipRot.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET,
                                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_Z
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    obj.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })

            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9677217278061704/57037684E623F5E07758B8F6811F78DD224C8668/',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                type = 0,
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0.1,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    else
        if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        end
    end
end

function RefreshShip()
    local currentState = {
        conditions = state.conditions,
        health = state.health,
        base = state.base,
        imageScale = state.imageScale,
        sig = state.sig,
        sigAuraShown = state.sigAuraShown,
    }
    --print("Rebuilding Assets")
    rebuildAssets()
--print("Wait")
    Wait.frames(function()
        for key, value in pairs(currentState) do
            state[key] = value
        end

        self.UI.setXml(ui())
        Sync()
        RefreshModelShape()
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            showSigAura()
        end
        showMeasurementLine()

        RecalculateSignature()

        --print(self.getName() .. " has been refreshed.")
    end, 2)
end

function UI_ModifyShipcost(p, alt)

        print("Ship Cost: " .. Shipcost)

        updateAuraVisuals()

        Sync()
        print("Ship Scan: " .. ShipScan .. '"')
    end

--[[
    Mat Chooser Script
    
    This mat tile uses Global UI for the mat chooser panel.
    This approach ensures the UI persists even when the mat reloads.
    
    Flow:
    1. Player clicks "Choose Mat Image" button on the mat
    2. Mat tells Global to open the UI, passing its GUID
    3. Player selects an image in the Global UI
    4. Global calls back to this mat's changeMatImage() function
    5. Mat changes its image and reloads (UI is unaffected because it's Global)
]]

function onLoad()
    -- Default mat image (used on load if the current image is different)
    local DEFAULT_IMAGE = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/14918722638024884561/1862826ED8EFBDC8B34AE0F6BE217E00798CE471/"

    self.interactable = false
    self.gizmo_selectable = false

    -- Ensure a default mat image is set on load. If it's different, update and reload once.
    local custom = self.getCustomObject() or {}
    local current = custom.image or ""
    if current ~= DEFAULT_IMAGE then
        custom.image = DEFAULT_IMAGE
        self.setCustomObject(custom)
        -- Apply the new image by reloading shortly after setting it
        Wait.time(function() self.reload() end, 0.1)
        return
    end

    -- Create the "Choose Mat Image" button on the object
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "openChooser",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "Choose Mat Image",
        position       = {-0.86, 0.2, -1.028},
        rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
        width          = 1300,
        height         = 270,
        scale          = {0.1, 0.1, 0.1},
        font_size      = 140,
        color          = {0, 0, 0},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
    })
end

-- Called when the button is clicked - opens Global UI
function openChooser(obj, playerColor, alt_click)
    -- Tell Global to open the mat chooser UI for this player
    -- We pass our GUID so Global can find us later when the player selects an image
    Global.call("openMatChooser", {
        playerColor = playerColor,
        matGUID = self.getGUID()
    })
end

-- Called by Global when the player selects a mat image
function changeMatImage(params)
    local url = params.url
    if not url then return end
    
    -- Change the custom object image
    local custom = self.getCustomObject()
    custom.image = url
    self.setCustomObject(custom)
    
    -- Reload to apply the new image
    -- The UI is in Global, so it won't be affected by this reload!
    self.reload()
end
